title: Dua Akhassi Sifatik
description: A comprehensive Dua covering worldly and otherworldly needs. Recommended for safety from trials, protection from calamities, and for continuous addition in knowledge, health, and a good end in the hereafter.

lines.english: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
lines.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے جو بڑا مہربان نہایت رحم والا ہے

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.urdu: اے اللہ محمدؐ اور آل محمدؐ پر رحمت نازل فرما

lines.arabic: إِلٰهِي بِأَخَصِّ صِفَاتِكَ، وَبِعِزِّ جَلَالِكَ، وَبِأَعْظَمِ أَسْمَائِكَ،
lines.english: Allah, in the name of your most special, in the name of the dignity of your exalted majesty, in the name of the greatness of your names,
lines.transliteration: ILLAHI BI AKHASI SIFATIKA, WA BI EEZI JALALIKA, WA BI ADHAMATI ASMAIKA,
lines.urdu: میرے معبود! تیری خاص ترین صفات کے واسطے سے، اور تیری بزرگ و برتر عزت کے واسطے سے، اور تیرے عظیم ترین ناموں کے واسطے سے،

lines.english: in the name of the purity of your prophets, in the name of the light of your chosen representatives,
lines.transliteration: WA BI ISMATI AN BIYAIKA, WA BI NOORI AULIYAIKA,
lines.urdu: اور تیرے نبیوں کی عصمت کے واسطے سے، اور تیرے اولیاء کے نور کے واسطے سے،

lines.english: in the name of the blood shed by the martyrs in your cause, in the name of the ink used by the scholars of your purpose and plan,
lines.transliteration: WA BI D'AMI SHUHADAIKA, WA BI MIDADI ULAMAIKA,
lines.urdu: اور تیرے راستہ میں بہائے گئے شہیدوں کے خون کے واسطے سے، اور تیرے مقصد کے علماء کی سیاہی کے واسطے سے،

lines.english: in the name of the prayers of the righteous and in the name of the invocations made by your servants leaving in resignation and asceticism,
lines.transliteration: WA BI DUA'AI SULAHAIKA, WA BI MUNAJATI FUKARAIKA,
lines.urdu: اور تیرے نیک بندوں کی دعا کے واسطے سے، اور تیرے ان بندوں کی مناجات کے واسطے سے جو زہد و تقویٰ میں رہتے ہیں،

lines.arabic: نَسْأَلُكَ زِيَادَةً فِي الْعِلْمِ، وَصِحَّةً فِي الْجِسْمِ، وَطُولاً فِي الْعُمْرِ فِي طَاعَتِكَ،
lines.english: We beseech you for continuous addition in knowledge, freedom from sickness in the body, long duration of life spent in your obedience
lines.transliteration: NAS ALUKA ZIYADATAN FIL ILM, WA SIHATAN FIL JISM, WA TULAN FIL UMR FI TA'ATIKA,
lines.urdu: ہم تجھ سے علم میں اضافے، جسم میں تندرستی، اور تیری اطاعت میں لمبی عمر کا سوال کرتے ہیں،

lines.arabic: وَسَعَةً فِي الرِّزْقِ، وَتَوْبَةً قَبْلَ الْمَوْتِ،
lines.english: abundance in the means of livelihood, divine guidance to turn repentant unto you, before death,
lines.transliteration: WA SA'ATAN FI RIZK, WA TAUBATAN KABLAL MAUT,
lines.urdu: اور رزق میں وسعت، اور موت سے پہلے توبہ کی توفیق،

lines.arabic: وَرَاحَةً عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ، وَمَغْفِرَةً بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ، وَنُوراً فِي الْقَبْرِ،
lines.english: freedom from pain at the time of death, protection after death, light in the grave,
lines.transliteration: WA RAHATAN INDAL MAUT, WA MAGHFIRATAN BA'ADAL MAUT, WA NOORAN FIL KABRI,
lines.urdu: اور موت کے وقت راحت، اور موت کے بعد بخشش، اور قبر میں نور کا سوال کرتے ہیں،

lines.arabic: وَنَجَاةً مِنَ النَّارِ، وَدُخُولاً فِي الْجَنَّةِ،
lines.english: escape from the hell, entry into the paradise
lines.transliteration: WA NAJATAN MINA NAARI, WA DUKHULAN FIL JANATI,
lines.urdu: اور آگ سے نجات، اور جنت میں داخلے،

lines.arabic: وَعَافِيَةً مِنْ كُلِّ بَلَاءِ الدُّنْيَا، وَعَذَابِ الْآخِرَةِ،
lines.english: and safety from all the evils of the world and from the chastisement in the hereafter,
lines.transliteration: WA AFIYATAN MIN KULI BALAAI DUNYA, WA ADHABIL AKHIRATI,
lines.urdu: اور دنیا کی ہر بلا اور آخرت کے عذاب سے عافیت کا سوال کرتے ہیں،

lines.arabic: بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ الطَّيِبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ الْمَعْصُومِينَ.
lines.english: in the name and for the sake of Muhammad and his pure, purified and infallible progeny.
lines.transliteration: BIHAKI MUHAMADIN WA AHLI BATIHI TAYIBINA TAHIRIYNAL MA'ASUMINA.
lines.urdu: محمدؐ اور ان کی پاک و پاکیزہ اور معصوم آل کے صدقے میں (ہماری یہ دعائیں قبول فرما)۔

title: Dua Yaman (Ya Man Azharal Jamil)
description: Also known as the 'Supplication of the Youth Stricken for His Sin's cure' or specifically 'Dua Yaman'. It was brought by Gabriel to the Prophet (SAW) and contains the Greatest Name of Allah. It is highly recommended for having one's defects covered and sins forgiven.

lines.english: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
lines.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے جو بڑا مہربان نہایت رحم والا ہے

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.urdu: اے اللہ محمدؐ اور آل محمدؐ پر رحمت نازل فرما

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ أَظْهَرَ الْجَمِيلَ وَسَتَرَ الْقَبِيحَ
lines.english: O You who reveal the beauty and conceal the ugly,
lines.transliteration: Ya man azharal jamil wa sataral qabih
lines.urdu: اے وہ جس نے خوبصورتی کو ظاہر کیا اور برائی کو چھپایا،

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَمْ يُؤَاخِذْ بِالْجَرِيرَةِ وَلَمْ يَهْتِكِ السِّتْرَ
lines.english: O You who do not take the wrongdoer to task and do not tear the veil,
lines.transliteration: Ya man lam yu'akhidh bil jarirah wa lam yahtikis sitr
lines.urdu: اے وہ جس نے گناہ پر گرفت نہیں کی اور پردہ دری نہیں کی،

lines.english: O You who are Great Forgiver,
lines.urdu: اے عظیم درگزر کرنے والے،

lines.english: O You are of great forbearance,
lines.urdu: اے بہترین درگزر کرنے والے،

lines.english: O You who have pardon abounding,
lines.urdu: اے وسیع مغفرت والے،

lines.english: O You who have opened Your hands for mercy,
lines.urdu: اے رحمت کے لیے اپنے ہاتھ کھولنے والے،

lines.english: O Hearer of all whisperings,
lines.urdu: اے ہر سرگوشی کے سننے والے،

lines.english: O You to whom all complaints are made,
lines.urdu: اے وہ جس تک تمام شکایات پہنچتی ہیں،

lines.english: O Possessor of great favor,
lines.urdu: اے بہترین درگزر (صفح) والے،

lines.english: O Possessor of great favor,
lines.urdu: اے عظیم احسان والے،

lines.english: O You who give blessings to Your servants when they do not deserve it,
lines.transliteration: Ya mubtadi'an bin ni'ami qabla istihqaqiha
lines.urdu: اے وہ جس نے مستحق ہونے سے پہلے نعمتوں کا آغاز کیا۔

title: Dua after Ziyarat Ashura
description: You may then offer a two-unit prayer and when you finish, you may say the Dua below:

lines.english: O Allah, I have offered a prayer for You
and I have genuflected and prostrated myself for You
lines.transliteration: wa laka raka`tu wa laka sajadtu

lines.english: alone without setting any partner to You,
because prayers,
genuflections, and prostrations are illegal for anyone save You,

lines.arabic: لاِنَّكَ انْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاََ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ
lines.english: because You are Allah; there is no god save You.
lines.transliteration: li'annaka anta allahu alladhi la ilaha illa anta

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍٍ
lines.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin

lines.english: convey to them the most favorite salutations and greetings from me,
and convey to me their response to my greeting.
O Allah, these two units of prayer are a present from me
lines.transliteration: allahumma wa hatani alrrak`atani hadiyyatun minni

lines.english: to my master al-Husayn the son of `Ali,
peace be upon both of them.
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon him,
accept these two units of prayer from me, and reward me for them

lines.arabic: افْضَلَ امَلِي وَرَجَائِي فِيكَ وَفِي وَلِيِّكَ
lines.english: by granting me the best of my hope and expectation in you and in Your Friend,
lines.transliteration: afdala amali wa raja'i fika wa fi waliyyika

lines.english: O Guardian of the believers!
Peace be upon al-Husayn the son of `Ali,
the wronged and martyred,
the victim of shed tears,
and the captive of agonies.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اشْهَدُ انَّهُ وَلِيُّكَ وَٱبْنُ وَلِيِّكَ
lines.english: O Allah, I do bear witness that he is Your intimate friend and the son of Your intimate friend
lines.transliteration: allahumma inna ashhadu annahu waliyyuka wabnu waliyyika

lines.english: and Your choicest one who revolted to demand with Your right.
You have thus honored him with Your honor,
sealed his lifetime with martyrdom,
made him one of the chiefs
and one of the leaders,
honored him with immaculate birth,
gave him the inheritances of the prophets,

lines.arabic: وَجَعَلْتَهُ حُجَّةً عَلَىٰ خَلْقِكَ مِنَ ٱلاوْصِيَاءِ
lines.english: and made him argument against Your creatures and one of the Successors.
lines.transliteration: wa ja`altahu hujjatan `ala khalqika min al-awsiya'i

lines.english: So, he called to You flawlessly,
gave advice,
and sacrificed himself for Your sake

lines.arabic: حَتَّىٰ ٱسْتَنْقَذَ عِبَادَكَ مِنَ ٱلْجَهَالَةِ وَحَيْرَةِ ٱلضَّلاَلَةِ
lines.english: until he could save Your servants from ignorance and perplexity of straying off.
lines.transliteration: hatta istanqadha `ibadaka min aljahalati wa hayrati alddalalati

lines.arabic: وَقَدْ تَوَازَرَ عَلَيْهِ مَنْ غَرَّتْهُ ٱلدُّنْيَا
lines.english: Yet, those whom were seduced by this worldly life,
lines.transliteration: wa qad tawazara `alayhi man gharrat-hu alddunya

lines.english: those who sold their share of the Hereafter with the lowly price,
lines.transliteration: wa ba`a hazzahu min al-akhirati bil-adna

lines.english: those who perished because of following their desires,
those who brought to themselves Your wrath and the wrath of Your Prophet,

lines.arabic: وَاطَاعَ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ اوْلِي ٱلشِّقَاقِ وَٱلنِّفَاقِ
lines.english: and those who obeyed the dissident and hypocritical servants of You
lines.transliteration: wa ata`a min `ibadika uli alshshiqaqi walnnifaqi

lines.english: and the bearers of the burdens (of sins) who deserve Hellfire—all those supported each other against him;
so, he fought against them with steadfastness and expectation of Your reward,
facing them courageously, never turning back,

lines.arabic: لاََ تَاخُذُهُ فِي ٱللَّهُ لَوْمَةُ لاَئِمٍ
lines.english: and never fearing the blame of anyone concerning carrying out his duty towards You
lines.transliteration: la ta'khudhuhu fi allahi lawmatu la'imin

lines.english: until his blood was shed while he was in obedience to You
and his inviolability was also infringed.
O Allah, curse them with incessant curses
and chastise them with painful chastisement

title: Dua Alqama
description: This Dua is recited after Ziyarat Ashura. It is also known as Dua Safwan.

lines.arabic: يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ
lines.transliteration: ya allahu ya allahu ya allahu
lines.english: O Allah! O Allah! O Allah!
O He Who responds to the prayer of the distressed!
O He Who relieves the agonies of the agonized!
O Aide of the callers for aid!
O Helper of those who cry for help!

lines.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيَّ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
lines.transliteration: wa ya man huwa aqrabu ilayya min habli alwaridi
lines.english: O He Who is nearer to me than my life-vein!

lines.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يَحُولُ بَيْنَ ٱلْمَرْءِ وَقَلْبِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa ya man yahulu bayna almar'i wa qalbihi
lines.english: O He Who intervenes between man and his heart!

lines.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ هُوَ بِٱلْمَنْظَرِ ٱلأَعْلَىٰ وَبِٱلأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
lines.transliteration: wa ya man huwa bilmanzari al-a`la wa bil'ufuqi almubini
lines.english: O He Who is in the Highest Position and in the Clear Horizon!

lines.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمٰنُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱسْتَوَىٰ
lines.transliteration: wa ya man huwa alrrahmanu alrrahimu `ala al`arshi istawa
lines.english: O He Who is all-beneficent and all-merciful and is established on the Throne!

lines.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يَعْلَمُ خَائِنَةَ ٱلأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِي ٱلصُّدُورُ
lines.transliteration: wa ya man ya`lamu kha'inata al-a`yuni wa ma tukhfi alssuduru
lines.english: O He Who knows the stealthy looks and that which the breasts conceal!

lines.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يَخْفَىٰ عَلَيْهِ خَافِيَةٌ
lines.transliteration: wa ya man la yakhfa `alayhi khafiyatun
lines.english: O He from Whom no secret can remain hidden!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ لاَ تَشْتَبِهُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلأَصْوَاتُ
lines.english: O He Whom is not confused by the many voices (that pray Him)!

lines.transliteration: wa ya man la tughallituhu alhajatu
lines.english: O He Whom is not confounded by the many requests (that are raised to Him)!

lines.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يُبْرِمُهُ إِلْحَاحُ ٱلْمُلِحِّينَ
lines.transliteration: wa ya man la yubrimuhu ilhahu almulihhina
lines.english: O He Who is not annoyed by the insistence of those who entreat Him persistently!
O He Who overtakes every attempt of escape!
O Reunifier of every scattering thing!

lines.transliteration: wa ya bari'a alnnufusi ba`da almawti
lines.english: O Re-originator of the souls after death!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ هُوَ كُلِّ يَوْمٍ فِي شَأْنٍ
lines.transliteration: ya man huwa kulla yawmin fi sha'nin
lines.english: O He Who is in a state every moment!
O Grantor of requests!
O Reliever of agonies!
O Conferrer of demands!
O Bestower of desires!
O Savior from sufferings!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ يَكْفِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
lines.transliteration: ya man yakfi min kulli shay'in
lines.english: O He Who can save from all things

lines.arabic: وَلاَ يَكْفِي مِنْهُ شَيْءٌ فِي ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ
lines.transliteration: wa la yakfi minhu shay'un fi alssamawati wal-ardi
lines.english: and nothing in the heavens or in the earth can save from Him!
I beseech You in the name of Muhammad the seal of the Prophets,
`Ali the commander of the faithful,
Fatimah the daughter of Your Prophet,
al-Hasan, and al-Husayn,

lines.arabic: فَإِنِّي بِهِمْ أَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْكَ فِي مَقَامِي هٰذَا
lines.transliteration: fa'inni bihim atawajjahu ilayka fi maqami hadha
lines.english: for I turn my face towards You in their names at this very situation of mine,
I make them my means to You,
I seek their intercession for me with You,

lines.transliteration: wa bihaqqihim as'aluka wa uqsimu wa a`zimu `alayka
lines.english: I beseech You in the name of Your duty towards them, I adjure You, and I beg You earnestly,
in the name of the status that they enjoy with You,
the value that they enjoy in Your sight,
in the name of the thing by which You have preferred them over all the other beings,
in the name of Your Name that You have placed with them
and given them exclusively other than all the other beings,
and through which You have distinguished them

lines.transliteration: wa abanta fadlahum min fadli al`alamina
lines.english: and demonstrated their distinctive precedence over all the other beings so uniquely

lines.arabic: حَتَّىٰ فَاقَ فَضْلُهُمْ فَضْلَ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ جَمِيعاً
lines.transliteration: hatta faqa fadluhum fadla al`alamina jami`an
lines.english: that their preference has exceeded all the distinctive features of all the other beings;

lines.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: as'aluka an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: I beseech You (in the name of all that) to send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
to relieve me from my distress,
grief, and agony,
to make up for me all my distressing affairs,
to help me settle my debts,
to safeguard me against poverty,
to safeguard me against scarcity,
to make me dispense with begging from the created beings,

lines.transliteration: wa takfiyani hamma man akhafu hammahu
lines.english: to spare me from the distress of what I anticipate to distress me,
the difficulty of what I anticipate to be difficult for me,
the toughness of what I anticipate to be hard for me (to deal with),
the evil of what I anticipate to be evil,
the conspiracy of whom I anticipate to plot conspiracy (against me),
the tyranny of whom I anticipate to treat me tyrannically,
the injustice of whom I anticipate to be unjust to me
the domination of whom I anticipate to dominate me,
the trickery of whom I anticipate to trick me,
and the authority of whom I anticipate to seize me,
and to ward off from me the trickeries of the deceivers
and the cunning of the devious.
O Allah, stand for me against him who intends evil for me,
intrigue against him who intends to conspire against me,
turn away from me his trickeries, cunning,
influence, and evil desires,

lines.arabic: وَٱمْنَعْهُ عَنِّي كَيْفَ شِئْتَ وَأَنَّىٰ شِئْتَ
lines.transliteration: wamna`hu `anni kayfa shi'ta wa anna shi'ta
lines.english: and prevent him against me in any way You choose and at any time You choose.
O Allah, (please) preoccupy him against me
by means of poverty that You never cut down,
ordeals that You never recover,
neediness that You never stop,
ailment that You never heal,
humility that You never change into dignity,
and destitution that You never cut down.
O Allah, (please) strike him with humility in the center of his eyes,
interleave poverty to his own house,
place ailment and disease in his body

lines.arabic: حَتَّىٰ تَشْغَلَهُ عَنِّي بِشُغْلٍ شَاغِلٍ لاَ فَرَاغَ لَهُ
lines.transliteration: hatta tashghalahu `anni bishughlin shaghilin la faragha lahu
lines.english: so that You will preoccupy him with an engrossing, relentless preoccupation,

lines.transliteration: wa ansihi dhikri kama ansaytahu dhikraka
lines.english: make him fail to remember me in the same was as he has failed to remember You,
divert from me his hearing, sight,
tongue, hand,
leg, heart,
and all of his organs,

lines.arabic: وَأَدْخِلْ عَلَيْهِ فِي جَمِيعِ ذٰلِكَ ٱلسُّقْمَ
lines.transliteration: wa adkhil `alayhi fi jami`i dhalika alssuqma
lines.english: place in him sickness in all these (organs),

lines.arabic: وَلا تَشْفِهِ حَتَّىٰ تَجْعَلَ ذٰلِكَ لَهُ شُغْلاً شَاغِلاً بِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa la tashfihi hatta taj`ala dhalika lahu shughlan shaghilan bihi
lines.english: and do not heal him so that all these (sicknesses) will preoccupy him relentlessly
from me and from mentioning me.

lines.arabic: وَٱكْفِنِي يَا كَافِي مَا لاَ يَكْفِي سِوَاكَ
lines.transliteration: wakfini ya kafi ma la yakfi siwaka
lines.english: And spare me, O Savior, from all that which cannot be spared by anyone other than You,
for You are verily the Savior; and there is no savior other than You,
You are verily the Reliever, and there is no reliever other than You,
You are verily the Succorer, and there is no succorer other than You,
and You are verily the Shelterer, and there is no shelterer other than You.
Disappointed is he whose shelterer is other than You,
whose recourse to anywhere other than You,
whose resort is anywhere other than You,
whose way out is anywhere other than You,
whose haven is anywhere other than You,
and whose savior from any created being is anyone other than You.
You are verily my trust, my hope,
my resort, my way out,
my haven, and my savior.
With You do I commence
through You do I seek success.
In the name of Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

lines.transliteration: atawajjahu ilayka wa atawassalu wa atashaffa`u
lines.english: do I turn my face towards You, seek means to You, and seek intercession to You.

lines.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ
lines.transliteration: fa'as'aluka ya allahu ya allahu ya allahu
lines.english: So, I beseech You, O Allah! O Allah! O Allah!
Yours is all praise and Yours is all thanks.

lines.transliteration: wa ilayka almushtaka wa anta almusta`anu
lines.english: To You is my complaint and You are the Besought for help.

lines.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ
lines.transliteration: fa'as'aluka ya allahu ya allahu ya allahu
lines.english: So, I beseech You, O Allah! O Allah! O Allah!
In the name of Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

lines.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: to send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

lines.arabic: وَأَنْ تَكْشِفَ عَنِّي غَمِّي وَهَمِّي وَكَرْبِي
lines.transliteration: wa an takshifa `anni ghammi wa hammi wa karbi
lines.english: and to relieve my distress, grief, and agony
in this situation of mine

lines.arabic: كَمَا كَشَفْتَ عَنْ نَبِيِّكَ هَمَّهُ وَغَمَّهُ وَكَرْبَهُ
lines.transliteration: kama kashafta `an nabiyyika hammahu wa ghammahu wa karbahu
lines.english: in the same way as You have relieved the distress, grief, and agony of Your Prophet
and saved him from the horrors of his enemy.
So, (please) relieve me in the same way as You did to him,
dispel my worries in the same way as You did to him,
save me in the same way as You did to him,

lines.arabic: وَٱصْرِفْ عَنِّي هَوْلَ مَا أَخَافُ هَوْلَهُ
lines.english: drive away from me the horror of what I anticipate to horrify me,
the encumbrance of what I anticipate to overburden me,
and the distress of what I anticipate to distress me

lines.arabic: بِلا مَؤُونَةٍ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِي مِنْ ذٰلِكَ
lines.english: without making me suffer any encumbrance due to all that.
And make me leave having all my requests granted
and having all my distresses relieved,
including the affairs of this world and the Hereafter.
O Commander of the Faithful!
O Abu-`Abdullah!
Peace of Allah be upon you both from me forever

lines.transliteration: ma baqitu wa baqiya allaylu walnnaharu
lines.english: as long as I am existent and as long as there are day and night.

lines.arabic: وَلاَ جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ آخِرَ ٱلْعَهْدِ مِنْ زِيَارَتِكُمَا
lines.transliteration: wa la ja`alahu allahu akhira al`ahdi min ziyaratikuma
lines.english: May Allah not decide this time of my visit to you both to be the last.

lines.transliteration: wa la farraqa allahu bayni wa baynakuma
lines.english: May Allah never separate me from you both.

lines.transliteration: allahumma ahyini hayata muhammadin wa dhurriyyatihi
lines.english: O Allah, (please) make me live the same lifestyle that Muhammad and his offspring lived,
make me die on the same faith on which they died,
receive my soul while I am following their religion,
include me with their group,

lines.transliteration: wa la tufarriq bayni wa baynahum
lines.english: and never separate me from them
not for even a winking of any eye
in this world and in the Hereafter.
O Commander of the Faithful!
O Abu-`Abdullah!
I have come to you both to visit you,

lines.transliteration: wa mutawassilan ila allahi rabbi wa rabbikuma
lines.english: making both of you to be my means to Allah your and my Lord,
turning my face to Him in your names,

lines.arabic: وَمُسْتَشْفِعاً بِكُمَا إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ تَعَالَىٰ فِي حَاجَتِي هٰذِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa mustashfi`an bikuma ila allahi ta`ala fi hajati hadhihi
lines.english: and seeking your intercession for me with Allah All-exalted to grant me this request of mine;
so, intercede for me,

lines.arabic: فَإِنَّ لَكُمَا عِنْدَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَقَامَ ٱلْمَحْمُودَ
lines.english: since you both enjoy with Allah a praiseworthy position,
an admissible status,
a lofty standing, and a means (of nearness to Him).
I will now leave you both,
expecting my request to be granted,

lines.transliteration: wa qada'iha wa najahiha min allahi
lines.english: settled, and made successful by Allah

lines.arabic: بِشَفَاعَتِكُمَا لِي إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ فِي ذٰلِكَ
lines.transliteration: bishafa`atikuma li ila allahi fi dhalika
lines.english: on account of your intercession for me with Allah in that;
so, do not let me down

lines.arabic: وَلاَ يَكونُ مُنْقَلَبِي مُنْقَلَباً خَائِباً خَاسِراً
lines.transliteration: wa la yakunu munqalabi munqalaban kha'iban khasiran
lines.english: and do not make me leave with disappointment and loss;
rather, make me leave with achievement,
prosperity, success, and response (of my prayers)
by having all my requests granted.
And (please) intercede for me with Allah recurrently.
I now leave on ‘whatever is willed by Allah shall come to pass’

lines.arabic: وَلا حَوْلَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi
lines.english: and ‘there is neither might nor power except with Allah’,
relegating all my affairs to Allah,
referring all my power to Allah,
depending upon Allah,

lines.transliteration: wa aqulu hasbiya allahu wa kafa
lines.english: and repeating, ‘Allah is only sufficient to me,’
and ‘May Allah respond to him who prays Him.’
Other than Allah
and other than you all, O my masters, I have nothing to put my hope in.
Only that which my Lord wills shall come to pass,

lines.transliteration: wa ma lam yasha' lam yakun
lines.english: and whatever He does not will shall never be.

lines.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi
lines.english: There is neither might nor power except with Allah.
I entrust you both with Allah.

lines.arabic: وَلا جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ آخِرَ ٱلْعَهْدِ مِنِّي إِلَيْكُمَا
lines.transliteration: wa la ja`alahu allahu akhira al`ahdi minni ilaykuma
lines.english: May Allah never decide this time of my visit to you both to be the last.

lines.arabic: إِنْصَرَفْتُ يَا سَيِّدِي يَا أَمِيرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَمَوْلاَي
lines.transliteration: insaraftu ya sayyidi ya amira almu'minina wa mawlaya
lines.english: May I now leave, O my master, O Commander of the faithful

lines.arabic: وَأَنْتَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ يَا سَيِّدِي
lines.transliteration: wa anta ya aba `abdillahi ya sayyidi
lines.english: and you O Abu-`Abdullah, O my master.
My greetings to you both are as continuous
as night and day.
May my greetings reach you both (all the time)
and my salutation never be screened from reaching you both,
Allah willing.

lines.arabic: وَأَسْأَلُهُ بِحَقِّكُمَا أَنْ يَشَاءَ ذٰلِكَ وَيَفْعَلَ
lines.transliteration: wa as'aluhu bihaqqikuma an yasha'a dhalika wa yaf`ala
lines.english: I also beseech Him in your names to determine and do that,
for He is verily the owner of praise and the owner of glory.
I am now leaving you both, O my masters,
repenting to and praising Allah,
and thanking Him and hoping Him to respond to me;
I neither despair nor lose hope,
and I intend to come back, return, revisit you both,

lines.arabic: غَيْرَ رَاغِبٍ عَنْكُمَا وَلاَ عَنْ زِيَارَتِكُمَا
lines.english: while I have never desired to leave you or to abandon visiting you;

lines.arabic: بَلْ رَاجِعٌ عَائِدٌ إِنْ شَاءَ ٱللَّهُ
lines.english: rather, I shall return and come back, if Allah wills.

lines.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi
lines.english: There is neither might nor power except with Allah.

lines.arabic: يَا سَادَتِي رَغِبْتُ إِلَيْكُمَا وَإِلَىٰ زِيَارَتِكُمَا
lines.transliteration: ya sadati raghibtu ilaykuma wa ila ziyaratikuma
lines.english: O my masters, I do desire for both of you and for visiting you

lines.arabic: بَعْدَ أَنْ زَهِدَ فِيكُمَا وَفِي زِيَارَتِكُمَا أَهْلُ ٱلدُّنْيَا
lines.transliteration: ba`da an zahida fikuma wa fi ziyaratikuma ahlu alddunya
lines.english: although the people of this world (may) abandon you both or abandon visiting you.

lines.arabic: فَلاَ خَيَّبَنِيَ ٱللَّهُ مِمَّا رَجَوْتُ وَمَا أَمَّلْتُ فِي زِيَارَتِكُمَا
lines.transliteration: fala khayyabaniya allahu mimma rajawtu wa ma ammaltu fi ziyaratikuma
lines.english: May Allah never make me fail to attain what I have hoped and desired in visiting you both.
Verily, He is All-nigh, All-responding.

title: Dua Tawassul
description: Seeking Intercession through Ahlulbayt(as). It is reported from the Holy Imams (peace be upon them) that whenever this supplication is recited for any matter, the traces of response are found immediately.

lines.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka wa atawajjahu ilayka
lines.english: O Allah, I beseech You and turn my face toward You
in the name of Your Prophet; the Prophet of Mercy,
Muhammad—may Allah send blessings to him and his Household.
O Abu’l-Qasim!
O Allah’s Messenger!
O Chief of Mercy!
O our master and chief!
We are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Abu’l-Hasan!
O commander of the Believers!
O `Ali, son of Abu-Talib!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
We are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Fatimah, the Luminous Lady!
O daughter of Muhammad!
O delight of the Messenger’s eyes!
O our chief!
We are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Abu-Muhammad!
O Hasan the son of `Ali!
O well-Chosen one!
O son of Allah’s Messenger!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
we are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Abu-`Abdullah!
O Husayn the son of `Ali!
O Martyr!
O son of Allah’s Messenger!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
we are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Abu’l-Hasan!
O `Ali the son of al-Husayn!
O Ornament of the Worshippers!
O son of Allah’s Messenger!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
we are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Abu-Ja`far!
O Muhammad the son of `Ali!
O Cleaver [of knowledge]!
O son of Allah’s Messenger!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
we are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Abu-`Abdullah!
O Ja`far the son of Muhammad!
O Veracious!
O son of Allah’s Messenger!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
we are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Abu’l-Hasan!
O Musa the son of Ja`far!
O Suppressor [of rage]!
O son of Allah’s Messenger!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
we are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Abu’l-Hasan!
O `Ali the son of Musa!
O Amicable!
O son of Allah’s Messenger!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
we are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Abu-Ja`far!
O Muhammad the son of `Ali!
O pious and magnanimous!
O son of Allah’s Messenger!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
we are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Abu’l-Hasan!
O `Ali the son of Muhammad!
O guide and pure!
O son of Allah’s Messenger!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
we are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O Abu-Muhammad!
O Hasan the son of `Ali!
O immaculate resident of `Askar [city]!
O son of Allah’s Messenger!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
we are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
O successor of al-Hasan!
O descendant [of the Infallibles] and Argument [of Allah]!
O Riser, Awaited, and Well-guided!
O son of Allah’s Messenger!
O Allah’s Argument against His creatures!
O our master and chief!
we are turning our faces toward you, seeking your intercession
and your advocacy for us before Allah;
and we are presenting you [as our intermediary] for the settlement of our needs.
O well-esteemed with Allah,
intercede for us before Allah.
You may now beseech Almighty Allah to grant your needs, and they will be settled, if Allah permits. According to another narration, you may say the following words thereafter:
O my chiefs and masters!
I am turning my face toward Allah in the names of you [all],
for you are my leaders and my supporters
on the day of my destitution and neediness
before Allah.
I am seeking your advocacy for me before Allah
and seeking your intercession for me before Allah;
so, (please) intercede for me before Allah
and save me from my sins before Allah,
for you are my means to Allah

lines.arabic: وَبِحُبِّكُمْ وَبِقُرْبِكُمْ ارْجُو نَجَاةً مِنَ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: wa bihubbikum wa biqurbikum arju najatan mina allahi
lines.english: and through my love for you and my seeking nearness to you do I hope for salvation from Allah.
So, be my hope before Allah.
O my masters! O Allah’s intimate servants!
May Allah bless you all

lines.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu a`da'a allahi zalimihim
lines.english: and may Allah curse the enemies of Allah; those who wronged you,
from the past and the last generations.
Respond to us, O Lord of the Worlds!

title: Dua Ahad
description: Recited daily, especially after Fajr prayer. Imam Sadiq (a.s) said: 'One who recites this supplication for forty mornings will be accounted as one of the helpers of the Imam al-Mahdi (a.j). If he dies before the reappearance of the Imam, Allah the Almighty will take him out of his grave to serve the Imam.'

lines.english: O Allah, Lord of the Great Light,
Lord of the Elevated Throne,
Lord of the Swelling Ocean,
Revealer of the Torah, the Gospel, and the Psalms,
Lord of the Shade and the Heat,
Revealer of the Great Quran,

lines.transliteration: wa rabba al-mala'ikati almuqarrabina wal-anbiya'i wal-mursalina
lines.english: and Lord of the Archangels, the Prophets, and the Messengers.
O Allah, I beseech You in Your Noble Face,
and in the Light of Your Radiant Face,
and in Your Ancient Sovereignty.
O Ever-living, O Self-subsisting!

lines.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ بِٱسْمِكَ ٱلَّذِي أَشْرَقَتْ بِهِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتُ وَٱلارَضُونَ
lines.transliteration: as'aluka bismika alladhi ashraqat bihi al-samawatu wal-aradoona
lines.english: I beseech You in Your Name with which the heavens and the earths have been lit up,

lines.arabic: وَبِٱسْمِكَ ٱلَّذِي يَصْلُحُ بِهِ ٱلاوَّلُونَ وَٱلآخِرُونَ
lines.transliteration: wa bismika alladhi yasluhu bihi al-awwaloona wal-akhiroona
lines.english: and in Your Name with which the past and the coming generations have been improved.
O He Who has been living before the existence of any living soul!

lines.transliteration: wa ya hayyan ba`da kulli hayyin
lines.english: O He Who shall be living after the perish of every living soul!

lines.transliteration: wa ya hayyan heena la hayya
lines.english: O He Who was living when there was no living soul!

lines.transliteration: ya muhyiya al-mawta wa mumeeta al-ahya'i
lines.english: O He Who gives life to the dead and brings death to the living!

lines.arabic: يَا حَيُّ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
lines.transliteration: ya hayyu la ilaha illa anta
lines.english: O Ever-living; there is no god save You.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَلِّغْ مَوْلاَنَا ٱلإِمَامَ ٱلْهَادِيَ ٱلْمَهْدِيَّ ٱلْقَائِمَ بِأَمْرِكَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma balligh mawlana al-imama al-hadiya al-mahdiyya al-qa'ima bi-amrika
lines.english: O Allah, (please) convey to our master the Imam—the guide, the rightly guided, and the undertaker of Your command,

lines.arabic: صَلَوَاتُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ آبَائِهِ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ
lines.english: blessings of Allah be upon him and upon his immaculate fathers,
from all the believing men and women
in the east and the west of the earth,

lines.transliteration: sahliha wa jabaliha wa barriha wa bahriha
lines.english: in the plains, the mountains, the lands, and the seas,

lines.arabic: وَعَنِّي وَعَنْ وَالِدَيَّ مِنَ ٱلصَّلَوَاتِ زِنَةَ عَرْشِ ٱللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: wa `anni wa `an walidayya min al-ssalawati zinata `arshi allahi
lines.english: and from me and my parents; convey to him blessings that are as heavy as Allah’s Throne,

lines.transliteration: wa midada kalimatihi wa ma ahsahu `ilmuhu
lines.english: as much as the ink of His Words, as much as His knowledge has counted,
as much as His Book has encompassed.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُجَدِّدُ لَهُ فِي صَبِيحَةِ يَوْمِي هٰذَا
lines.transliteration: allahumma inni ujaddidu lahu fi sabihati yawmi hadha
lines.english: O Allah! I surely renew for him on the morning of this day
and for all the days of my life

lines.arabic: عَهْداً وَعَقْداً وَبَيْعَةً لَهُ فِي عُنُقِي
lines.english: a covenant, a bond, and an oath (of allegiance) that I have taken on my neck;

lines.arabic: لاَ أَحُولُ عَنْهَا وَلاَ أَزُولُ أَبَداً
lines.transliteration: la ahoulu `anha wa la azoulu abadan
lines.english: I shall never deviate from it nor shall I ever leave it.

lines.transliteration: allahumma ij`alni min ansarihi wa a`wanihi
lines.english: O Allah, (please) make me of his supporters, his helpers,

lines.arabic: وَٱلذَّابِّينَ عَنْهُ، وَٱلْمُسَارِعِينَ إِلَيْهِ فِي قَضَاءِ حَوَائِجِهِ
lines.transliteration: wal-dhahhabbina `anhu wal-musari`inna ilayhi fi qada'i hawa'ijihi
lines.english: those who defend him, those who hurry to carry out his needs,
those who obey his commands, those who protect him,

lines.arabic: وَٱلسَّابِقِينَ إِلَىٰ إِرَادَتِهِ، وَٱلْمُسْتَشْهَدِينَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ
lines.transliteration: wal-ssabiqina ila iradatihi wal-mustash-hadina bayna yadayhi
lines.english: those who compete with each other to fulfill his will, and those who will be martyred in his presence.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ حَالَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ ٱلْمَوْتُ
lines.transliteration: allahumma in hala bayni wa baynahu al-mawtu
lines.english: O Allah! If death,

lines.arabic: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلْتَهُ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِكَ حَتْماً مَقْضِيّاً
lines.english: which You have inevitably and certainly decreed for Your servants, intervenes between me and him,
then (please) take me out of my grave wearing my shroud,
unsheathing my sword, brandishing my spear,

lines.arabic: مُلَبِّياً دَعْوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِي فِي ٱلْحَاضِرِ وَٱلْبَادِي
lines.english: and responding to the call of the caller in the cities and the deserts.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَرِنِي ٱلطَّلْعَةَ ٱلرَّشِيدَةَ، وَٱلْغُرَّةَ ٱلْحَمِيدَةَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma arini al-ttal`ata al-rrashidata wal-ghurrata al-hameedata
lines.english: O Allah! (please) show me that rightly-guided appearance and that praised brightness,
and apply kohl to my eyes by letting me have a look at him.
(Please) hasten his relief, make his reappearance easy,

lines.transliteration: wa awsi` manhajahu wasluk bi mahajjatahu
lines.english: widen his course, direct me to follow his path,
carry out his command, and strengthen his back.

lines.arabic: وَٱعْمُرِ ٱللَّهُمَّ بِهِ بِلاَدَكَ، وَأَحْيِ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ
lines.transliteration: wa-`umur allahumma bihi biladaka wa ahyi bihi `ibadaka
lines.english: O Allah! Populate Your lands through him and refresh Your servants through him,
for You have said, and Your Word is the Truth:

lines.arabic: {ظَهَرَ ٱلْفَسَادُ فِي ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِي ٱلنَّاسِ}
lines.transliteration: zahara al-fasadu fil-barri wal-bahri bima kasabat aydi al-nnasi
lines.english: “Corruption has appeared in the land and the sea on account of what the hands of men have wrought;”
so, O Allah! Show us Your friend
and the son of Your Prophet’s daughter,
who bears the same name as Your Messenger,

lines.arabic: حَتَّىٰ لاَ يَظْفَرَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنَ ٱلْبَاطِلِ إِلاَّ مَزَّقَهُ
lines.transliteration: hatta la yazhfara bi-shay'in min al-batili illa mazzaqahu
lines.english: so that he shall tear up any falsehood that he faces
and shall show and confirm the truth.
O Allah! Make him the shelter for Your wronged servants,

lines.arabic: وَنَاصِراً لِمَنْ لاَ يَجِدُ لَهُ نَاصِراً غَيْرَكَ
lines.transliteration: wa nasiran liman la yajidu lahu nasiran ghayraka
lines.english: a supporter for those who cannot find any supporter other than You,

lines.arabic: وَمُنْزِلَ لِمَا عُطِّلَ مِنْ أَحْكَامِ كِتَابِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa mujaddidan lima `uttila min ahkami kitabika
lines.english: a restorer of the laws of Your Book that have been suspended,

lines.arabic: وَوَمُشَيِّداً لِمَا وَرَدَ مِنْ أَعْلاَمِ دِينِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa mushayyidan lima warada min a`lami deenika
lines.english: and a builder of the signs of Your religion

lines.arabic: وَسُنَنِ نَبِيِّكَ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa sunani nabiyyika salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
lines.english: and the traditions of Your Prophet—peace of Allah be upon him and his Household.

lines.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْهُ اللَّهُمَّ مِمَّنْ حَصَّنْتَهُ مِنْ بَأْسِ ٱلْمُعْتَدِينَ
lines.transliteration: waj`alhu allahumma mimman hassantahu min ba'si al-mu`tadeena
lines.english: O Allah! Make him of those whom You protect from the attacks of the aggressors.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَسُرَّ نَبِيَّكَ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ بِرُؤْيَتِهِ
lines.transliteration: allahumma wa surra nabiyyaka muhammadan salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi bi-ru'yatihi
lines.english: O Allah! (please) delight Your Prophet Muhammad, peace of Allah be upon him and his Household, by letting him see him
as well as those who followed him in his call,
and (please) have mercy upon our humiliation after him.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ٱكْشِفْ هٰذِهِ ٱلْغُمَّةَ عَنْ هٰذِهِ ٱلأُمَّةِ بِحُضُورِهِ
lines.transliteration: allahumma ikshif hathihi al-ghumata `an hathahi al-ummati bi-hudhourihi
lines.english: O Allah! (please) relieve this distress from this nation by his presence,
and hasten his reappearance for us.

lines.transliteration: innahum yarawnahu ba`eedan wa narahu qareeban
lines.english: “They surely see it (i.e. the reappearance) far off, but We see it nigh.”
(Do all that) in the name of Your mercy; O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
You may then slap your right thigh with your hand three times and, at each time, say the following:

lines.arabic: اَلْعَجَلَ اَلْعَجَلَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا صَاحِبَ ٱلزَّمَانِ
lines.transliteration: al-`ajala al-`ajala ya moulaya ya sahiba al-zzamani
lines.english: Hurry! Hurry! O my master, O Master of the Time!

title: Dua Kumayl
description: Imam Ali(as) advised Kumayl Ibn Ziyad Nakha'i to recite this "Du'a" on the eve of (i.e. evening preceding) every Friday, or once a month or at least once in every year so that, added Imam Ali(AS), "Allah may protect thee from the evils of the enemies and the plots contrived by impostors. O' Kumayl! in consideration of thy companionship and understanding, I grant thee this honour of entrusting this "Du'a" to thee."
significance: Kumayl Ibn Ziyad Nakha'i was a confidant amongst the companions of Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib (as.) and this sublime Du'a was first heard from the beautiful, though anguished, voice of Imam Ali. According to Allama Majlisi (on whom be Allah's Mercy) Kumayl had attended an assembly in the Mosque at Basra which was addressed by Imam Ali in the course of which the night of the 15th of Shaban was mentioned. Imam Ali said-"Whosoever keeps awake in devoutness on this night and recites the Du'a of Prophet Khizr, undoubtedly that person's supplication will be responded to and granted. When the assembly at the Mosque had dispersed, Kumayl called at the house where Imam Ali was staying, and requested him to acquaint him with Prophet Khizr's "Du'a". Imam Ali asked Kumayl to sit down, record and memorise the "Du'a" which Imam Ali dictated to Kumayl. Imam Ali then advised Kumayl to recite this "Du'a" on the eve of (i.e. evening preceding) every Friday, or once a month or at least once in every year so that, added Imam Ali, "Allah may protect thee from the evils of the enemies and the plots contrived by impostors. O' Kumayl! in consideration of thy companionship and understanding, I grant thee this honour of entrusting this "Du'a" to thee."

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka bi-rahmatika allati wasi`at kulla shay'in
lines.english: O Allah, I ask Thee by Thy mercy which embraces all things

lines.arabic: وَبِقُوَّتِكَ الَّتِي قَهَرْتَ بِهَا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
lines.transliteration: wa bi-quwwatika allati qaharta biha kulla shay'in
lines.english: and by Thy strength by which Thou hast quashed all things
to which all things have submitted
and before which all things are humble

lines.arabic: وَبِجَبَرُوتِكَ الَّتِي غَلَبْتَ بِهَا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
lines.transliteration: wa bi-jabarutika allati ghalabta biha kulla shay'in
lines.english: and by Thy invincibility by which Thou hast overwhelmed all things

lines.arabic: وَبِعِزَّتِكَ الَّتِي لا يَقُومُ لَهَا شَيْءٌ
lines.transliteration: wa bi-`izzatika allati la yaqumu laha shay'un
lines.english: and by Thy might which nothing can resist

lines.transliteration: wa bi-`azamatika allati mala'at kulla shay'in
lines.english: and by Thy greatness which has filled all things
and by Thy authority which towers over all things

lines.arabic: وَبِوَجْهِكَ الْبَاقِي بَعْدَ فَنَاءِ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
lines.transliteration: wa bi-wajhika al-baqi ba`da fana'i kulli shay'in
lines.english: and by Thy face which subsists after the annihilation of all things

lines.arabic: وَبِأَسْمَائِكَ الَّتِي مَلَأَتْ أَرْكَانَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
lines.transliteration: wa bi-asma'ika allati mala'at arkana kulli shay'in
lines.english: and by Thy Names which have filled the foundations of all things

lines.transliteration: wa bi-`ilmika alladhi ahata bi-kulli shay'in
lines.english: and by Thy knowledge which encompasses all things

lines.arabic: وَبِنُورِ وَجْهِكَ الَّذِي أَضَاءَ لَهُ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ
lines.transliteration: wa bi-nuri wajhika alladhi ada'a lahu kullu shay'in
lines.english: and by the light of Thy face through which all things are illumined!
O Light! O All-holy!

lines.arabic: يَا أَوَّلَ الأوَّلِينَ وَيَا آخِرَ الآخِرِينَ
lines.transliteration: ya awwala al-awwalina wa ya akhira al-akhirina
lines.english: O Foremost of the foremost and O Last of the last!

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تَهْتِكُ الْعِصَمَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma ighfir liya al-dhunuba allati tahtiku al-`isama
lines.english: O Allah, forgive me those sins which tear apart safeguards!

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تُنْزِلُ النِّقَمَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma ighfir liya al-dhunuba allati tunzilu al-niqama
lines.english: O Allah, forgive me those sins which draw down adversities!

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تُغَيِّرُ النِّعَمَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma ighfir liya al-dhunuba allati tughayyiru al-ni`ama
lines.english: O Allah, forgive me those sins which alter blessings!

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تَحْبِسُ الدُّعَاءَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma ighfir liya al-dhunuba allati tahbisu al-du`a'a
lines.english: O Allah, forgive me those sins which hold back supplication!

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِي تُنْزِلُ الْبَلاءَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma ighfir liya al-dhunuba allati tunzilu al-bala'a
lines.english: O Allah, forgive me those sins which bring down tribulation!

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي كُلَّ ذَنْبٍ أَذْنَبْتُهُ وَكُلَّ خَطِيئَةٍ أَخْطَأْتُهَا
lines.transliteration: allahumma ighfir liya kulla dhanbin adhabnatuhu wa kulla khati'atin akhta'tuha
lines.english: O Allah, forgive me every sin I have committed and every mistake I have made!
O Allah, I seek nearness to Thee through remembrance of Thee
and I seek intercession from Thee with Thyself

lines.arabic: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِجُودِكَ أَنْ تُدْنِيَنِي مِنْ قُرْبِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa as'aluka bi-judika an tudniyani min qurbika
lines.english: and I ask Thee by Thy generosity to bring me near to Thy proximity
to provide me with gratitude to Thee
and to inspire me with Thy remembrance!

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ سُؤَالَ خَاضِعٍ مُتَذَلِّلٍ خَاشِعٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka su'ala khadi`in mutadhallilin khashi`in
lines.english: O Allah, I ask Thee with the asking of one humble, lowly and fearful
to treat me with clemency and have mercy on me
and to make me satisfied and content with Thy appointment
and [to make me] humble in every state.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَأَسْأَلُكَ سُؤَالَ مَنِ اشْتَدَّتْ فَاقَتُهُ
lines.transliteration: allahumma wa as'aluka su'ala man ishtaddat faqatuhu
lines.english: O Allah, I ask Thee the asking of one whose indigence is extreme
who has stated to Thee his need in difficulties
and whose desire for what is with Thee has become great.
O Allah, Thy authority is tremendous, Thy position is lofty

lines.transliteration: wa khafiya makruka wa zahara amruka
lines.english: Thy plan is hidden, Thy command is manifest

lines.transliteration: wa ghalaba qahruka wa jarat qudratuka
lines.english: Thy sovereign might is overwhelming, Thy power is all-pervading

lines.transliteration: wa la yumkinu al-firaru min hukumatika
lines.english: and escape from Thy government is impossible.
O Allah, I find no forgiver of my sins
no concealer of my ugly acts

lines.arabic: وَلا لِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عَمَلِيَ الْقَبِيحِ بِالْحَسَنِ مُبَدِّلاً غَيْرَكَ
lines.transliteration: wa la li-shay'in min `amaliya al-qabihi bi-l-hasani mubaddilan ghayraka
lines.english: and no transformer of my foul deeds into good ones other than Thee!

lines.arabic: لا إِلَهَ إِلا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ وَبِحَمْدِكَ
lines.transliteration: la ilaha illa anta subhanaka wa bi-hamdika
lines.english: There is no god but Thee! Glory be to Thee and Thine is the praise!
I have wronged my soul and I have been audacious in my ignorance

lines.arabic: وَسَكَنْتُ إِلَى قَدِيمِ ذِكْرِكَ لِي وَمَنِّكَ عَلَيَّ
lines.transliteration: wa sakantu ila qadimi dhikrika li wa mannika `alayya
lines.english: and I have relied upon Thy ancient remembrance of me and Thy grace towards me.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَوْلايَ كَمْ مِنْ قَبِيحٍ سَتَرْتَهُ
lines.transliteration: allahumma mawlaya kam min qabihin satartahu
lines.english: O Allah, my Master, how many ugly things hast Thou concealed!

lines.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ فَادِحٍ مِنَ الْبَلاءِ أَقَلْتَهُ
lines.transliteration: wa kam min fadihin min al-bala'i aqaltahu
lines.english: How many burdensome tribulations hast Thou abolished!
How many stumbles hast Thou prevented!
How many loathsome things hast Thou averted!

lines.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ ثَنَاءٍ جَمِيلٍ لَسْتُ أَهْلاً لَهُ نَشَرْتَهُ
lines.transliteration: wa kam min thana'in jamilin lastu ahlan lahu nashartahu
lines.english: And how many beautiful praises, for which I was unworthy, hast Thou spread abroad!

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَظُمَ بَلائِي وَأَفْرَطَ بِي سُوءُ حَالِي
lines.transliteration: allahumma `azuma bala'i wa afrata bi su'u hali
lines.english: O Allah, my tribulation is tremendous, and my bad state is excessive

lines.arabic: وَقَصُرَتْ بِي أَعْمَالِي وَقَعَدَتْ بِي أَغْلالِي
lines.transliteration: wa qasurat bi `amali wa qa`adat bi aghlali
lines.english: my acts are inadequate, my shackles have fettered me
and my far-fetched hopes have held me back from my own gain
and this world with its delusions has deceived me,
and my soul with its offenses and its delay.

lines.arabic: يَا سَيِّدِي فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِعِزَّتِكَ أَنْ لا يَحْجُبَ عَنْكَ دُعَائِي سُوءُ عَمَلِي وَفِعَالِي
lines.transliteration: ya sayyidi fa-as'aluka bi-`izzatika an la yahjuba `anka du`a'i su'u `amali wa fi`ali
lines.english: O my Master! So I ask Thee by Thy might not to let my evil acts and deeds veil my supplication from Thee

lines.arabic: وَلا تَفْضَحْنِي بِخَفِيِّ مَا اطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ سِرِّي
lines.transliteration: wa la tafdahni bi-khafiyyi ma ittala`ta `alayhi min sirri
lines.english: and not to disgrace me by the hidden things Thou knowest of my secrets

lines.arabic: وَلا تُعَاجِلْنِي بِالْعُقُوبَةِ عَلَى مَا عَمِلْتُهُ فِي خَلَوَاتِي
lines.transliteration: wa la tu`ajilni bi-l-`uqubati `ala ma `amiltuhu fi khalawati
lines.english: and not to hasten me to punishment for what I have done in private:
my evil deeds, my misdeeds,
my continuous negligence, my ignorance
and my many passions and my forgetfulness

lines.arabic: وَكُنِ اللَّهُمَّ بِعِزَّتِكَ لِي فِي كُلِّ الأَحْوَالِ رَؤُوفًا
lines.transliteration: wa kuni allahumma bi-`izzatika li fi kulli al-ahwali ra'ufan
lines.english: And by Thy might, O Allah, be kind to me in all states
and be gracious to me in all affairs.
My God and my Lord!
Have I any but Thee

lines.arabic: أَسْأَلُهُ كَشْفَ ضُرِّي وَالنَّظَرَ فِي أَمْرِي
lines.transliteration: as'aluhu kashfa durri wa-l-nazara fi amri
lines.english: from whom to ask removal of my affliction and regard for my affairs?
My God and my Master! Thou puttest upon me a decree
in which I followed the caprice of my own soul

lines.arabic: وَلم أَحْتَرِسْ فِيهِ مِنْ تَزْيِينِ عَدُوِّي
lines.transliteration: wa lam ahtaris fihi min tazyini `aduwwi
lines.english: and I did not guard myself against the adornment of my enemy.

lines.arabic: فَغَرَّنِي بِمَا أَهْوَى وَأَسْعَدَهُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ الْقَضَاءُ
lines.transliteration: fa-gharrani bi-ma ahwa wa as`adahu `ala dhalika al-qada'u
lines.english: He deluded me through my desire, and destiny favored him in that.

lines.arabic: فَتَجَاوَزْتُ بِمَا جَرَى عَلَيَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ بَعْضَ حُدُودِكَ
lines.transliteration: fa-tajawaztu bi-ma jara `alayya min dhalika ba`da hududika
lines.english: So I transgressed some of the bounds Thou settedst for me
and I disobeyed some of Thy commands.

lines.arabic: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَيَّ فِي جَمِيعِ ذَلِكَ
lines.english: Thine is the argument against me in all of that

lines.arabic: وَلا حُجَّةَ لِي فِيمَا جَرَى عَلَيَّ فِيهِ قَضَاؤُكَ
lines.transliteration: wa la hujjata li fima jara `alayya fihi qada'uka
lines.english: and I have no argument in what Thy destiny put upon me
nor in Thy decree and Thy tribulation which enjoined me.

lines.arabic: وَقَدْ أَتَيْتُكَ يَا إِلَهِي بَعْدَ تَقْصِيرِي وَإِسْرَافِي عَلَى نَفْسِي
lines.transliteration: wa qad ataytuka ya ilahi ba`da taqsiri wa israfi `ala nafsi
lines.english: Now I have come to Thee, my God, after my shortcoming and my immoderation toward myself

lines.arabic: مُعْتَذِرًا نَادِمًا مُنْكَسِرًا مُسْتَقِيلاً مُسْتَغْفِرًا مُنِيبًا مُقِرًّا مُذْعِنًا مُعْتَرِفًا
lines.transliteration: mu`tadhiran nadiman munkasiran mustaqilan mustaghfiran muniban muqirran mudh`inan mu`tarifan
lines.english: proffering my excuse, regretful, broken, apologizing, asking forgiveness, repenting, acknowledging, submissive, confessing.

lines.arabic: لا أَجِدُ مَفَرًّا مِمَّا كَانَ مِنِّي وَلا مَفْزَعًا أَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْهِ فِي أَمْرِي
lines.transliteration: la ajidu mafarran mimma kana minni wa la mafza`an atawajjahu ilayhi fi amri
lines.english: I find no place of escape from what occurred through me, nor any place of refuge to which I may turn in my affairs

lines.arabic: غَيْرَ قَبُولِكَ عُذْرِي وَإِدْخَالِكَ إِيَّايَ فِي سَعَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ
lines.transliteration: ghayra qabulika `udhri wa idkhalika iyyaya fi sa`ati rahmatika
lines.english: other than Thy acceptance of my excuse and Thy leading me into the encompassment of Thy mercy.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَاقْبَلْ عُذْرِي وَارْحَمْ شِدَّةَ ضُرِّي وَفُكَّنِي مِنْ شَدِّ وَثَاقِي
lines.transliteration: allahumma fa-qbal `udhri wa-rham shiddata durri wa fukkani min shaddi wathaqi
lines.english: O Allah, so accept my excuse, have mercy upon the severity of my affliction and release me from the tightness of my fetters!

lines.arabic: يَا رَبِّ ارْحَمْ ضَعْفَ بَدَنِي وَرِقَّةَ جِلْدِي وَدِقَّةَ عَظْمِي
lines.transliteration: ya rabbi irham da`fa badani wa riqqata jildi wa diqqata `azmi
lines.english: My Lord, have mercy upon the weakness of my body, the thinness of my skin and the frailty of my bones!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ بَدَأَ خَلْقِي وَذِكْرِي وَتَرْبِيَتِي وَبِرِّي وَتَغْذِيَتِي
lines.transliteration: ya man bada'a khalqi wa dhikri wa tarbiyati wa birri wa taghdhiyati
lines.english: O Thou who gavest a beginning to my creation, my remembrance, my nurture, my goodness [toward me] and my nourishment

lines.arabic: هَبْنِي لابْتِدَاءِ كَرَمِكَ وَسَالِفِ بِرِّكَ بِي
lines.transliteration: habni l-ibtida'i karamika wa salifi birrika bi
lines.english: bestow upon me for the sake of Thy having given me a beginning with generosity and Thy previous goodness toward me!

lines.arabic: يَا إِلَهِي وَسَيِّدِي وَرَبِّي أَتُرَاكَ مُعَذِّبِي بِنَارِكَ بَعْدَ تَوْحِيدِكَ
lines.transliteration: ya ilahi wa sayyidi wa rabbi aturaka mu`adhdhibi bi-narika ba`da tawhidika
lines.english: O my God, my Master and my Lord! Canst Thou see Thyself punishing me with Thy fire after I have professed Thy unity?

lines.arabic: وَبَعْدَ مَا انْطَوَى عَلَيْهِ قَلْبِي مِنْ مَعْرِفَتِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa ba`da ma antawa `alayhi qalbi min ma`rifatika
lines.english: And after my heart has been layered with knowledge of Thee

lines.transliteration: wa lahija bihi lisani min dhikrika
lines.english: my tongue has unceasingly mentioned Thee
and my inner thoughts have been supple with love of Thee?

lines.arabic: وَبَعْدَ صِدْقِ اعْتِرَافِي وَدُعَائِي خَاضِعًا لِرُبُوبِيَّتِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa ba`da sidqi i`tirafi wa du`a'i khadi`an li-rububiyatika
lines.english: And after the sincerity of my confession and my supplication, humble before Thy lordship?

lines.arabic: هَيْهَاتَ أَنْتَ أَكْرَمُ مِنْ أَنْ تُضَيِّعَ مَنْ رَبَّيْتَهُ
lines.transliteration: hayhata anta akramu min an tudayi`a man rabbaytahu
lines.english: Far be it from Thee! Thou art too generous to dishonor him whom Thou hast nurtured

lines.arabic: أَوْ تُبْعِدَ مَنْ أَدْنَيْتَهُ أَوْ تُشَرِّدَ مَنْ آوَيْتَهُ
lines.transliteration: aw tub`ida man adnaytahu aw tusharrida man awaytahu
lines.english: or to banish him whom Thou hast brought nigh, or to drive away him whom Thou hast given abode!

lines.arabic: فَلَيْتَ شِعْرِي يَا سَيِّدِي وَإِلهِي وَمَوْلايَ
lines.transliteration: fa-layta shi`rī yā sayyidī wa ilāhī wa mawlāy
lines.english: Would that I knew, my Master, my God and my Protector,

lines.arabic: أَتُسَلِّطُ النَّارَ عَلى وُجُوهٍ خَرَّتْ لِعَظَمَتِكَ ساجِدَةً
lines.transliteration: atusallitu al-nara `ala wujuhin kharrat li-`azamatika sajidatan
lines.english: whether Thou wilt give the Fire dominion over faces fallen prostrate before Thy greatness,

lines.arabic: وَعَلى أَلْسُنٍ نَطَقَتْ بِتَوْحِيدِكَ صادِقَةً وَبِشُكْرِكَ مادِحَةً
lines.transliteration: wa `ala alsunin nataqat bi-tawhidika sadiqatan wa bi-shukrika madihatan
lines.english: or over tongues voicing sincerely Thy unity and giving thanks to Thee in praise,
or over hearts acknowledging Thy divinity through verification,

lines.arabic: وَعَلى جَوانِحَ حَوَتْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ بِكَ حَتَّى صارَتْ خاشِعَةً
lines.transliteration: wa `ala jawanika hawat min al-`ilmi bika hatta sarat khashi`atan
lines.english: or over minds encompassing such knowledge of Thee that they have become humble,

lines.arabic: وَعَلى جَوارِحَ سَعَتْ إِلى أَوْطانِ تَعَبُّدِكَ طائِعَةً وَأَشارَتْ بِاسْتِغْفارِكَ مُذْعِنَةً
lines.transliteration: wa `ala jawariha sa`at ila awtani ta`abudika tai`atan wa asharat bi-stighfarika mudh`inatan
lines.english: or over limbs hastening to the places of Thy worship obediently and beckoning Thy forgiveness submissively.

lines.arabic: ما هكَذَا الظَّنُّ بِكَ وَلا أُخْبِرْنا بِفَضْلِكَ عَنْكَ يَا كَرِيمُ
lines.transliteration: ma hakadha al-zannu bika wa la ukhbirna bi-fadhilika `anka ya karimu
lines.english: No such opinion is held of Thee, nor has such been reported - thanks to Thy grace - concerning Thee, O Generous!

lines.arabic: يَا رَبِّ وَأَنْتَ تَعْلَمُ ضَعْفِي عَنْ قَلِيلٍ مِنْ بَلاءِ الدُّنْيا وَعُقُوباتِها
lines.transliteration: ya rabbi wa anta ta`lamu da`fi `an qalilin min bala'i al-dunya wa `uqubatiha
lines.english: My Lord, and Thou knowest my weakness before a little of this world's tribulations and their punishments,

lines.arabic: وَما يَجْرِي فِيها مِنَ الْمَكارِهِ عَلى أَهْلِها
lines.transliteration: wa ma yajri fiha min al-makarihi `ala ahliha
lines.english: and the misfortunes which befall its inhabitants;

lines.arabic: عَلى أَنَّ ذلِكَ بَلاءٌ وَمَكْرُوهٌ قَلِيلٌ مَكْثُهُ يَسِيرٌ بَقاؤُهُ قَصِيرٌ مُدَّتُهُ
lines.transliteration: ala anna dhalika bala'un wa makruhun qalilun makthuhu yasirun baqa'uhu qasirun muddatuhu
lines.english: though those tribulations and misfortunes are but little, their stay is but short, their period is but limited and their duration is but brief.

lines.arabic: فَكَيْفَ احْتِمالِي لِبَلاءِ الآخِرَةِ وَجَلِيلِ وُقُوعِ الْمَكارِهِ فِيها
lines.transliteration: fa-kayfa ihtimali li-bala'i al-ākhirati wa jalili wuqu`i al-makarihi fiha
lines.english: How then can I endure the tribulations of the next world and the great misfortunes that occur within it?

lines.arabic: وَهُوَ بَلاءٌ تَطُولُ مُدَّتُهُ وَيَدُومُ مَقامُهُ
lines.transliteration: wa huwa bala'un tatulu muddatuhu wa yadumu maqamuhu
lines.english: For it is a tribulation whose period is long, whose station is enduring

lines.arabic: وَلا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْ أَهْلِهِ ، لأَنَّهُ لا يَكُونُ إلا عَنْ غَضَبِكَ وَاْنِتقامِكَ وَسَخَطِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa la yukhaffafu `an ahlihi li-annahu la yakunu illa `an ghadhabika wa-ntiqamika wa sakhatika
lines.english: and whose inhabitants are given no respite, since it only derives from Thy wrath, Thy vengeance and Thy anger,

lines.arabic: وَهذا ما لا تَقُومُ لَهُ السَّماواتُ وَالأرْضُ
lines.transliteration: wa hadha ma la taqumu lahu al-samawatu wal-ardh
lines.english: and these cannot be withstood by the heavens and the earth!

lines.arabic: يَا سَيِّدِي فَكَيْفَ بِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ الضَّعِيفُ الذَّلِيلُ الْحَقِيرُ الْمِسْكِينُ الْمُسْتَكِينُ
lines.transliteration: ya sayyidi fa-kayfa bi wa ana `abduka al-da`ifu al-dhalilu al-haqiru al-miskinu al-mustakinu
lines.english: My Master, so what about me?! For I am Thy weak, lowly, base, wretched and miserable slave.

lines.transliteration: ya ilahi wa rabbi wa sayyidi wa mawlaya
lines.english: My God, my Lord, my Master and my Protector!

lines.arabic: لأَيِّ الأُمُورِ إِلَيْكَ أَشْكُو وَلِما مِنْها أَضِجُّ وَأَبْكِي
lines.transliteration: li-ayyi al-umuri ilayka ashku wa lima minha adhijju wa abki
lines.english: For which things should I complain to Thee? And for which of them should I cry and weep?

lines.arabic: لأَلِيمِ الْعَذابِ وَشِدَّتِهِ ، أَمْ لِطُولِ الْبَلاءِ وَمُدَّتِهِ
lines.transliteration: li-alimi al-`adhabi wa shiddatihi am li-tuli al-bala'i wa muddatihi
lines.english: For the pain and severity of chastisement, or for the length and period of tribulation?
So if Thou takest me for the punishments along with Thy enemies,

lines.transliteration: wa jama`ta bayni wa bayna ahli bala'ika
lines.english: and gatherest me together with those who deserve Thy tribulations

lines.transliteration: wa farraqta bayni wa bayna ahibba'ika wa awliya'ika
lines.english: and separatest me from Thy friends and those dear to Thee,

lines.arabic: فَهَبْنِي يَا إِلهِي وَسَيِّدِي وَمَوْلايَ وَرَبِّي صَبَرْتُ عَلى عَذابِكَ
lines.transliteration: fa-habni ya ilahi wa sayyidi wa mawlaya wa rabbi sabartu `ala `adhabika
lines.english: then suppose, my God, my Master, my Protector and my Lord, that I am able to endure Thy chastisement,
how can I endure separation from Thee?

lines.arabic: وَهَبْنِي صَبَرْتُ عَلى حَرِّ نارِكَ فَكَيْفَ أَصْبِرُ عَنِ النَّظَرِ إِلى كَرامَتِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa habni sabartu `ala harri narika fa-kayfa asbiru `an al-nazari ila karamatika
lines.english: And suppose that I am able to endure the heat of Thy fire, how can I endure not gazing upon Thy generosity?

lines.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ أَسْكُنُ فِي النَّارِ وَرَجائِي عَفْوُكَ
lines.transliteration: am kayfa askunu fi al-nari wa raja'i `afwuka
lines.english: Or how can I dwell in the Fire while my hope is for Thy pardon?

lines.arabic: فَبِعِزَّتِكَ يَا سَيِّدِي وَمَوْلايَ أُقْسِمُ صادِقاً
lines.transliteration: fa-bi-`izzatika ya sayyidi wa mawlaya uqsimu sadiqan
lines.english: So by Thy might, my Master and my Protector, I swear sincerely,

lines.arabic: لَئِنْ تَرَكْتَنِي ناطِقاً لأَضِجَّنَّ إِلَيْكَ بَيْنَ أَهْلِها ضَجِيجَ الآمِلِينَ
lines.transliteration: la'in taraktani natiqan la'adjidjanna ilayka bayna ahliha dajija al-amilina
lines.english: that if Thou leavest me with utterance, I will surely cry out to Thee from among the Fire's inhabitants with the crying of the hopeful;
I will surely shout to Thee with the shouting of those crying for help;
I will surely weep before Thee with the weeping of the bereft;

lines.arabic: وَلأُنادِيَنَّكَ أَيْنَ كُنْتَ يَا وَلِيَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.english: and I will surely call out to Thee: Where art Thou, O Protector of the believers,
O Goal of the hopes of those who know Thee,
O Aid of those who seek aid,
O Beloved of the hearts of the sincere,
and O God of all the worlds?

lines.arabic: أَفَتُراكَ سُبْحانَكَ يَا إِلهِي وَبِحَمْدِكَ تَسْمَعُ فِيها صَوْتَ عَبْدٍ مُسْلِمٍ سُجِنَ فِيها بِمُخالَفَتِهِ
lines.transliteration: afataraka subhanaka ya ilahi wa bi-hamdika tasma`u fiha sawta `abdin muslimin sujina fiha bi-mukhalafatihi
lines.english: Canst Thou see Thyself - Glory be to Thee, my God, and Thine is the praised - hearing within the Fire the voice of a slave surrendered to Thee imprisoned there because of his disobedience,

lines.arabic: وَذاقَ طَعْمَ عَذابِها بِمَعْصِيَتِهِ وَحُبِسَ بَيْنَ أَطْباقِها بِجُرْمِهِ وَجَرِيرَتِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa dhaqa ta`ma `adhabiha bi-ma`siyatihi wa hubisa bayna atbaqiha bi-jurmihi wa jariratihi
lines.english: tasting the flavor of its torment because of his rebellion and confined within its levels because of his crime and sin,

lines.arabic: وَهُوَ يَضِجُّ إِلَيْكَ ضَجِيجَ مُؤَمِّلٍ لِرَحْمَتِكَ وَيُنادِيكَ بِلِسانِ أَهْلِ تَوْحِيدِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa huwa yadhijju ilayka dhajija mu'ammilin li-rahmatika wa yunadika bi-lisani ahli tawhidika
lines.english: while he cries out to Thee with the crying of one hopeful for Thy mercy, and calls to Thee with the tongue of those who profess Thy unity
and seeks mediation through Thy Lordship:

lines.arabic: يَا مَوْلَايَ فَكَيْفَ يَبْقَى فِي الْعَذَابِ وَهُوَ يَرْجُو مَا سَلَفَ مِنْ حِلْمِكَ؟
lines.transliteration: ya mawlaya fakayfa yabqa fil-'adhabi wa huwa yarju ma salafa min hilmika
lines.english: O my Protector! Then how could he remain in the chastisement while he has hope of Thy past forbearance?

lines.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ تُؤْلِمُهُ النَّارُ وَهُوَ يَأْمُلُ فَضْلَكَ وَرَحْمَتَكَ؟
lines.transliteration: am kayfa tu'limuhu-nnaru wa huwa ya'mulu fadlaka wa rahmataka
lines.english: Or how could the Fire cause him pain while he expects Thy bounty and mercy?

lines.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ يُحْرِقُهُ لَهِيبُهَا وَأَنْتَ تَسْمَعُ صَوْتَهُ وَتَرَى مَكَانَهُ؟
lines.transliteration: am kayfa yuhriquhu lahibuha wa anta tasma'u sawtahu wa tara makanahu
lines.english: Or how could its flames burn him while Thou hearest his voice and seest his place?

lines.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ يَشْتَمِلُ عَلَيْهِ زَفِيرُهَا وَأَنْتَ تَعْلَمُ ضَعْفَهُ؟
lines.transliteration: am kayfa yashtamilu 'alayhi zafiruha wa anta ta'lamu da'fahu
lines.english: Or how could its sighing encompass him while Thou knowest his weakness?

lines.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ يَتَقَلْقَلُ بَيْنَ أَطْبَاقِهَا وَأَنْتَ تَعْلَمُ صِدْقَهُ؟
lines.transliteration: am kayfa yataqalqalu bayna atbaqiha wa anta ta'lamu sidqahu
lines.english: Or how could he be convulsed between its levels while Thou knowest his truthfulness?

lines.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ تَزْجُرُهُ زَبَانِيَتُهَا وَهُوَ يُنَادِيكَ: يَا رَبَّهْ؟
lines.transliteration: am kayfa tazjuruhu zabani-yatuha wa huwa yunadika ya rabbah
lines.english: Or how could its keepers browbeat him while he calls out to Thee: 'O Lord!'?

lines.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ يَرْجُو فَضْلَكَ فِي عِتْقِهِ مِنْهَا فَتَتْرُكُهُ فِيهَا؟
lines.transliteration: am kayfa yarju fadlaka fi 'itqihi minha fatatrukuhu fiha
lines.english: Or how could he have hope of Thy bounty in freeing him from it while Thou abandonest him within it?

lines.arabic: هَيْهَاتَ! مَا ذَلِكَ الظَّنُّ بِكَ، وَلَا الْمَعْرُوفُ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
lines.transliteration: hayhata ma dhalika-zzannu bika wala-l-ma'rufu min fadlika
lines.english: Far be it from Thee! That is not what is expected from Thee, nor what is well-known of Thy bounty!

lines.arabic: وَلَا مُشْبِهٌ لِمَا عَامَلْتَ بِهِ الْمُوَحِّدِينَ مِنْ بِرِّكَ وَإِحْسَانِكَ!
lines.transliteration: wala mushbihun lima 'amalta bihil-muwahhidina min birrika wa ihsanika
lines.english: Nor does it resemble the goodness and kindness Thou hast shown to those who profess Thy unity.

lines.arabic: فَبِالْيَقِينِ أَقْطَعُ، لَوْلَا مَا حَكَمْتَ بِهِ مِنْ تَعْذِيبِ جَاحِدِيكَ
lines.transliteration: fabil-yaqini aqta'u lawla ma hakamta bihi min ta'dhibi jahidika
lines.english: I declare with certainty that were it not for what Thou hast decreed concerning the chastisement of Thy deniers

lines.transliteration: wa qadayta bihi min ikhladi mu'anidika
lines.english: and what Thou hast decided concerning the everlasting abode of Thy adversaries
Thou wouldst have made the Fire, all of it, coolness and safety

lines.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لِأَحَدٍ فِيهَا مَقَرّاً وَلَا مُقَاماً
lines.transliteration: wa ma kana li-ahadin fiha maqarran wala muqaman
lines.english: and no one would have had a place within it nor an abode.
But Thou, holy are Thy Names,
hast sworn that Thou wilt fill it with the disbelievers
both Jinn and men together
and that Thou wilt place the adversaries therein forever.

lines.arabic: وَأَنْتَ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ قُلْتَ مُبْتَدِئاً، وَتَطَوَّلْتَ بِالْإِنْعَامِ مُتَكَرِّماً:
lines.transliteration: wa anta jalla thana'uka qulta mubtadi'an wa tatawwalta bil-in`ami mutakarriman
lines.english: And Thou, majestic is Thy praise, didst say at the beginning, and wert gracious through kindness as a favor:

lines.arabic: «أَفَمَنْ كَانَ مُؤْمِناً كَمَنْ كَانَ فَاسِقاً؟ لَا يَسْتَوُونَ!»
lines.transliteration: afaman kana mu'minan kaman kana fasiqan la yasta-wuna
lines.english: 'Is he who was a believer like him who was ungodly? They are not equal!'

lines.arabic: إِلَهِي وَسَيِّدِي، فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِالْقُدْرَةِ الَّتِي قَدَّرْتَهَا
lines.transliteration: ilahi wa sayyidi fa-as'aluka bil-qudrati allati qaddartaha
lines.english: My God and my Protector! I ask Thee by the power which Thou hast determined

lines.transliteration: wa bil-qadiyati allati hatamtaha wa hakamtaha
lines.english: and by the decree which Thou hast finalized and ordained
and by which Thou hast overcome him upon whom Thou hast imposed it:

lines.arabic: أَنْ تَهَبَ لِي فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَفِي هَذِهِ السَّاعَةِ
lines.transliteration: an tahaba li fi hadhihil-laylati wa fi hadhihis-sa'ati
lines.english: That Thou forgivest me in this night and at this hour

lines.arabic: كُلَّ جُرْمٍ أَجْرَمْتُهُ، وَكُلَّ ذَنْبٍ أَذْنَبْتُهُ
lines.transliteration: kulla jurmin ajramtuhu wa kulla dhanbin adhnabtuhu
lines.english: every offence I have committed, and every sin I have performed,

lines.arabic: وَكُلَّ قَبِيحٍ أَسْرَرْتُهُ، وَكُلَّ جَهْلٍ عَمِلْتُهُ
lines.transliteration: wa kulla qabihin asrartuhu wa kulla jahlin 'amiltuhu
lines.english: and every ugly thing I have concealed, and every act of ignorance I have done,

lines.arabic: كَتَمْتُهُ أَوْ أَعْلَنْتُهُ، أَخْفَيْتُهُ أَوْ أَظْهَرْتُهُ
lines.transliteration: katamtuhu aw a'lantuhu akhfaytuhu aw azhartuhu
lines.english: whether I have hidden or announced it, or concealed it or manifested it,

lines.arabic: وَكُلَّ سَيِّئَةٍ أَمَرْتَ بِإِثْبَاتِهَا الْكِرَامَ الْكَاتِبِينَ
lines.english: and every evil deed which Thou hast commanded the Noble Scribes to write down,

lines.arabic: الَّذِينَ وَكَّلْتَهُمْ بِحِفْظِ مَا يَكُونُ مِنِّي
lines.transliteration: al-ladhina wakkaltahum bi-hifzi ma yakunu minni
lines.english: those whom Thou hast appointed to keep watch over what proceeds from me
and whom Thou hast made witnesses over me along with my bodily parts,

lines.arabic: وَكُنْتَ أَنْتَ الرَّقِيبَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ
lines.english: and Thou wert Thyself the Watcher over me from behind them,
and the Witness of what is hidden from them.

lines.transliteration: wa bi-rahmatika akhfaytuhu wa bi-fadlika satartuhu
lines.english: And through Thy mercy Thou concealedst it, and through Thy bounty Thou veiledst it.

lines.arabic: وَأَنْ تُوَفِّرَ حَظِّي مِنْ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ أَنْزَلْتَهُ
lines.transliteration: wa an tu-waffira hazzi min kulli khayrin anzaltahu
lines.english: And that Thou bestowest upon me an abundant share of every good Thou sendest down,

lines.arabic: أَوْ إِحْسَانٍ فَضَّلْتَهُ، أَوْ بِرٍّ نَشَرْتَهُ
lines.transliteration: aw ihsanin faddaltahu aw birrin nashartahu
lines.english: or kindness Thou conferrest, or goodness Thou spreadest,

lines.arabic: أَوْ رِزْقٍ بَسَطْتَهُ، أَوْ ذَنْبٍ تَغْفِرُهُ، أَوْ خَطَأٍ تَسْتُرُهُ
lines.transliteration: aw rizqin basattahu aw dhanbin taghfiruhu aw khata'in tasturuhu
lines.english: or provision Thou extendest, or sin Thou forgivest, or error Thou coverest.

lines.arabic: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ
lines.transliteration: ya rabbi ya rabbi ya rabbi
lines.english: O Lord! O Lord! O Lord!

lines.arabic: يَا إِلَهِي وَسَيِّدِي وَمَوْلَايَ وَمَالِكَ رِقِّي
lines.transliteration: ya ilahi wa sayyidi wa mawlaya wa malika riqqi
lines.english: My God, my Protector, my Master, and the Owner of my freedom!
O He who holds my forelock in His hand!
O He who knows my affliction and my misery!
O He who is aware of my poverty and my indigence!

lines.arabic: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ
lines.transliteration: ya rabbi ya rabbi ya rabbi
lines.english: O Lord! O Lord! O Lord!
I ask Thee by Thy truth and Thy holiness
and the greatest of Thy attributes and names,

lines.arabic: أَنْ تَجْعَلَ أَوْقَاتِي فِي اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ بِذِكْرِكَ مَعْمُورَةً
lines.transliteration: an taj'ala awqati fil-layli wa-nnahari bi-dhikrika ma'muratan
lines.english: That Thou makest my times in the night and the day inhabited by Thy remembrance,

lines.transliteration: wa bi-khid-matika mawsulatan wa a'mali 'indaka maqbulatan
lines.english: and joined to Thy service, and my works acceptable to Thee,

lines.arabic: حَتَّى تَكُونَ أَعْمَالِي وَأَوْرَادِي كُلُّهَا وِرْداً وَاحِداً
lines.transliteration: hatta takuna a'mali wa awradi kulluha wirdan wahidan
lines.english: So that my works and my litanies may all be a single litany
and my state in Thy service may be everlasting.

lines.arabic: يَا سَيِّدِي، يَا مَنْ عَلَيْهِ مُعَوَّلِي
lines.english: O my Protector! O He upon whom I rely!
O He to whom I complain of my states!

lines.arabic: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ
lines.transliteration: ya rabbi ya rabbi ya rabbi
lines.english: O Lord! O Lord! O Lord!
Strengthen my bodily parts for Thy service,
and fortify my determination,
and bestow upon me earnestness in fearing Thee
and continuity in being joined to Thy service,

lines.arabic: حَتَّى أَسْرَحَ إِلَيْكَ فِي مَيَادِينِ السَّابِقِينَ
lines.english: So that I may move easily toward Thee in the fields of the foremost
and hurry to Thee among those who hasten
and yearn for Thy proximity among the yearning
and draw near to Thee with the nearness of the sincere,
and fear Thee with the fear of those who have certainty,
and gather in Thy neighborhood with the believers.

lines.transliteration: allahumma wa man aradani bi-su'in fa-arid-hu
lines.english: O Allah! And whoever desires evil for me, desire it for him!
And whoever deceives me, deceive him!

lines.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ أَحْسَنِ عَبِيدِكَ نَصِيباً عِنْدَكَ
lines.english: And make me one of the best of Thy slaves in share before Thee,

lines.arabic: وَأَقْرَبِهِمْ مَنْزِلَةً مِنْكَ، وَأَخَصِّهِمْ زُلْفَةً لَدَيْكَ
lines.transliteration: wa aqrabihim manzilatan minka wa akhas-sihim zulfatan ladayka
lines.english: and the nearest of them in station to Thee, and the most elected of them in proximity to Thee.

lines.arabic: فَإِنَّهُ لَا يُنَالُ ذَلِكَ إِلَّا بِفَضْلِكَ
lines.transliteration: fa'innahu la yunalu dhalika illa bi-fadlika
lines.english: For that cannot be attained except through Thy bounty.

lines.arabic: وَجُدْ لِي بِجُودِكَ، وَاعْطِفْ عَلَيَّ بِمَجْدِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa jud li bi-judika wa'tif 'alayya bi-majdika
lines.english: And grant generously to me through Thy generosity, and incline toward me through Thy splendor
and protect me with Thy mercy!
And make my tongue repeat Thy remembrance
and my heart enthralled by Thy love!
And be gracious to me by Thy beauty of response,
and nullify my slip and forgive my lapse!
For Thou hast decreed Thy worship for Thy slaves

lines.transliteration: wa amartahum bi-du'a'ika wa daminta lahumul-ijabata
lines.english: and commanded them to supplicate Thee, and assured them of a response.
So toward Thee, O Lord, I have turned my face,

lines.transliteration: wa ilayka ya rabbi madadtu yadi
lines.english: and toward Thee, O Lord, I have extended my hand.

lines.arabic: فَبِعِزَّتِكَ اسْتَجِبْ لِي دُعَائِي، وَبَلِّغْنِي مُنَايَ
lines.transliteration: fabi-`izzatika-stajib li du'ali wa ballighni munaya
lines.english: So by Thy might, respond to my supplication and let me attain my hopes!

lines.transliteration: wa la taqta' min fadlika raja'i
lines.english: Do not sever my hope from Thy bounty

lines.arabic: وَاكْفِنِي شَرَّ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ مِنْ أَعْدَائِي
lines.english: and protect me from the evil of my enemies among jinn and men!

lines.arabic: يَا سَرِيعَ الرِّضَا، اغْفِرْ لِمَنْ لَا يَمْلِكُ إِلَّا الدُّعَاءَ
lines.transliteration: ya sari'ar-rida-ghfir liman la yamliku illa-ddu'a
lines.english: O He whose satisfaction is quickly reached! Forgive him who owns nothing but supplication,
for Thou doest what Thou wilt.

lines.arabic: يَا مَنِ اسْمُهُ دَوَاءٌ، وَذِكْرُهُ شِفَاءٌ، وَطَاعَتُهُ غِنًى
lines.transliteration: ya man ismuhu dawa'un wa dhikruhu shifa'un wa ta'atuhu ghinan
lines.english: O He whose Name is a remedy, and whose remembrance is a cure, and whose obedience is wealth!

lines.arabic: ارْحَمْ مَنْ رَأْسُ مَالِهِ الرَّجَاءُ، وَسِلَاحُهُ الْبُكَاءُ
lines.transliteration: irham man ra'su malihir-raja'u wa silahuhul-buka'
lines.english: Have mercy upon him whose capital is hope and whose weapon is tears!
