lines.arabic: يَا سَابِغَ النِّعَمِ، يَا دَافِعَ النِّقَمِ
lines.english: O Abundant Bestower of blessings! O Repeller of adversities!

lines.arabic: يَا نُورَ الْمُسْتَوْحِشِينَ فِي الظُّلَمِ، يَا عَالِماً لَا يُعَلَّمُ
lines.transliteration: ya nural-mustaw-hishina fizzulami ya 'aliman la yu'allam
lines.english: O Light of those who are lonely in the darkness! O Knower who was never taught!
Bless Muhammad and the progeny of Muhammad,
and do with me what is worthy of Thee!

lines.arabic: وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ وَالْأَئِمَّةِ الْمَيَامِينَ مِنْ آلِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa sallallahu 'ala rasulihi wal-a'immatil-mayamina min alihi
lines.english: And Allah bless His Messenger and the holy Imams of his household
and give them abundant peace!

title: Dua al-Sabah
description: The Morning Supplication (Dua al-Sabah) of Imam Ali (as), usually recited after the Fajr prayer.
significance: Amirul Mo'mineen Ali bin Abi Talib (a.s) used to recite this supplication after the Morning (Fajr) Prayer. It is highly recommended for obtaining sustenance and protection throughout the day.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ دَلَعَ لِسَانَ اَلصَّبَاحِ بِنُطْقِ تَبَلُّجِهِ
lines.transliteration: allahumma ya man dala'a lisan as-sabah bi-nutqi taballujih
lines.english: O Allah, O He who extended the tongue of the morning by the speech of its dawning,

lines.arabic: وَسَرَّحَ قِطَعَ اَللَّيْلِ اَلْمُظْلِمِ بِغَيَاهِبِ تَلَجْلُجِهِ
lines.english: and dispatched the fragments of the dark night with the gloom of its stammering,

lines.arabic: وَأَتْقَنَ صُنْعَ اَلْفَلَكِ اَلدَّوَّارِ فِي مَقَادِيرِ تَبَرُّجِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa atqana sun'al-falaki-d-dawwari fi maqadiri tabarrujih
lines.english: and made firm the handiwork of the rotating sphere in the measures of its display,
and beamed forth the light of the sun with the glow of its heating!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ دَلَّ عَلَى ذَاتِهِ بِذَاتِهِ
lines.english: O He who demonstrates His essence by His essence,
transcends association with His creatures
and is exalted beyond conformity with His qualities!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ قَرُبَ مِنْ خَطَرَاتِ اَلظُّنُونِ
lines.english: O He who is near to the passing thoughts of opinions
but far from the regards of eyes,

lines.arabic: وَعَلِمَ بِمَا كَانَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَكُونَ
lines.transliteration: wa 'alima bima kana qabla an yakun
lines.english: and knows what will be before it comes to be!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ أَرْقَدَنِي فِي مِهَادِ أَمْنِهِ وَأَمَانِهِ
lines.transliteration: Ya man arqadani fi mihadi amnihi wa amanih
lines.english: O He who has put me to sleep in the cradle of His security and His safety,

lines.arabic: وَأَيْقَظَنِي إِلَى مَا مَنَحَنِي بِهِ مِنْ مِنَنِهِ وَإِحْسَانِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa ayqazani ila ma manahani bihi min minanihi wa ihsanih
lines.english: awakened me to the favors and kindness which He has bestowed upon me,

lines.arabic: وَكَفَّ أَكُفَّ اَلسُّوءِ عَنِّي بِيَدِهِ وَسُلْطَانِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa kaffa akuffas-su'i 'anni biyadihi wa sultanih
lines.english: and held back the hands of evil from me with His power and His authority!

lines.arabic: صَلِّ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى اَلْدَّليلِ إِلَيْكَ فِي اَللَّيْلِ اَلْأَلْيَلِ
lines.english: Bless, O Allah, the guide to Thee in the darkest night,

lines.arabic: وَاَلْمَاسِكِ مِنْ أَسْبَابِكَ بَحَبْلِ اَلشَّرَفِ اَلْأَطْوَلِ
lines.english: him who, of Thy ropes, clings to the cord of the longest nobility,

lines.arabic: وَاَلنَّاصِعِ اَلْحَسَبِ فِي ذِرْوَةِ اَلْكَاهِلِ اَلْأَعْبَلِ
lines.english: him whose glory is evident on the summit of the stoutest shoulders,

lines.arabic: وَاَلثَّابِتِ اَلْقَدَمِ عَلَى زَحَالِيقِهَا فِي اَلزَّمَنِ اَلْأَوَّلِ
lines.english: and whose foot is fixed in spite of slippery places in ancient time;
and (bless) his household, the chosen, the good, the pious!

lines.arabic: وِاَفْتَحِ اللَّهُمَّ لَنَا مَصَارِيعَ اَلصَّبَاحِ بِمَفَاتِيحِ اَلرَّحْمَةِ وَاَلْفَلاحِ
lines.english: Open for us, O Allah, the leaves of the morning with the keys of mercy and prosperity!

lines.arabic: وَأَلْبِسْنِي اللَّهُمَّ مِنْ أَفْضَلِ خِلَعِ اَلْهِدَايَةِ وَاَلصَّلاحِ
lines.transliteration: wa albisni-llahumma min afdali khila'i-l-hidayati wa-s-salah
lines.english: Clothe me, O Allah, with the most excellent robes of guidance and righteousness!

lines.arabic: وَأَغْرِسِ اللَّهُمَّ بِعَظَمَتِكَ فِي شِرْبِ جَنَانِي يَنَابِيعَ اَلْخُشُوعِ
lines.transliteration: wa aghrisi-llahumma bi-'azamatika fi shirbi janani yanabi'a-l-khushu'
lines.english: Plant, O Allah, through Thy greatness, the springs of humility in the watering place of my heart!

lines.arabic: وَأَجْرِ اللَّهُمَّ لِهَيْبَتِكَ مِنْ أَمَاقِي زَفَرَاتِ اَلْدُّمُوعِ
lines.transliteration: wa ajri-llahumma li-haybatika min amaqi zafara-tid-dumu'
lines.english: Let flow, O Allah, out of Thy awe, tears of moaning from the corners of my eyes!

lines.arabic: وَأَدِّبِ اللَّهُمَّ نَزَقَ اَلْخُرْقِ مِنِّي بِأَزِمَّةِ اَلْقُنُوعِ
lines.english: And chastise, O Allah, the recklessness of my clumsiness with the reins of contentment!

lines.arabic: إِلَهِي إِنْ لَمْ تَبْتَدِئْنِي اَلرَّحْمَةُ مِنْكَ بِحُسْنِ اَلتَّوْفِيقِ فَمَنِ اَلسَّالِكُ بِي إِلَيْكَ فِي وَاضِحِ اَلطَّرِيقِ
lines.transliteration: Ilahi il-lam tabtadi'ni-r-rahmatu minka bi-husni-t-tawfiqi famani-s-saliku bi ilayka fi wadihi-t-tariq
lines.english: My God, if mercy from Thee does not begin with fair success, then who can direct me to Thee in the evident path?

lines.arabic: وَإِنْ أَسْلَمَتْنِي أَنَاتُكَ لِقَائِدِ اَلْأَمَلِ وَاَلْمُنَى فَمَنِ اَلْمُقِيلُ عَثَرَاتِي مِنْ كَبَوَاتِ اَلْهَوَى
lines.transliteration: wa in aslamatni anatuka li-qa'idi-l-amali wa-l-muna famani-l-muqilu 'atharati min kabawati-l-hawa
lines.english: If Thy deliberateness surrenders me to the conductor of hope and desires, then who will release me from the slips of passion?

lines.arabic: وَإِنْ خَذَلَنِي نَصْرُكَ عِنْدَ مُحَارَبَةِ اَلنَّفْسِ وَاَلشَّيْطَانِ فَقَدْ وَكَلَنِي خِذْلانُكَ إِلَى حَيْثُ اَلنَّصَبُ وَاَلْحِرْمَانُ
lines.transliteration: wa in khadhalani nasruka 'inda muharabati-n-nafsi wa-sh-shaytani faqad wakalani khidhlānuka ila haythu-n-nasabu wa-l-hirman
lines.english: If Thy succor abandons me in the battle with the soul and the Satan, then Thy abandonment will have entrusted me to misery and deprivation!

lines.arabic: إِلَهِي أَتَرَانِي مَا أَتَيْتُكَ إِلاَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ اَلْآمالِ
lines.transliteration: Ilahi atarani ma ataytuka illa min haythu-l-amal
lines.english: My God, dost Thou see that I have only come to Thee from the direction of hopes,

lines.arabic: أَمْ عَلِقْتُ بِأَطْرَافِ حِبَالِكَ إِلاَّ حِينَ بَاعَدَتْنِي ذُنُوبِي عَنْ دَارِ اَلْوِصَالِ
lines.transliteration: am 'aliqtu bi-atrafi hibalika illa hina ba'adatni dhunubi 'an dari-l-wisal
lines.english: or clung to the ends of Thy cords only when my sins have driven me from the abode of union?

lines.arabic: فَبِئْسَ اَلْمَطِيَّةُ اَلَّتِي اِمْتَطَتْ نَفْسِي مِنْ هَوَاهَا
lines.english: So what an evil mount my soul has mounted - its passion!

lines.arabic: فَوَاهاً لَهَا لِمَا سَوَّلَتْ لَهَا ظُنُونُهَا وَمُنَاهَا
lines.transliteration: fawahan laha lima sawwalat laha dhununuhu wa munaha
lines.english: Woe to it for what its fancies and its desires have conjectured for it!

lines.arabic: وَتَبّاً لَهَا لِجُرْأَتِهَا عَلَى سَيِّدِهَا وَمَوْلاهَا
lines.transliteration: wa tabban laha li-jur'atiha 'ala sayyidiha wa mawlaha
lines.english: And destruction to it for its audacity toward its Master and its Protector!

lines.arabic: إِلَهِي قَرَعْتُ بَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ بِيَدِ رَجَائِي
lines.transliteration: Ilahi qara'tu baba rahmatika biyadi raja'i
lines.english: My God, I have knocked at the door of Thy mercy with the hand of my hope,

lines.arabic: وَهَرَبْتُ إِلَيْكَ لاجِئاً مِنْ فَرْطِ أَهْوَائِي
lines.transliteration: wa harabtu ilayka lājian min farti ahwa'i
lines.english: fled unto Thee seeking refuge from my excessive passion,
and fixed the fingers of my love to the ends of Thy cords.

lines.arabic: فَاصْفَحِ اللَّهُمَّ عَمَّا كُنْتُ أَجْرَمْتُهُ مِنْ زَلَلِي وَخَطَايَايَ
lines.transliteration: fasfahi-llahumma 'amma kuntu ajramtuhu min zalali wa khatayay
lines.english: So forgive, O Allah, the slips and errors I have committed
and release me from the fall of my robe!

lines.transliteration: fa-innaka sayyidi wa mawlaya wa mu'tamadi wa raja'i
lines.english: For Thou art my Master, my Protector, my Support and my Hope

lines.arabic: وَأَنْتَ غَايَةُ مَطْلُوبِي وَمُنَايَ فِي مُنْقَلَبِي وَمَثْوَايَ
lines.transliteration: wa anta ghāyatu matlubi wa munaya fi munqalabi wa mathway
lines.english: and Thou art the object of my search and my desire in my ultimate destination and my abode!

lines.arabic: إِلَهِي كَيْفَ تَطْرُدُ مِسْكِيناً اِلْتَجَأَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ اَلذُّنُوبِ هَارِباً
lines.transliteration: Ilahi kayfa tatrudu miskinan-iltaja'a ilayka minadh-dhunubi hariba
lines.english: My God, how couldst Thou drive away a wretched person who seeks refuge in Thee from sins, fleeing?

lines.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ تُخَيِّبُ مُسْتَرْشِداً قَصَدَ إِلَى جَنَابِكَ صَاقِباً
lines.transliteration: am kayfa tukhayyibu mustarshidan qasada ila janabika saqiba
lines.english: Or how couldst Thou disappoint one seeking guidance who repairs to Thy threshold, running?

lines.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ تَرُدُّ ظَمْآناً وَرَدَ إِلَى حِيَاضِكَ شَارِباً
lines.transliteration: am kayfa taruddu dham'anan warada ila hiyadika shariba
lines.english: Or how couldst Thou reject a thirsty person who comes to Thy pools to drink?

lines.arabic: كَلاَّ وَحِيَاضُكَ مُتْرَعَةٌ فِي ضَنْكِ اَلْمُحُولِ
lines.transliteration: Kalla wa hiyaduka mutra'atun fi danki-l-muhul
lines.english: Nay! Thy pools are full in the hardship of drought,
Thy door is open for seeking and penetration,
and Thou art the goal of requests and the end of hopes!

lines.arabic: إِلَهِي هَذِهِ أَزِمَّةُ نَفْسِي عَقَلْتُهَا بِعِقَالِ مَشِيئَتِكَ
lines.transliteration: Ilahi hadhihi azimmatu nafsi 'aqaltuha bi-'iqali mashi'atik
lines.english: My God, these are the reins of my soul; I have bound them with the tie of Thy will.

lines.arabic: وَهَذِهِ أَعْبَاءُ ذُنُوبِي دَرَأْتُهَا بِي عَفْوِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa hadhihi a'ba'u dhunubi dara'tuha bi-'afwika wa rahmatik
lines.english: These are the burdens of my sins; I have averted them with Thy pardon and Thy mercy.

lines.arabic: وَهَذِهِ أَهْوَائِيَ اَلْمُضِلَّةُ وَكَلْتُهَا إِلَى جَنَابِ لُطْفِكَ وَرَأْفَتِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa hadhihi ahwa'iya-l-mudillatu wakaltuha ila janabi lutfika wa ra'fatik
lines.english: And these are my misleading passions; I have entrusted them to the threshold of Thy gentleness and Thy compassion.

lines.arabic: فَاجْعَلِ اللَّهُمَّ صَبَاحِي هَذَا نَازِلاً عَلَيَّ بِضِيَاءِ اَلْهُدَى
lines.english: Therefore make this morning of mine, O Allah, descend upon me with the light of guidance
and safety in religion and the world!
My evening a protector against the deceptions of enemies
and a guard against the destructive inclinations of passion!
Verily Thou art able over what Thou wilt!

lines.arabic: تُؤْتِي اَلْمُلْكَ مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَتَنْزِعُ اَلْمُلْكَ مِمَّنْ تَشَاءُ
lines.transliteration: tu'ti-l-mulka man tasha'u wa tanzi'u-l-mulka mimman tasha'
lines.english: Thou givest the kingdom to whom Thou wilt, and Thou seizest the kingdom from whom Thou wilt;

lines.arabic: وَتُعِزُّ مَنْ تَشَاءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَنْ تَشَاءُ
lines.transliteration: wa tu'izzu man tasha'u wa tudhillu man tasha'
lines.english: Thou exaltest whom Thou wilt, and Thou abasest whom Thou wilt.

lines.arabic: بِيَدِكَ اَلْخَيْرُ إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
lines.english: In Thy hand is the good; Thou art powerful over all things!

lines.arabic: تُولِجُ اَللَّيْلَ فِي اَلنَّهَارِ وَتُولِجُ اَلنَّهَارَ فِي اَللَّيْلِ
lines.english: Thou makest the night to enter into the day, and Thou makest the day to enter into the night;

lines.arabic: وَتُخْرِجُ اَلْحَيَّ مِنَ اَلْمَيِّتِ وَتُخْرِجُ اَلْمَيِّتَ مِنَ اَلْحَيِّ
lines.transliteration: wa tukhriju-l-hayya minal-mayyiti wa tukhriju-l-mayyita minal-hayy
lines.english: Thou bringest forth the living from the dead, and Thou bringest forth the dead from the living;

lines.transliteration: wa tarzuqu man tasha'u bi-ghayri hisab
lines.english: and Thou providest for whom Thou wilt without reckoning.

lines.arabic: لا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ
lines.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka-llahumma wa bi-hamdik
lines.english: There is no god but Thou; Glory be to Thee, O Allah, and Thine is the praise!

lines.arabic: مَنْ ذَا يَعْرِفُ قَدْرَكَ فَلا يَخَافُكَ
lines.transliteration: man dha ya'rifu qadraka fala yakhafuk
lines.english: Who knows Thy measure and then does not fear Thee?

lines.arabic: وَمَنْ ذَا يَعْلَمُ مَا أَنْتَ فَلا يَهَابُكَ
lines.transliteration: wa man dha ya'lamu ma anta fala yahabuk
lines.english: And who knows what Thou art and then does not stand in awe of Thee?
Through Thy power Thou hast joined the separated,
through Thy gentleness Thou hast cleaved the morning,
and through Thy generosity Thou hast illumined the dark shrouds of the night.

lines.arabic: وَأَنْهَرْتَ اَلْمِيَاهَ مِنَ اَلصُّمِّ اَلصَّيَاخِيدِ عُذْباً وَأُجَاجاً
lines.english: Thou hast made waters - sweet and salt - to flow forth from hard stones,
sent down from the rain clouds water in torrents,

lines.arabic: وَجَعَلْتَ اَلشَّمْسَ وَاَلْقَمَرَ لِلْبَرِيَّةِ سِرَاجاً وَهَّاجاً
lines.transliteration: wa ja'alta-sh-shamsa wal-qamara lil-bariyyati sirajan wahhaja
lines.english: and appointed the sun and moon a blazing lamp for the creatures,

lines.arabic: مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ تُمَارِسَ فِيمَا اِبْتَدَأْتَ بِهِ لُغُوباً وَلا عِلاجاً
lines.transliteration: min ghayri an tumarisa fima ibtada'ta bihi lughuban wa la 'ilaja
lines.english: without Thy feeling any weariness or needing any device in what Thou didst begin.
So, O He who is unique in might and subsistence
and overwhelms His servants with death and annihilation!
Bless Muhammad and his household, the godfearing,
answer my call, hear my supplication,

lines.transliteration: wa haqqiq bi-fadlika amali wa raja'i
lines.english: and accomplish through Thy bounty my hope and my desire.

lines.arabic: يَا خَيْرَ مَنْ دُعِيَ لِكَشْفِ اَلضُّرِّ
lines.english: O the Best of those who are called to remove adversity
and the object of hope in every difficulty and ease!

lines.arabic: بِكَ أَنْزَلْتُ حَاجَتِي فَلا تَرُدَّنِي مِنْ سَنِيِّ مَوَاهِبِكَ خَائِباً
lines.transliteration: bika anzaltu hajati fala tarrud-dani min saniyyi mawahibika kha'iba
lines.english: I have stated my need to Thee, so do not reject me from the excellence of Thy gifts, disappointed!

lines.arabic: يَا كَرِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ
lines.transliteration: Ya Karimu Ya Karimu Ya Karimu
lines.english: O All-generous! O All-generous! O All-generous!
Through Thy mercy, O most Merciful of the merciful!

lines.arabic: وَصَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَى خَيْرِ خَلْقِهِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa salla-llahu 'ala khayri khalqihi muhammadin wa alihi ajma'in
lines.english: And Allah bless the best of His creatures, Muhammad, and all his household!
Prostrate and say (in Sajdah)
My God, my heart is veiled,
my soul is deficient,
my intelligence is defeated,
my caprice is triumphant,
my obedience is little,
my disobedience is much,
and my tongue confesses of sinning;
so, what am I to do?
O He Who covers defects!
O He Who knows the unseen!
O He Who removes troubles!
Forgive my sins, all of them,
in the name of the sacredness of Muhammad and the household of Muhammad!

lines.arabic: يَا غَفَّارُ يَا غَفَّارُ يَا غَفَّارُ
lines.transliteration: ya ghaffaru ya ghaffaru ya ghaffaru
lines.english: O All-forgiver! O All-forgiver! O All-forgiver!
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful!
Sahifa Alavia dua no 62 has this addition /difference
Then say seven times:
By Your Generosity.
Then say:
O Subtle!
Then say seven times:
By Your Grace.
Then say:
O Mighty!
Then say seven times:
By Your Might.
Then say:

lines.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِیْ صَدْرِیْ وَ یَسِّرْ لِیْ اَمْرِیْ وَ احْلُلْ عُقْدَۃً مِّنْ لِسَانِیْ یَفْقَہُوْا قَوْلِیْ وَ ارْجِعْنِیْ اِلٰی اَحْسَنِ الْاَحْوَالِ وَ اصْرِفْ عَنِّیْ کُلَّ اٰفَۃٍ وَ عَاہَۃٍ وَ كُلَّ بَلِیَّۃٍ بِمُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِہٖ.
lines.transliteration: Rabbish Rah Lee Sadree Wa Yassir Lee Amree Wah Lul U’qdatam Mil Lesaanee Yafqahoo Qawlee War Je’nee Elaa Ahsanil Ahwaale Was Rif A’nnee Kulla Aafatin Wa A’ahatin Wa Kulla Baliyyatin Be-Mohammadinw Wa Aalehi
lines.english: O my Lord! Expand my breast for me, and make my affair easy to me, and loose the knot from my tongue, (That) they may understand my word; and return me to the best of conditions, turn away from me every vice, defect and all misfortunes by Muhammad and his family.
Then go in prostration and say:

lines.arabic: اِلٰہِیْ قَلْبِیْ مَحْجُوْبٌ وَ عَقْلِیْ مَغْلُوْبٌ وَ نَفْسِیْ مَعْیُوْبٌ وَ ہَوَآئِیْ غَالِبٌ وَ طَاعَتِیْ قَلِیْلَۃٌ وَ مَعْصِيَتِیْ کَثِیْرٌ وَ لِسَانِیْ مُقِرٌّ بِالذُّنُوْبِ وَ مُعْتَرِفٌ بِالْعُیُوْبِ فَمَا حِیْلَتِیْ یَا عَلَّامَ الْغُیُوْبِ يَا سَتَّارَ الْعُیُوْبِ وَ یَا غَفَّارَ الذُّنُوْبُ اِغْفِرْ لِيْ ذُنُوْبِیْ کُلَّہَا یَا غَفَّارُ وَ اسْتُرْ عَلَيَّ يَا سَتَّارُ بِمُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهِ الْاَطْهَارِ بِرَحْمَتِکَ یَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِیْنَ.
lines.transliteration: Elaahee Qalbee Mahjoobun Wa A’qlee Maghloobun Wa Nafsee Ma’yoobun Wa Hawaaa-Ee Ghaalebun Wa Taa-A’tee Qaleelatun Wa Ma’seyatee Kaseerun Wa Lesaanee Moqirrun Biz-Zonoobe Wa Mo’tarefun Bil-O’yoobe Famaa Heelatee Yaa A’llaamal Ghoyoobe Yaa Sattaaral O’yoobe Wa Yaa Ghaffaaraz Zonoobe Ighfir Lee Zonoobee Kullahaa Yaa Ghaffaaro Was Tur A’layya Yaa Sattaaro Be-Mohammadin Wa Aalehil Athaare Be-Rahmateka Yaa Arhamar Raahemeen.
lines.english: My God! My heart is veiled, my intelligence is defeated, my soul is deficient, my caprice is triumphant, my obedience is little, my disobedience is much and my tongue acknowledges sins and confessing the defects. So what am I to do? O He Who knows the unseen! O He Who covers defects! O Forgiver of the sins! Forgive my sins, all of them, O All-Forgiver! And cover them, O Concealer! By Muhammad and his pure progeny, by Your Mercy O the most Merciful!

title: Dua Aliya al-Mazameen
description: Lofty Meanings. Recited after Ziyarat of Holy Imams. Mentioned by Sayyid Ibn Tawus in Misbah al-Zair after Ziyarat Aimmatul Momineen.

lines.english: O Allah, I am visiting this Imam
confessing his Imamate
and believing in the obligation of the obedience to him;
therefore, I have betaken myself to his shrine in spite of all of my sins, defects,
the perils of my wrongdoings,
my numerous misdeeds and faults,
and whatsoever You know about me;
taking shelter in Your amnesty,
seeking refuge of Your forbearance,
hoping for Your mercy,
resorting to Your asylum,
seeking the protection of Your compassion,

seeking the intercession of Your vicegerent and the son (If this supplication is said at the holy shrine of Imam `Ali (`a), the word ‘wabni (and the son)’ must be changed into ‘wa abi (and the father)’.) of Your vicegerent,
Your choicest servant and the son of Your choicest servants,
Your trustee and the son of Your trustees,
and Your representative and the son of Your representatives,

lines.arabic: الَّذِينَ جَعَلْتَهُمُ الْوَسِيلَةَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ وَ رِضْوَانِكَ
lines.transliteration: alladhina ja`altahum alwasilata ila rahmatika wa ridwanika
lines.english: whom You have made the means to approach Your mercy and pleasure

lines.arabic: وَ الذَّرِيعَةَ إِلَى رَأْفَتِكَ وَ غُفْرَانِكَ‏
lines.english: and the channels to Your compassion and forgiveness.
O Allah, my first need from You

lines.arabic: أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي مَا سَلَفَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي عَلَى كَثْرَتِهَا
lines.transliteration: an taghfira li ma salafa min dhunubi `ala kathratiha
lines.english: is that I implore You to forgive all of my previous sins although they are numerous,

lines.arabic: وَ أَنْ تَعْصِمَنِي فِيمَا بَقِيَ مِنْ عُمْرِي
lines.transliteration: wa an ta`simani fima baqiya min `umri
lines.english: to protect me (against sinning) in my coming lifetime,
to purify my religion from whatsoever stains,
disgraces, or degrades it,

lines.arabic: وَ تَحْمِيَهُ مِنَ الرَّيْبِ وَ الشَّكِّ
lines.english: to save it from suspect, doubt,
corruption, and blasphemy,
to make me stand firm on the obedience to You,
to Your Messenger,
and to his Progeny the pure and happy,
may Your blessings be upon them

lines.arabic: وَ رَحْمَتُكَ وَ سَلاَمُكَ وَ بَرَكَاتُكَ‏
lines.transliteration: wa rahmatuka wa salamuka wa barakatuka
lines.english: as well as Your mercy, peace, and favors,

lines.arabic: وَ تُحْيِيَنِي مَا أَحْيَيْتَنِي عَلَى طَاعَتِهِمْ
lines.english: to make me live as long as You grant me life on the obedience to them,

lines.arabic: وَ تُمِيتَنِي إِذَا أَمَتَّنِي عَلَى طَاعَتِهِمْ‏
lines.english: to make me die, when You decide so, on the obedience to them,

lines.arabic: وَ أَنْ لاَ تَمْحُوَ مِنْ قَلْبِي مَوَدَّتَهُمْ وَ مَحَبَّتَهُمْ
lines.transliteration: wa an la tamhuwa min qalbi mawaddatahum wa mahabbatahum
lines.english: and not to erase from my heart my love and affection for them,
my aversion to their enemies,
my companionship of their adherents, and my acting piously towards them.

lines.arabic: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبِّ أَنْ تَقْبَلَ ذَلِكَ مِنِّي
lines.transliteration: wa as'aluka ya rabbi an taqbala dhalika minni
lines.english: I also beseech You, O my Lord, to accept all that from me,
to endear my worshipping You to myself,
to endue me with perseverance in worship,
to make me active in it,

lines.arabic: وَ تُبَغِّضَ إِلَيَّ مَعَاصِيَكَ وَ مَحَارِمَكَ
lines.transliteration: wa tubaghghida ilayya ma`asiyaka wa maharimaka
lines.english: to make me loathe acts of disobedience to You and acts that You deemed forbidden,
to take me away from these acts,
to save me against negligence of my prayers,
belittling them,
and slackening in their performance,

lines.arabic: وَ تُوَفِّقَنِي لِتَأْدِيَتِهَا كَمَا فَرَضْتَ‏ وَ أَمَرْتَ بِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa tuwaffiqani lita'diyatiha kama faradta wa amarta bihi
lines.english: to lead me to perform them as perfect as You have made incumbent upon me and as You have commanded
according to the traditions of Your Messenger,
may Your blessings be upon him and his Household
as well as Your mercy and favors,
with submission and reverence,
to expand my breast for defraying the poor-rate,
giving alms,
giving charity,

lines.arabic: وَ الْإِحْسَانِ إِلَى شِيعَةِ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: and doing favors to the adherents of the Household of Muhammad,
peace be upon them, and for consoling them.

lines.arabic: وَ لاَ تَتَوَفَّانِي إِلاَّ بَعْدَ أَنْ تَرْزُقَنِي حِجَّ بَيْتِكَ الْحَرَامِ
lines.transliteration: wa la tatawaffani illa ba`da an tarzuqani hajja baytika alharami
lines.english: Do not take me up (i.e. cause me to die) before You bestow upon me with the favor of going on pilgrimage to Your Sacred House
and to the tomb of Your Prophet
and the tombs of the Imams, peace be upon them.

lines.arabic: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبِّ تَوْبَةً نَصُوحاً تَرْضَاهَا
lines.transliteration: wa as'aluka ya rabbi tawbatan nasuhan tardaha
lines.english: I also beseech You, O Lord, to grant me a sincere repentance that You accept,
an intention that You praise,
and righteous deed that You admit,

lines.arabic: وَ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي وَ تَرْحَمَنِي إِذَا تَوَفَّيْتَنِي
lines.transliteration: wa an taghfira li wa tarhamani idha tawaffaytani
lines.english: to forgive me and have mercy upon me when You take me up,
to make easy for me the agonies of death,

lines.arabic: وَ تَحْشُرَنِي فِي زُمْرَةِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa tahshurani fi zumrati muhammadin wa alihi
lines.english: to include me with the group of Muhammad and his Household,
peace of Allah be upon him and them,
to allow me to enter Paradise out of Your mercy,

lines.arabic: وَ تَجْعَلَ دَمْعِي غَزِيراً فِي طَاعَتِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa taj`ala dam`i ghaziran fi ta`atika
lines.english: to make me shed heavy tears as obeisance to You,

lines.arabic: وَ عَبْرَتِي جَارِيَةً فِيمَا يُقَرِّبُنِي مِنْكَ
lines.english: to make my tears always run down in acts that draw me near You,
to make my heart sympathetic towards Your intimate servants,
to save me in this worldly life
from handicaps, epidemics,
incurable diseases,
chronic illnesses,

lines.arabic: وَ جَمِيعِ أَنْوَاعِ الْبَلاَءِ وَ الْحَوَادِثِ
lines.english: and all sorts of misfortunes and catastrophes.
[I also beseech You to] cause my heart to turn away from the forbidden (acts and things),
make me hate acts of disobedience to You,
make me love the legally gotten sustenance
open its doors before me,

lines.arabic: وَ تُثَبِّتَ نِيَّتِي وَ فِعْلِي عَلَيْهِ
lines.english: make firm my intention and my deeds on it,
extend my lifetime,
and close the doors of adversaries before me.

lines.arabic: وَ لاَ تَسْلُبَنِي مَا مَنَنْتَ بِهِ عَلَيَّ
lines.transliteration: wa la taslubani ma mananta bihi `alayya
lines.english: (Please) do not deprive me of whatsoever You have favored upon me,

lines.arabic: وَ لاَ تَسْتَرِدَّ شَيْئًا مِمَّا أَحْسَنْتَ بِهِ إِلَيَ‏
lines.transliteration: wa la tastaridda shay'an mimma ahsanta bihi ilayya
lines.english: do not take back from me the graces that You have granted me,

lines.arabic: وَ لاَ تَنْزِعَ مِنِّي النِّعَمَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ بِهَا عَلَيَّ
lines.transliteration: wa la tanzi` minniya alnni`ama allati an`amta biha `alayya
lines.english: do not strip me of the elegances that You have conferred upon me;
[rather, please] increase that which You have authorized me to possess,
expand it many folds for me,
and provide me with fortune that is very much,
spacious, agreeable,
joyful, growing, and satisfactory,
and with dignity that is everlasting and sufficient,
and with prestige that is outgoing and overwhelming,
and with bounty that is flowing and broad.

lines.arabic: وَ تُغْنِيَنِي بِذَلِكَ عَنِ الْمَطَالِبِ الْمُنَكَّدَةِ
lines.english: Through all that, (please) make me dispense with the humiliating appeals
and unreachable sources,
save me from them with good health

lines.arabic: فِي دِينِي وَ نَفْسِي وَ وَلَدِي
lines.transliteration: fi dini wa nafsi wa waladi
lines.english: as regards my religion, self, sons,
and whatsoever You have given and granted me,
preserve for me my properties
and whatsoever You have put under my disposal,
watch me against the hands of the tyrants,
take me back to my homeland (safely),

lines.arabic: وَ تُبَلِّغَنِي نِهَايَةَ أَمَلِي فِي دُنْيَايَ وَ آخِرَتِي
lines.transliteration: wa tuballighani nihayata amali fi dunyaya wa akhirati
lines.english: confer upon me the utmost of my hope in my worldly life and the Hereafter,

lines.arabic: وَ تَجْعَلَ عَاقِبَةَ أَمْرِي مَحْمُودَةً حَسَنَةً سَلِيمَةً
lines.transliteration: wa taj`ala `aqibata amri mahmudatan hasanatan salimatan
lines.english: make the consequence of my conducts praiseworthy, good, and sound,
make me broadminded,
well-off,
and well-mannered,
[and take me] away from miserliness, stinginess.
hypocrisy, fabrication,
slander, and perjury.

lines.arabic: وَ تُرْسِخَ فِي قَلْبِي مَحَبَّةَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ شِيعَتِهِمْ‏
lines.transliteration: wa tursikha fi qalbi mahabbata muhammadin wa ali muhammadin wa shi`atihim
lines.english: [Please] make firm in my heart the love for Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and their adherents (Shi`ah).

lines.arabic: وَ تَحْرُسَنِي يَا رَبِّ فِي نَفْسِي وَ أَهْلِي
lines.transliteration: wa tahrusani ya rabbi fi nafsi wa ahli
lines.english: O Lord, guard me, my family,
my properties, my sons,
those who are under my custody, my brothers,
those whom I love, and my offspring
in the name of Your mercy and Magnanimity.
O Allah, these are my needs from You.

lines.arabic: وَ قَدِ اسْتَكْثَرْتُهَا لِلُؤْمِي وَ شُحِّي
lines.transliteration: wa qad istakthartuha lilu'mi wa shuhhi
lines.english: Out of my meanness and avarice, I have considered these needs great,
while in Your view the are insignificantly small
and they are easy and effortless for You.

lines.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِجَاهِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: fa'as'aluka bijahi muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: I thus beseech You in the name of the standing of Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
peace be upon him and them, in Your view,
in the name of Your duty towards You,
in the name of what You have made incumbent upon Yourself towards them,
in the name of Your other Prophets and Messengers,
in the name of Your choicest ones and intimate servants
whom You have selected over others for worshipping You,
and in the name of Your Grand, Substantial Name,
(I beseech You by all these) to grant me all of my requests,
to relieve me through settling them for me,

lines.arabic: وَ لَمْ تُخَيِّبْ أَمَلِي وَ رَجَائِي‏
lines.transliteration: wa lam tukhayyib amali wa raja'i
lines.english: and not to disappoint nor let me down.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَ شَفِّعْ صَاحِبَ هَذَا الْقَبْرِ فِيَ‏
lines.transliteration: allahumma wa shaffi` sahiba hadha alqabri fiyya
lines.english: O Allah, (please) accept the one in this tomb as my interceder before You.

lines.arabic: يَا سَيِّدِي يَا وَلِيَّ اللَّهِ يَا أَمِينَ اللَّهِ
lines.transliteration: ya sayyidi ya waliyya allahi ya amina allahi
lines.english: O my Master! O Allah’s vicegerent! O Allah’s trustee!

lines.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَشْفَعَ لِي إِلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ
lines.transliteration: as'aluka an tashfa`a li ila allahi `azza wa jalla
lines.english: I beseech you to intercede for me before Allah the Almighty and All-majestic
so that He may approve of and grant me all of my requests
in the name of Your Immaculate fathers
and in the name of Your well-selected sons.

lines.arabic: فَإِنَّ لَكَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ تَقَدَّسَتْ أَسْمَاؤُهُ
lines.english: Verily, you enjoy in the view of Allah, sacred be His Names,
an honorable standing,
a lofty rank,
and a spacious regard.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَوْ عَرَفْتُ مَنْ هُوَ أَوْجَهُ عِنْدَكَ
lines.english: O Allah, had I known a person more acceptable in Your view
than this Imam

lines.arabic: وَ مِنْ آبَائِهِ وَ أَبْنَائِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa min aba'ihi wa abna'ihi alttahirina
lines.english: and his immaculate fathers and sons,
peace and blessings be upon them,
I would have chosen them to be my interceders (before You)

lines.arabic: وَ قَدَّمْتُهُمْ أَمَامَ حَاجَتِي وَ طَلِبَاتِي هَذِهِ‏
lines.transliteration: wa qaddamtuhum amama hajati wa talibati hadhihi
lines.english: and I would have introduced them as means by whom I would put before You my needs and requests.
Therefore, (please) hear from me,
respond to me,

lines.arabic: وَ افْعَلْ بِي مَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ
lines.english: and do to me that which You alone are worthy to do.
O most merciful of all those who show mercy.

lines.arabic: االلَّهُمَّ وَ مَا قَصُرَتْ عَنْهُ مَسْأَلَتِي
lines.english: O Allah, as regards the needs that my requests have not included,
the things that I am too powerless to do,
and the things that I am not too clever to mention,

lines.arabic: مِنْ صَالِحِ دِينِي و وَ دُنْيَايَ وَ آخِرَتِي‏
lines.transliteration: min salihi dini wa dunyaya wa akhirati
lines.english: among the things that prosper my religion, worldly life, and next life;
(please) confer upon me with these,
protect me, guard me,

lines.arabic: وَ هَبْ لِي وَ اغْفِرْ لِي
lines.english: bestow upon me (with Your favors), and forgive me.

lines.arabic: وَ مَنْ أَرَادَنِي بِسُوءٍ أَوْ مَكْرُوهٍ
lines.transliteration: wa man aradani bisu'in aw makruhin
lines.english: As for any one who intends evil or wickedness to me,
such as a rebellious devil,
a tyrant ruler,
a dissident miscreant,
a rival in a worldly affair,
one who envies me for a grace,
an unjust individual, or a despot;
then (please) make their hands too short to catch me,
take away their plots against me,
preoccupy them against me with their own affairs,
save me from their evils
and the evils of their followers and devils,

lines.arabic: وَ أَجِرْنِي مِنْ كُلِّ مَا يَضُرُّنِي وَ يُجْحِفُ بِي
lines.transliteration: wa ajirni min kulli ma yadurruni wa yujhifu bi
lines.english: stand by me against whatsoever may harm and do injustice to me,
and (please) grant me the entire goodness

lines.arabic: مِمَّا أَعْلَمُ وَ مِمَّا لاَ أَعْلَمُ‏
lines.transliteration: mimma a`lamu wa mimma la a`lamu
lines.english: whether I know or I do not.

lines.arabic: االلَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
and forgive me, my parents,
my brothers, my sisters,
my (paternal) uncles, my (paternal) aunts,
my (maternal) uncles, my (maternal) aunts,
my forefathers, my foremothers,
their descendants, their offspring,
my spouse(s), my offspring,
my relatives, my friends,
my neighbors, my brothers-in-faith
from the people of the east and the west (of the earth),
all those whom I love
among the believing men and women,
be they alive or dead,
all those who have ever taught me an item of decency,
and those who have received from me an item of knowledge.
O Allah, make all these have a share in my best supplications to You

lines.arabic: وَ زِيَارَتِي لِمَشْهَدِ حُجَّتِكَ وَ وَلِيِّكَ‏
lines.transliteration: wa ziyarati limashhadi hujjatika wa waliyyika
lines.english: and in my (ritual) pilgrimages to the shrine of Your Argument and Your vicegerent;
make me have a share in the best of their supplications,
in the name of Your mercy, O most merciful of all those who show mercy.
Convey their greetings to Your vicegerent.

lines.arabic: وَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ
lines.transliteration: wa alssalamu `alayka wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
lines.english: Peace and Allah's mercy and blessings be upon you.
O my master, O my leader; O…(You should here mention the name of the Imam you are visiting.)
may Allah bless you,
your soul, and your body;
you are my means to approach Allah
and my way towards Him;

lines.arabic: وَ لِي حَقُّ مُوَالاَتِي وَ تَأْمِيلِي‏
lines.transliteration: wa li haqqu muwalati wa ta'mili
lines.english: and I enjoy the right of my loyalty to you and the right of my putting my entire hope in you;

lines.arabic: فَكُنْ شَفِيعِي إِلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ
lines.transliteration: fakun shafi`i ila allahi `azza wa jalla
lines.english: therefore, be my interceder before Allah the Almighty and All-majestic
so that He shall regard my story (that I have just told)

lines.arabic: وَ صَرْفِي عَنْ مَوْقِفِي هَذَا بِالنُّجْحِ
lines.english: and so that He shall decide success to be the result of all of my requests in this situation of mine

lines.arabic: بِمَا سَأَلْتُهُ كُلِّهِ بِرَحْمَتِهِ وَ قُدْرَتِهِ‏
lines.transliteration: bima sa'altuhu kullihi birahmatihi wa qudratihi
lines.english: that I have besought from Him, out of His mercy and omnipotence.
O Allah, (please) bestow upon me a perfect intellectuality,
a sagacious reason,
an everlasting might,
a pure heart,
a very much deed,
and excellent manners;
decide all these to be for my good,
but do not make them stand against me;
in the name of Your mercy, O most merciful of all those who show mercy.

title: Dua Simaat
description: Dua Simaat (The Supplication of the Signs) is a highly esteemed supplication recited by the Prophet (saw) and the Imams (as). It is traditionally recited during the last hour of Friday before Sunset.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيمِ الْأَعْظَمِ الْأَعَزِّ الْأَجَلِّ الْأَكْرَمِ
lines.transliteration: allahumma inni asaluka bismika al-`azimi al-a`zami al-a`azzi al-ajalli al-akrami
lines.english: O Allah, I beseech Thee by Thy name, the most Great, the most Mighty, the most Powerful, the most Glorious, the most Noble,

lines.arabic: الَّذِي إِذَا دُعِيتَ بِهِ عَلَى مَغَالِقِ أَبْوَابِ السَّمَاءِ لِلْفَتْحِ بِالرَّحْمَةِ انْفَتَحَتْ
lines.transliteration: alladhi idha du`ita bihi `ala maghaliqi abwabi alssama'i lilfathi bilrrahmati infatahat
lines.english: which if it is invoked on the closed doors of the heaven for opening with mercy, they are opened;

lines.arabic: وَ إِذَا دُعِيتَ بِهِ عَلَى مَضَايِقِ أَبْوَابِ الْأَرْضِ لِلْفَرَجِ انْفَرَجَتْ
lines.transliteration: wa'idha du`ita bihi `ala madayaqi abwabi al-ardi lilfaraji infarajat
lines.english: and if it is invoked on the narrow doors of the earth for relief, they are relieved;

lines.arabic: وَ إِذَا دُعِيتَ بِهِ عَلَى الْعُسْرِ لِلْيُسْرِ تَيَسَّرَتْ
lines.transliteration: wa'idha du`ita bihi `ala al-`usri lilyusri tayassarat
lines.english: and if it is invoked on the difficulty for ease, it results in ease;

lines.arabic: وَ إِذَا دُعِيتَ بِهِ عَلَى الْأَمْوَاتِ لِلنُّشُورِ انْتَشَرَتْ
lines.transliteration: wa'idha du`ita bihi `ala al-amwati lilnnushuri intasharat
lines.english: and if it is invoked on the dead for rising, they rise;

lines.arabic: وَ إِذَا دُعِيتَ بِهِ عَلَى كَشْفِ الْبَأْسَاءِ وَ الضَّرَّاءِ انْكَشَفَتْ
lines.transliteration: wa'idha du`ita bihi `ala kashfi alba'sa'i walddarrai inkashafat
lines.english: and if it is invoked on the removal of hardships and harms, they are removed.
And (I beseech Thee) by the Glory of Thy Noble Face,
the noblest of faces and the most powerful of faces,
before which all faces bow in submission,
and all necks stoop in humility,
and all voices are hushed in awe,

lines.arabic: وَ وَجِلَتْ لَهُ الْقُلُوبُ مِنْ مَخَافَتِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa wajilat lahu alqulubu min makhafatika
lines.english: and all hearts throb in fear of Thee;

lines.arabic: وَ بِقُوَّتِكَ الَّتِي بِهَا تُمْسِكُ السَّمَاءَ أَنْ تَقَعَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ إِلا بِإِذْنِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa biquwwatika allati biha tumsiku alssama'a an taqa`a `ala al-ardi illa bi'idhnika
lines.english: and (I beseech Thee) by Thy Power with which Thou holdest the heaven lest it should fall on the earth except by Thy permission,

lines.arabic: وَ تُمْسِكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضَ أَنْ تَزُولا
lines.transliteration: wa tumsiku alssamawati wal-arda an tazula
lines.english: and with which Thou holdest the heavens and the earth lest they should deviate;

lines.arabic: وَ بِمَشِيَّتِكَ الَّتِي دَانَ لَهَا الْعَالَمُونَ
lines.transliteration: wa bamashiyyatika allati dana laha al`alamuna
lines.english: and (I beseech Thee) by Thy Will which the whole world obeys,

lines.arabic: وَ بِكَلِمَتِكَ الَّتِي خَلَقْتَ بِهَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضَ
lines.transliteration: wa bikalimatika allati khalaqta biha alssamawati wal-arda
lines.english: and by Thy Word with which Thou createdst the heavens and the earth,

lines.arabic: وَ بِحِكْمَتِكَ الَّتِي صَنَعْتَ بِهَا الْعَجَائِبَ
lines.transliteration: wa bihikmatika allati sana`ta biha al`aja'iba
lines.english: and by Thy Wisdom with which Thou createdst wonders,

lines.arabic: وَ خَلَقْتَ بِهَا الظُّلْمَةَ وَ جَعَلْتَهَا لَيْلا
lines.transliteration: wa khalaqta biha alzzulmata wa ja`altaha laylan
lines.english: and with which Thou createdst the darkness and madest it night,
and madest the night for rest,

lines.arabic: وَ خَلَقْتَ بِهَا النُّورَ وَ جَعَلْتَهُ نَهَارا
lines.transliteration: wa khalaqta biha alnnuura wa ja`altahu naharan
lines.english: and with which Thou createdst the light and madest it day,
and madest the day for rising and seeing,

lines.arabic: وَ خَلَقْتَ بِهَا الشَّمْسَ وَ جَعَلْتَ الشَّمْسَ ضِيَاءً
lines.transliteration: wa khalaqta biha alshshamsa wa ja`alta alshshamsa diya'an
lines.english: and with which Thou createdst the sun and madest the sun a shining light,

lines.arabic: وَ خَلَقْتَ بِهَا الْقَمَرَ وَ جَعَلْتَ الْقَمَرَ نُورا
lines.transliteration: wa khalaqta biha alqamara wa ja`alta alqamara nuran
lines.english: and with which Thou createdst the moon and madest the moon a light,
and with which Thou createdst the planets

lines.arabic: وَ جَعَلْتَهَا نُجُوما وَ بُرُوجا وَ مَصَابِيحَ وَ رُجُوما وَ مَنَاراً وَ جَمَالا
lines.transliteration: wa ja`altaha nujuman wa burujan wa masabiha wa rujuman wa manaran wa jamala
lines.english: and madest them stars and signs and lamps and means of stoning (the devils) and a light and a beauty,

lines.arabic: وَ بِجَلالِكَ الَّذِي تَهْدِي بِهِ مَنْ تَشَاءُ
lines.transliteration: wa bijalalika alladhi tahdi bihi man tasha'u
lines.english: and by Thy Glory with which Thou guidest whomsoever Thou wilt,
and by Thy Might which cannot be challenged,
and by Thy inaccessible Authority,

lines.arabic: وَ بِعَظَمَتِكَ الَّتِي مَلَأَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
lines.transliteration: wa bi`azamatika allati mala'at kulla shay'in
lines.english: and by Thy Greatness that has filled everything,
and by Thy Ancient Favor,
and by Thy Universal Generosity,

lines.arabic: وَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ الَّتِي اسْتَطَلْتَ بِهَا عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
lines.transliteration: wa biquwwatika allati istatalta biha `ala kulli shay'in
lines.english: and by Thy Power with which Thou art dominant over everything,

lines.arabic: وَ بِمَجْدِكَ الَّذِي تَجَلَّيْتَ بِهِ لِمُوسَى كَلِيمِكَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ فِي طُورِ سَيْنَاءَ
lines.transliteration: wa bimajdika alladhi tajallayta bihi limusa kalimika `alayhi alssalamu fi turi sayna'a
lines.english: and by Thy Glory with which Thou appeared to Thy speaker (Moosa - Moses), peace be on him, on Mount Sinai;

lines.arabic: وَ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلِكَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ مِنْ قَبْلُ فِي مَسْجِدِ الْخَيْفِ
lines.transliteration: wa li'ibrahima khalilika `alayhi alssalamu min qablu fi masjidi alkhayfi
lines.english: and before that to Ibrahim, Thy friend, peace be on him, in the Mosque of al-Khayf;

lines.arabic: وَ لِإِسْحَاقَ صَفِيِّكَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ فِي بِئْرِ شِيَعٍ
lines.transliteration: wa li'ishaqa safiyyika `alayhi alssalamu fi bi'ri shiya`in
lines.english: and to Ishaq (Isaac), Thy chosen one, peace be on him, in Bi'r Shiya;

lines.arabic: وَ لِيَعْقُوبَ نَبِيِّكَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ فِي بَيْتِ إِيلٍ
lines.transliteration: wa liya`quba nabiyyika `alayhi alssalamu fi bayti ilin
lines.english: and to Ya`qub (Jacob), Thy Prophet, peace be on him, in Bayt iyl;
and that Thou fulfilledst Thy promise to Ibrahim;
and Thy oath to Ishaq;
and Thy testimony to Ya`qub;
and for the believers Thy promise;
and for those who supplicated (Thee) by Thy names, and Thou respondedst to them;

lines.arabic: وَ بِمَجْدِكَ الَّذِي ظَهَرَ لِمُوسَى بْنِ عِمْرَانَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ
lines.transliteration: wa bimajdika alladhi zahara limusa ibni `imrana `alayhi alssalamu
lines.english: and by Thy Glory which appeared to Moosa ibn 'Imran, peace be on him,
over the dome of the pomegranate;

lines.arabic: وَ بِآيَاتِكَ الَّتِي وَقَعَتْ عَلَى أَرْضِ مِصْرَ
lines.transliteration: wa bi'ayatika allati waqa`at `ala ardi misra
lines.english: and by Thy signs which appeared on the land of Egypt
with grand power and sovereignty
and by mighty signs,

lines.arabic: وَ بِسُلْطَانِ الْقُوَّةِ وَ بِعِزَّةِ الْقُدْرَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa bisultani alquwwati wa bi`izzati alqudrati
lines.english: and by the authority of power and by glorious power;
and by the state of the Complete Word;

lines.arabic: وَ بِكَلِمَاتِكَ الَّتِي تَفَضَّلْتَ بِهَا عَلَى أَهْلِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ
lines.transliteration: wa bikalimatika allati tafaddalta biha `ala ahli alssamawati wal-ardi
lines.english: and by Thy words with which Thou favored the people of the heavens and the earth

lines.arabic: وَ أَهْلِ الدُّنْيَا وَ أَهْلِ الْآخِرَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa ahli alddunya wa ahli al-akhirati
lines.english: and the people of this world and the world hereafter;

lines.arabic: وَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي خَلَقْتَ بِهَا جَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa birahmatika allati khalaqta biha jami`a khalqika
lines.english: and by Thy mercy with which Thou createdst all Thy creatures;

lines.arabic: وَ بِاسْتِطَاعَتِكَ الَّتِي أَقَمْتَ بِهَا الْعَالَمِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa bistita`atika allati aqamta biha al`alamina
lines.english: and by Thy power with which Thou establishedst the worlds;

lines.arabic: وَ بِنُورِكَ الَّذِي قَدْ خَرَّ مِنْ فَزَعِهِ طُورُ سَيْنَاءَ
lines.transliteration: wa binurika alladhi qad kharra min faza`ihi tuuru sayna'a
lines.english: and by Thy light from the dread of which Mount Sinai collapsed;

lines.arabic: وَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَ جَلالِكَ وَ كِبْرِيَائِكَ وَ عِزَّتِكَ وَ جَبَرُوتِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa bi`ilmika wa jalalika wa kibriya'ika wa `izzatika wa jabarutika
lines.english: and by Thy knowledge, Thy splendor, Thy greatness, Thy might, and Thy pride;

lines.arabic: الَّتِي لَمْ تَسْتَطِعِ الْأَرْضُ نُهُوضاً بِهَا
lines.transliteration: allati lam tastati`i al-ardu nuhudan biha
lines.english: which the earth could not bear,
and for which the heavens lowered themselves,
and the great depths restrained themselves,

lines.arabic: وَ رَكَدَتْ لَهَا الْبِحَارُ وَ الْأَنْهَارُ
lines.english: and the seas and rivers became motionless,
and the mountains submitted,
and the earth became still on its shoulders;
and all creatures submitted to it;

lines.arabic: وَ خَفَقَتْ لَهَا الرِّيَاحُ فِي جَرَيَانِهَا
lines.transliteration: wa khafaqat laha alrriyahu fi jarayaniha
lines.english: and for which the winds blew in their courses,

lines.arabic: وَ خَمَدَتْ لَهَا النِّيرَانُ فِي أَوْطَانِهَا
lines.transliteration: wa khamadat laha alnniranu fi awtaniha
lines.english: and the fires were extinguished in their places;

lines.arabic: وَ بِسُلْطَانِكَ الَّذِي عُرِفَتْ لَكَ بِهِ الْغَلَبَةُ دَهْرَ الدُّهُورِ
lines.transliteration: wa bisultanika alladhi `urifat laka bihi alghalabatu dahra alduhuri
lines.english: and by Thy authority through which Thou hast been known for Thy dominance through all ages,

lines.arabic: وَ حُمِدْتَ بِهِ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرَضِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa humidta bihi fi alssamawati wal-aradina
lines.english: and Thou hast been praised in the heavens and the earths;

lines.arabic: وَ بِكَلِمَتِكَ كَلِمَةِ الصِّدْقِ الَّتِي سَبَقَتْ لِأَبِينَا آدَمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ وَ ذُرِّيَّتِهِ بِالرَّحْمَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa bikalimatika kalimati alssidqi allati sabaqat li'abina adama `alayhi alssalamu wa dhurriyyatihi bilrrahmati
lines.english: and by Thy Word, the Word of Truth which was promised to our father Adam, peace be on him, and his progeny with mercy;

lines.arabic: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ االلَّهُمَّ بِكَلِمَتِكَ الَّتِي غَلَبَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
lines.transliteration: wa as'aluka allahumma bikalimatika allati ghalabat kulla shay'in
lines.english: and I beseech Thee, O Allah, by Thy Word which is dominant over everything,

lines.arabic: وَ بِنُورِ وَجْهِكَ الَّذِي تَجَلَّيْتَ بِهِ لِلْجَبَلِ فَجَعَلْتَهُ دَكّا
lines.transliteration: wa binuri wajhika alladhi tajallayta bihi liljabali faja`altahu dakkan
lines.english: and by the light of Thy Face with which Thou appeared to the Mountain and it was made into dust,
and Moosa (Moses) fell down unconscious;

lines.arabic: وَ بِمَجْدِكَ الَّذِي ظَهَرَ عَلَى طُورِ سَيْنَاءَ كَلَّمْتَ بِهِ عَبْدَكَ وَ رَسُولَكَ مُوسَى ابْنَ عِمْرَانَ
lines.transliteration: wa bimajdika alladhi zahara `ala turi sayna'a kallamta bihi `abdaka wa rasulaka musa ibni `imrana
lines.english: and by Thy Glory which appeared on Mount Sinai where Thou spokest to Thy servant and Messenger, Moosa ibn 'Imran;
and by Thy appearance in Sa'ir,
and Thy manifestation on Mount Paran;
and by the heights of the holy ones
and the hosts of the angels standing in rows,
and the submissiveness of those who glorify Thee;

lines.arabic: وَ بِبَرَكَاتِكَ الَّتِي بَارَكْتَ فِيهَا عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلِكَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ
lines.transliteration: wa bibarakatika allati barakta fiha `ala ibrahima khalilika `alayhi alssalamu
lines.english: and by Thy blessings with which Thou blessedst Ibrahim, Thy friend, peace be on him,

lines.arabic: فِي أُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
lines.transliteration: fi ummati muhammadin salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
lines.english: among the Ummah of Muhammad, Allah's blessings be on him and his progeny;

lines.arabic: وَ بَارَكْتَ لِإِسْحَاقَ صَفِيِّكَ فِي أُمَّةِ عِيسَى عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ
lines.transliteration: wa barakta li'ishaqa safiyyika fi ummati `isa `alayhima alssalamu
lines.english: and Thou blessedst Ishaq, Thy chosen one, among the Ummah of 'Isa, peace be on them;

lines.arabic: وَ بَارَكْتَ لِيَعْقُوبَ إِسْرَائِيلِكَ فِي أُمَّةِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ
lines.transliteration: wa barakta liya`quba isra'ilika fi ummati musa `alayhima alssalamu
lines.english: and Thou blessedst Ya`qub (Jacob), Thy Israel, among the Ummah of Moosa, peace be on them;

lines.arabic: وَ بَارَكْتَ لِحَبِيبِكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فِي عِتْرَتِهِ وَ ذُرِّيَّتِهِ وَ أُمَّتِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa barakta lihabibika muhammadin salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi fi `itratihi wa dhurriyyatihi wa ummatihi
lines.english: and Thou blessedst Thy beloved Muhammad, Allah's blessings be on him and his progeny, among his progeny and his offspring and his Ummah.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اَسْاَلُكَ بِحَقِّ هَذِهِ الاَسْماءِ الْمُكَرَّمَةِ عَلَيْكَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma as'aluka bi-haqqi hadhihi al-asma'i al-mukarramati 'alayk
lines.english: O Allah! I beseech Thee in the name of these honored names which Thou enjoyest
and in the name of their position with Thee

lines.arabic: اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: an tusalliya 'ala muhammadin wa ali muhammad
lines.english: to bless Muhammad and the household of Muhammad,

lines.transliteration: wa an tarzuqani khayra al-dunya wa al-akhirah
lines.english: and to grant me the good of this world and the world hereafter

lines.transliteration: wa balligh arwahahum wa ajsadahum minni al-salam
lines.english: and convey my greetings to their souls and their bodies,

lines.transliteration: wa tafaddal 'ala fuqara'i al-mu'minina wa al-mu'minat
lines.english: and favor the poor believing men and women
with wealth and riches,

lines.arabic: وَعَلى مَرْضَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِناتِ بِالشِّفاءِ وَالصِّحَّةِ
lines.transliteration: wa 'ala marda al-mu'minina wa al-mu'minat bi-al-shifa'i wa al-sihhah
lines.english: and the sick believing men and women with healing and health,

lines.arabic: وَعَلى اَحْياءِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِناتِ بِاللُّطْفِ وَالْكَرامَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa 'ala ahya'i al-mu'minina wa al-mu'minat bi-al-lutfi wa al-karamah
lines.english: and the living believing men and women with kindness and honor,

lines.arabic: وَعَلى اَمْواتِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِناتِ بِالْمَغْفِرَةِ وَالرَّحْمَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa 'ala amwati al-mu'minina wa al-mu'minat bi-al-maghfirati wa al-rahmah
lines.english: and the dead believing men and women with forgiveness and mercy,

lines.arabic: وَعَلى مُسافِرِي الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِناتِ بِالرَّدِّ اِلى اَوْطانِهِمْ سالِمينَ غانِمينَ
lines.transliteration: wa 'ala musafiri al-mu'minina wa al-mu'minat bi-al-raddi ila awtanihim salimina ghanimin
lines.english: and the traveling believing men and women with safe and successful return to their homes
out of Thy mercy, O most Merciful of all!

lines.arabic: وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلى سَيِّدِنا مُحَمَّدٍ خاتَمِ النَّبِيّينَ وَآلِهِ الطّاهِرينَ وَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيماً كَثِيراً
lines.transliteration: wa salla allahu 'ala sayyidina muhammadin khatami al-nabiyyina wa alihi al-tahirina wa sallama tasliman kathira
lines.english: May Allah's blessings be on our master Muhammad, the last of the Prophets, and his pure progeny, and give them peace in abundance.
Shaykh Ibn Fahad says that it is recommended to say the following prayer after Du`a' al-Simat:

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحُرْمَةِ هٰذَا ٱلدُّعَاءِ
lines.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka bihurmati hadha alddu`a'i
lines.english: O Allah, I beseech You in the name of the sacredness of this prayer

lines.transliteration: wa bima fata minhu mina al-asma'i
lines.english: the Names mentioned therein,

lines.arabic: وَبِمَا يَشْتَمِلُ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلتَّفْسِيرِ وَٱلتَّدْبِيرِ
lines.transliteration: wa bima yashtamilu `alayhi mina alttafsiri walttadbiri
lines.english: and the explanation and deep meanings of these names

lines.arabic: ٱلَّذِي لاَ يُحِيطُ بِهِ إِلاَّ انْتَ…
lines.transliteration: alladhi la yuhitu bihi illa anta…
lines.english: that none comprehends save You...

title: Hadith al-Kisa
description: The Tradition of the Cloak (Hadith al-Kisa) is a narrative of an incident where the Prophet Muhammad (s) assembled Hasan, Husayn, Ali, and Fatima under his cloak. It is highly reliable and recited for blessings and fulfillment of desires.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: O' Allāh send Your blessings on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli ala muhammadin wa ali muhammad

lines.arabic: عَنْ فاطِمَةَ الزَّهْراءِ عَلَيْهَا اَلسلام بِنْتِ رَسُول ِاللّه صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ أَنَّها قالَتْ :
lines.english: Fatimatuz-Zahra, the daughter of the Prophet (s), peace be on them, is to have thus related ( an event ) :

lines.arabic: دَخَلَ عَلَيَّ أَبِي رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فِي بَعْضِ الاْيَّامِ فَقالَ:
lines.english: My father, the Prophet (s) of Allah, came to my house one day and said to me:
lines.transliteration: dakhala a'lay-ya abee rasoolul-laahi (S) fee baa'-z'il ay-yaami faqaala :

lines.english: "Peace be on you, Fatimah"
I replied : "And upon you be peace"

lines.arabic: قالَ: إِنِّي أَجِدُ فِي بَدَنِي ضُعْفا
lines.english: Then he said : "I feel weakness in my body"
lines.transliteration: qaala : in-neee ajidu fee badanee z'ua'-faan'

lines.arabic: فَقُلْتُ: أُعِيذُكَ بِاللّهِ يَا أَبَتاهُ مِنَ الضُّعْفِ
lines.english: I said : "May Allah protect you from weakness, father"
lines.transliteration: faqul-tu lahooo : ue'ed'uka bil-laahi yaa abataahoo manaz'-z'ua'fi

lines.arabic: فَقَالَ: ”يَا فَاطِمَةُ! ٱئْتِينِي بِٱلْكِسَاءِ ٱلْيَمَانِيِّ فَغَطِّينِي بِهِ.
lines.english: He said : "Fatimah, please bring the Yemeni cloak and cover me with it"
lines.transliteration: faqaala : yaa faat'imatu ee-teenee bil-kasaaa-il-yamaanee faghat-teenee bihi

lines.english: So, I brought the Yemeni cloak and covered him with it.

lines.arabic: وَصرْتُ أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ وَإِذا وَجْهُهُ يَتَلَأَلَؤُ
lines.english: Then, I looked at him and saw that his face was shining
lines.transliteration: wa s'ur-tu anz'uru ilay-hee wa id'aa waj-hahoo yatal-lau

lines.arabic: كَأَنَّهُ الْبَدْرُ فِي لَيْلَة تَمامِهِ وَكَمالِهِ
lines.english: like a full moon with its glory and splendor
lines.transliteration: kaan-nahul-bad-ru fee lay-lati tamaamihee wa kamaalih

lines.arabic: فَمَا كانَتْ إِلاّ ساعَةً وَإِذا بِوَلَدِيَ الْحَسَنِ عليه السلام قَدْ أَقْبَلَ
lines.english: After a while, my son Hasan came in
lines.transliteration: famaa kaanat il-laa saaa'taw-wa id'aa biwaladiyal-h'asani (alayhis-salaam) qad aq-bala

lines.english: and said : "Peace be on you, mother"
lines.transliteration: wa qaala : as-salaamu a'lay-ki yaaa um-maah

lines.arabic: فَقُلتُ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا قُرَّةَ عَيْنِي وَثَمَرَةَ فُؤَادِي
lines.english: I replied : "And upon you be peace, O light of my eyes, and the delight of my heart"
lines.transliteration: faqul-tu : wa a'lay-kas-salaamu yaa qur-rata a'y-nee wa thamarata fuaadee

lines.arabic: فَقَالَ: يَا أُمَّاهُ إِنِّي أَشَمُّ عِنْدَكِ رائِحَةً طَيِّبَةً
lines.english: He then said : "O Mother! I smell a fragrance so sweet
lines.transliteration: faqaala : yaa um-maahoo in-nee ashum-mu i'ndaki raaa-ih'atin tay-yibatin

lines.arabic: كَأَنَّها رائِحَةُ جَدِّي رَسُولِ اللّه صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
lines.english: and so pure as that of my grandfather, the Prophet (s) of Allah"

lines.arabic: فَقُلْتُ: نَعَمْ إِنَّ جَدَّكَ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
lines.english: I replied : "Yes. Your grandfather is underneath the cloak"

lines.arabic: فَأَقْبَلَ الْحَسَنُ نَحْوَ الْكِساءِ وَقالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا جَدَّاهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ
lines.english: Hasan went near the cloak and said : "Peace be on you, my grandfather, the Prophet (s) of Allah;
lines.transliteration: fa aq-balal-h'asanu nah'-wal-kisaaa-i wa qaala : as-salaamu a'lay-ka yaa jad-daahoo yaa rasoolal-laahi

lines.arabic: أَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أَدْخُلَ مَعَكَ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
lines.english: May I enter the cloak with you?"
lines.transliteration: ata-d'anu leee an ad-khula maa'ka tah'-tal-kisaaa

lines.arabic: فَقالَ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا وَلَدِي وَيَا صاحِبَ حَوْضِي
lines.english: He replied : "And upon you be peace, my son and the master of my fountain (Kauthar),
lines.transliteration: qaala : wa a'lay-kas-salaamu yaa waladee wa yaa s'aah'iba h'awz'ee

lines.english: you are given the permission to enter"
So, Hasan entered the cloak with him

lines.arabic: فَمَا كانَتْ إِلاَّ ساعَةً وَإِذا بِوَلَدِيَ الْحُسَيْنِ قَدْ أَقْبَلَ وَقالَ
lines.english: After a while, my Husain came in and said :
lines.transliteration: famaa kaanat il-laa saaa'taw-wa id'aa biwaladial-h'usay-ni qad aq-bala wa qaala :

lines.english: "Peace be on you, mother"

lines.arabic: فَقُلْتُ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا وَلَدِي وَيَا قُرَّةَ عَيْنِي وَثَمَرَةَ فُؤَادِي.
lines.english: I replied : "And upon you be peace, O light of my eyes, and the delight of my heart"
lines.transliteration: faqul-tu : wa a'lay-kas-salaamu yaa waladee wa yaa qur-rata a'y-nee wa thamarata fuaadee

lines.arabic: فَقَالَ لِي: يَا أُمَّاهُ إِنِّي أَشَمُّ عِنْدَكِ رائِحَةً طَيِّبَةً
lines.english: He then said : "O Mother! I smell a fragrance so sweet
lines.transliteration: faqaala lee : yaaa um-maahoo in-nee shummu i'ndaki raaa-ih'atin tay-yibatan

lines.arabic: كَأَنَّها رائِحَةُ جَدِّي رَسُولِ اللّهُ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ.
lines.english: and so pure as that of my grandfather, the Prophet (s) of Allah"

lines.arabic: فَقُلْتُ: نَعَمْ إِنَّ جَدَّكَ وَأَخاكَ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ.
lines.english: I replied : "Yes. Your grandfather and your brother are underneath the cloak"
lines.transliteration: faqul-tu : naa'm in-na jad-daka wa akhaaka tah'-tal-kisaaa

lines.english: Husain stepped towards the cloak

lines.arabic: وَقالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا جَدَّاهُ السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنِ اخْتارَهُ اللّهُ
lines.english: and said : "Peace be on you, my grandfather, the Chosen of Allah;
lines.transliteration: wa qaala : as-salaamu a'lay-ka yaa jad-dahoos-salaamu a'lay-ka yaa manikh-taarahul-lahoo

lines.arabic: أَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أَكُونَ مَعَكُما تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
lines.english: May I enter the cloak with you?"
lines.transliteration: ata-d'anu leee an ad-khula maa'kumaa tah'-tal-kisaaa

lines.english: He replied : "And upon you be peace, my son

lines.arabic: وَيَا شافِعَ أُمَّتِي قَدْ أَذِنْتُ لَكَ.
lines.english: and interceder of my followers, you are given the permission to enter"
lines.transliteration: wa yaa shaafia'a um-matee qad ad'-intu lak

lines.english: So, Husain entered the cloak with them.

lines.arabic: فَأَ قْبَلَ عِنْدَ ذلِكَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طالِبٍ
lines.english: After a while, Abul Hasan, Ali bin Abi Talib came in
lines.transliteration: faaq-bala i'nda d'aalika abul-h'asani a'lee-yub-nu abee t'aalibiw-

lines.arabic: وَقالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكِ يَا بِنْتَ رَسُولِ اللّهِ.
lines.english: and said : "Peace be on you, O daughter of the Prophet (s) of Allah"
lines.transliteration: wa qaala : as-salaamu a'lay-ki yaa binta rasoolil-laah

lines.arabic: فَقُلْتُ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا أَبَا الْحَسَنِ وَيَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ.
lines.english: I replied : "And upon you be peace, O father of Hasan, and the Commander of the faithful"
lines.transliteration: faqul-tu wa a'lay-kas-salaamu yaa abal-h'asani wa yaaa ameeral-mumineen

lines.arabic: فَقالَ: يَا فاطِمَةُ إِنِّي أَشَمُّ عِنْدَكِ رائِحَةً طَيِّبَةً
lines.english: He then said : "O Fatima! I smell a fragrance so sweet and so pure
lines.transliteration: faqaala yaa faat'imatu in-nee ashum-mu i'ndaki raaa-ih'atan tay-yibatan

lines.arabic: كَانَّهَا رائِحَةُ أَخِي وَابْنِ عَمِّي رَسُولِ اللّه صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ.
lines.english: as that of my brother and my cousin, the Prophet (s) of Allah"
lines.transliteration: kaan-nahaa raaa-ih'atu akhee wab-ni a'm-mee rasoolil-laah sallallahu alaihi wa alihi wasallam

lines.arabic: فَقُلْتُ: نَعَمْ هَا هُوَ مَعَ وَلَدَيْكَ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
lines.english: I replied: "Yes. He is underneath the cloak with your two sons"
lines.transliteration: faqul-tu naa'm haa hooa maa' waladay-ka tah'-tal-kisaaa

lines.english: So, Ali went near the cloak

lines.arabic: وَقالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ
lines.english: and said : "Peace be on you, Prophet (s) of Allah;
lines.transliteration: wa qaala : assalaamu a'lay-ka yaa rasoolal-laahi

lines.arabic: وأَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أَكُونَ مَعَكُمْ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
lines.english: May I enter the cloak with you?"
lines.transliteration: ata-d'anu leee an akoo-na maa'kum tah'-tal-kisaaa

lines.arabic: قالَ لَهُ: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا أَخِي ويَا وَصِيِّي
lines.english: He replied : "And upon you be peace, my brother, my successor,
lines.transliteration: qaala lahu : wa a'lay-kas-salaamu yaaa akhee wa yaa was'ee

lines.arabic: وَخَلِيفَتِي وَصاحِبَ لِوَائِي قَدْ أَذِنْتُ لَكَ
lines.english: my successor, and my standard bearer, you are given the permission to enter"
lines.transliteration: wa khalee-fatee wa s'aah'iba liwaaa-ee qad ad'intu lak

lines.english: So, Ali entered the cloak with them.
Then I stepped forward

lines.arabic: وَقُلْتُ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَتاهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ
lines.english: and said : "Peace be on you, my father, O Prophet (s) of Allah;
lines.transliteration: wa qul-tu : as-salaamu a'lay-ka yaaa abataah yaa rasoolal-laahi

lines.arabic: أَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أَكُونَ مَعَكُمْ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
lines.english: May I enter the cloak with you?"
lines.transliteration: ata-d'anu leee an akoo-na maa'kum tah'-tal-kisaaa

lines.arabic: قالَ: وَعَلَيْكِ السَّلامُ يَا بِنْتِي وَيَا بِضْعَتِي قَدْ أَذِنْتُ لَكِ
lines.english: He replied : "And upon you be peace, my daughter, O part of myself; you are given the permission to enter"
lines.transliteration: qaala : wa a'lay-kis-salaamu yaa bintee yaa baz'-atee qad ad'intu laki

lines.english: So, I entered the cloak with them.

lines.arabic: فَلَمَّا اكْتَمَلْنا جَمِيعاً تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ أَخَذَ أَبِي رَسُولُ اللّه بِطَرَفَي الْكِساءِ
lines.english: Getting together underneath the cloak, my father, the Prophet (s) of Allah, held the two ends of the cloak
lines.transliteration: fal-lamak-tamal-naa jamee-a'n tah'-tal-kisaaa-i akhad'a abee rasoolul-laahi bitarafayil-kisaaa-i

lines.arabic: وَأَوْمَأَ بِيَدِهِ ٱلْيُمْـنٰى إِلَى السَّماءِ وَقالَ:
lines.english: and raised his right hand towards the heavens and prayed :
lines.transliteration: wa aw-maa biyadihil-yum-naa ilas-samaaa-i wa qaala :

lines.arabic: اللّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَؤُلاءِ أَهْلُ بَيْتِي وَخاصَّتِي وَحامَّتِي
lines.english: "O Allah, these are the people of my Household (Ahlul-Bayt). They are my confidants and my supporters.
lines.transliteration: al-laahum-ma in-na haa-ulaaa-i ah-lu bay-tee wa khaaas'-s'atee wa h'aaam-matee

lines.english: Their flesh is my flesh and their blood is my blood.
Whoever hurts them, hurts me too.
Whoever displeases them, displeases me too.
I am at war with those who are at war with them.
I am at peace with those who are at peace with them.
I am the enemy of their enemies
and I am the friend of their friends.
They are from me and I am from them.
O Allah! Bestow Your Blessings, Benevolence,
lines.transliteration: faj-a'l s'alawaatika wa barakaatika wa rah'-matika

lines.english: Forgiveness and Your pleasure upon me and upon them.

lines.arabic: وَعَلَيْهِمْ وَأَذْهِبْ عَنْهُمُ الرِّجْسَ وَطَهِّرْهُمْ تَطْهِيراً.
lines.english: And keep them away from impurity (and flaws) and keep them thoroughly purified"
lines.transliteration: wa a'lay-him wa ad'-hib a'n-humur-rij-sa wa tah-hiruhum tat-heera

lines.english: Then the Lord, Almighty Allah said :
"O My angels! O Residents of My Heavens,
lines.transliteration: yaa malaaa-ikatee wa yaa suk-kaana samaawaateee

lines.arabic: إِنِّي إمَا خَلَقْتُ سَماءً مَبْنِيَّةً وَلاَ أَرْضاً مَدْحِيَّةً وَلاَ قَمَراً مُنِيراً
lines.english: verily, I have not created the erected Sky, the stretched earth, the illuminated moon,
lines.transliteration: in-nee maa khalaq-tu samaa-am-mab-nee-yataw-wa laa ar-z'am-mad-h'ee-yataw-wa laa qamaram-muneeraw-

lines.arabic: وَلاَ شَمْساً مُضِيئَةً وَلاَ فَلَكاً يَدُورُ وَلاَ بَحْراً يَجْرِي وَلاَ فُلْكاً يَسْرِي
lines.english: the bright sun, the rotating planets, the flowing seas and the sailing ships,
lines.transliteration: wa laa sham-sam-muz'eee-ataw-wa laa falakay-yadoo-ru wa laa bah'-ray-yaj-reee wa laa fulkal yasree

lines.arabic: إِلاَّ فِي مَحَبَّةِ هَؤلاءِ الْخَمْسَةِ الَّذِينَ هُمْ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ.
lines.english: but for the love of these Five underneath the cloak"
lines.transliteration: il-laa fee mah'ab-bati haa-ulaaa-il-kham-satil-lad'ee-na hum tah'-tal-kisaaa

lines.arabic: فَقالَ الاْمِينُ جَبْرائِيلُ: يَارَبِّ وَمَنْ تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ
lines.english: Gabriel, the trusted angel, asked : "Who are under the cloak?"
lines.transliteration: faqaalal-ameenu jib-raaa-ee-lu : yaa rab-bi wa man tah'-tal-kisaaa

lines.english: The Almighty answered :

lines.arabic: هُمْ أَهْلُ بَيْتِ النُّبُوَّةِ وَمَعْدِنُ الرِّسالَةِ
lines.english: "They are the Household of the Prophet (s) and the assets of Prophet hood.
They are : Fatimah, her father, her husband and her two sons"
lines.transliteration: hum : faat'imatu wa aboohaa wa baa'-luhaa wa banoo-haa

lines.arabic: فَقالَ جَبْرائِيلُ: يَارَبِّ أَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أَهْبِطَ إِلَى الاْرْضِ
lines.english: Gabriel said : "O Lord, May I fly to earth
lines.transliteration: faqaala jib-raaa-ee-lu : yaa rab-bi ata-d'anu leee an ah-bita ilal-ar-z'i

lines.english: to be the sixth of them?"

lines.arabic: فَقالَ اللّهُ: نَعَمْ قَدْ أَذِنْتُ لَكَ.
lines.english: Allah replied: "Yes. You are given the permission"

lines.arabic: فَهَبَطَ الاْمِينُ جَبْرائِيلُ وَقالَ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ
lines.english: Gabriel, the trusted, landed near them and said : "Peace be on you, O Prophet (s) of Allah.
lines.transliteration: fahabatalameenu jib-raaa-ee-lu wa qaala : as-salaamu a'lay-ka yaa rasoolal-laahil-

lines.arabic: الْعَلِيُّ الاْعْلى يُقْرِئُكَ السَّلام َوَيَخُصُّكَ بِالتَّحِيَّةِ وَالاْكْرامِ
lines.english: The All-Highest conveys His peace on you and His greetings
lines.transliteration: a'lee-yul-aa'-laa yuq-riukas-salaamu wa yakhus'-s'uka bil-tah'eey-yati wa lik-raam

lines.english: and says: "By My Honor and Glory, O My angels! O Residents of My Heavens,
lines.transliteration: wa yaqoo-lu laka : wa iz'-zatee wa jalaalee

lines.english: verily, I have not created the erected Sky,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ أَرْضاً مَدْحِيَّةً وَلاَ قَمَراً مُنِيراً وَلاَ شَمْساً مُضِيئَةً
lines.english: the stretched earth, the illuminated moon, the bright sun,
lines.transliteration: wa laa ar-z'am-mad-h'ee-yataw-wa laa qamaram-muneeran wa laa sham-sam-muz'eeeataw-

lines.arabic: وَلاَ فَلَكاً يَدُورُ وَلاَ بَحْراً يَجْرِي وَلاَ فُلْكاً يَسْرِي
lines.english: the rotating planets, the flowing seas and the sailing ships,
lines.transliteration: wa laa falkal yadur wa laa bah'-ray-yaj-ree wa laa ful-kay-yas-reee

lines.english: but for your sake and love"

lines.arabic: وَقَدْ أَذِنَ لِي أَنْ أَدْخُلَ مَعَكُمْ
lines.english: and Allah has given me permission to enter the cloak with you.
lines.transliteration: wa qad ad'ina leee an ad-khula maa'kum

lines.arabic: فَهَلْ تَأْذَنُ لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللّه
lines.english: May I join you, O Prophet (s) of Allah?"

lines.arabic: فَقالَ رَسُولُ اللّه: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يَا أَمِينَ وَحْي اللّهِ
lines.english: The Prophet (s) replied : "And peace be on you, O trusted bearer of Allah's Revelations!
lines.transliteration: faqaala rasoolul-laahi : wa a'lay-kas-salaamu yaa amee-na wah'-yil-laahi

lines.english: you are granted the permission"
So, Gabriel entered the cloak with us

lines.arabic: فَقالَ لاِبِي: إِنَّ اللّهَ قَدْ أَوْحَى إِلَيْكُمْ يَقُولُ:
lines.english: and said to my father : Allah sends His Revelations to you;
lines.transliteration: faqaala li-abee : in-nal-laaha qad aw-h'aaa ilay-kum yaqoolu :

lines.arabic: إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ اللّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ الرِّجْسَ
lines.english: "Verily Allah's desire is to keep you away from impurity (and flaws),
O People of Household (Ahlul-Bayt) and keep you thoroughly purified"

lines.arabic: فَقالَ عَلِيٌّ لاِبِي: يَا رَسُولَ اللّه أَخْبِرْنِي مَا لِجُلُوسِنا
lines.english: Then Ali said to my father : "O Prophet (s) of Allah, tell me
lines.transliteration: faqaala a'lee-yul li-abee : yaa rasoolal-laahi akh-bir-nee maa lijuloosinaa

lines.arabic: هذَا تَحْتَ الْكِساءِ مِنَ الْفَضْلِ عِنْدَ اللّهُ
lines.english: what significance has Allah given for getting together underneath this cloak ?"

lines.arabic: فَقالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ:
lines.english: The Prophet (s) replied :
"By Him who rightfully appointed me a Prophet (s)
and chose me a Messenger for the salvation of the mankind.

lines.arabic: مَا ذُكِرَ خَبَرُنا هذَا فِي مَحْفِلٍ مِنْ مَحافِلِ
lines.english: whenever and wherever an assembly
lines.transliteration: maa d'ukira khabarunaa haad'aa fee mah'-falim-mim-mah'aafili

lines.arabic: أَهْلِ الاْرْضِ وَفِيهِ جَمْعٌ مِنْ شِيعَتِنا وَمُحِّبِينا
lines.english: of our followers and friends mention this event,
lines.transliteration: ah-lil-ar-z'i wa fee-hi jam-u'm-min shee-a'tinaa wa muh'-ib-bee-naa

lines.english: Allah will bestow on them His Blessings and Mercy;

lines.arabic: وَحَفَّتْ بِهِمُ الْمَلائِكَةُ وَاسْتَغْفَرَتْ لَهُمْ إِلى أَنْ يَتَفَرَّقُوا.
lines.english: angels will encircle them asking Allah the remission of their sins until the assembly disperses
lines.transliteration: wa h'af-fat bihimu lamalaaa-ikah was-tagh-farat lahum ilaaa ay-yatafar-raqoo

lines.arabic: فَقالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: إِذنْ وَاللّهِ فُزْنَا وَفازَ شِيعَتُنا وَرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةِ.
lines.english: So Ali said : "Verily, by the Lord of Kabaa! we and our followers are the winners"
lines.transliteration: faqaala a'lee-yun a'lay-his-salaamu : id'aw-wal-laahi fuz-naa wa faaza shee-a'tunaa wa rab-bil-kaa'-bah

lines.arabic: فَقالَ أَبِي رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ:
lines.english: Then my father replied :
lines.transliteration: faqaala abee rasoolul-laahi s'al-lal-laaho a'lay-hi wa aaalihi:

lines.arabic: يَا عَلِيُّ وَالَّذِي بَعَثَنِي بِالْحَقِّ نَبِيّاً
lines.english: "By Him who rightfully appointed me a Prophet
lines.transliteration: yaa a'lee-yu wal-lad'ee baa'thanee bil-h'aq-qi nabee-yaw

lines.english: and chose me a Messenger for the salvation of the mankind,

lines.arabic: مَا ذُكِرَ خَبَرُنا هذَا فِي مَحْفِلٍ مِنْ مَحَافِلِ أَهْلِ الاْرْضِ
lines.english: whenever and wherever an assembly
lines.transliteration: ma d'ukira khabarunaa haad'aa fee mah'-falim-mim-mah'aafili ah-lil ar-z'i

lines.english: our followers and friends mentions this event,
lines.transliteration: wa fee-hi jam-u'm-min shee-a'tinaa wa muh'ib-bee-naa

lines.arabic: وَفِيهِمْ مَهْمُومٌ إِلاَّ وَفَرَّجَ اللّهُ هَمَّهُ
lines.english: there shall remain none grieved but Allah will remove his grief,
lines.transliteration: wa fee-him mah-moo-mun il-laa wa far-rajal-laaho ham-mahoo

lines.arabic: وَلاَ مَغْمُومٌ إِلاَّ وَكَشَفَ اللّهُ غَمَّهُ
lines.english: there shall remain none distressed but Allah will dispel his distress,
lines.transliteration: walaa magh-moo-mun il-laa wa kashafal-laaho gham-mahoo

lines.arabic: وَلاَ طالِبُ حاجَةٍ إِلاَّ وَقَضَى اللّهُ حاجَتَهُ.
lines.english: there shall remain none wish-seeker but Allah will grant his wish."
lines.transliteration: wa laa t'aalibu h'aajatin il-laa wa qaz'al-laaho h'aajatah

lines.arabic: فَقالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: إِذن وَاللّه فُزْنا وَسُعِدْنا وَكَذلِكَ شِيعَتُنا
lines.english: `Ali, peace be upon him, said, "Then, we have won and attained pleasure. I swear it by Allah. So have our adherents;
lines.transliteration: faqaala a'lee-yun a'lay-his-salaamu id'aaw-wal-laahi fuz-naa wa sui'd-naa wa kad'aalika shee-atunaa

lines.arabic: فازُوا وَسُعِدُوا فِي الدُّنْيا وَالاْخِرَةِ وَرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةِ.
lines.english: they have won and attained pleasure in this world and in the Hereafter. I swear it by the Lord of the Ka`bah."
lines.transliteration: faazoo wa sui'doo fid-dunyaa wal aaakhirati wa rab-bil-kaa'-bah

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: O' Allāh send Your blessings on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli ala muhammadin wa ali muhammad

title: Dua Nudbah
description:
Calling out to Imam Mahdi(ajtfs) recommended for Friday Mornings and day of Eid


Dua al-Nudba, or the “supplication of lamentation” is traditionally recited weekly on the day of Friday. The supplication is narrated by Sayed Ibn Tawus, who was one of the greatest scholars within the school of Ahl al-Bayt (p), in one of his famous works.2 Ibn Mashadi, who is also one of the greatest scholars, narrates it in his famous encyclopedic work of supplications and visitations of the Holy Household.3 It is known as the “supplication of lamentation” because it brings the believers to tears during the course of its recitation, due to the fact that the Imam is in occultation when we are in great need and desire for his presence. From its early onset, upon praising God and sending salutations upon the Prophet Muhammad and his progeny (pbut), we immediately enter into the emotional invocation.

lines.english: All praise be to Allah the Lord of the worlds.

lines.arabic: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّهِ
lines.english: May Allah send blessings upon our master Muhammad His Prophet
lines.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala sayyidina muhammadin nabiyyihi

lines.english: and upon his Household and may He salute them with thorough salutation.
O Allah, all praise be to You
for Your decree that has been applied

lines.arabic: فِي اوْلِيَائِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَخْلَصْتَهُمْ لِنَفْسِكَ وَدِينِكَ
lines.english: to Your vicegerents whom You have purely selected for Yourself and Your religion;
lines.transliteration: fi awliya'ika alladhina istakhlastahum linafsika wa dinika

lines.arabic: إِِذِ ٱخْتَرْتَ لَهُمْ جَزِيلَ مَا عِنْدَكَ
lines.english: as You have chosen for them the abundance of what You have in possession;
that is the enduring pleasure

lines.arabic: ٱلَّذِي لاََ زَوَالَ لَهُ وَلاَ ٱضْمِحْلاَلَ
lines.english: that neither vanishes nor diminishes,
lines.transliteration: alladhi la zawala lahu wa la idmihlala

lines.english: after You had already stipulated on them to renounce
all the ranks of this lowly world
along with all of its embellishments and ornaments,
and they accepted this stipulation.
As You knew that they would fulfill this stipulation,
You accepted and drew them near to You.
You thus provided them with sublime mention
and obvious approval,
made Your angels descend to them,
honored them with Your revelations,
supported them with Your knowledge,
and made them the channel to You
and the means to winning Your pleasure.
Therefore, You made some of them dwell in Your Garden
until You decided to take him out of there.
You bore another one on in Your Ark
and saved him and those who believed with him
lines.transliteration: wa najjaytahu wa man amana ma`ahu

lines.english: from perdition, out of Your mercy.
You took another one as Your intimate friend

lines.arabic: وَسَالَكَ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي ٱلآخِرِينَ فَاجَبْتَهُ
lines.english: and when he asked You to leave behind him a truthful mention, You responded to him
lines.transliteration: wa sa'alaka lisana sidqin fi al-akhirina fa'ajabtahu

lines.english: and made that (mention) to be eminent.
You spoke to another one from a tree directly
lines.transliteration: wa ba`dun kallamtahu min shajaratin takliman

lines.arabic: وَجَعَلْتَ لَهُ مِنْ اخِيهِ رِدْءاً وَوَزِيراً
lines.english: and decided his brother to be his protector and representative.
lines.transliteration: wa ja`alta lahu min akhihi rid'an wa waziran

lines.english: You made another one to be born without a father,
lines.transliteration: wa ba`dun awladtahu min ghayri abin

lines.english: gave him clear-cut proofs
and aided him with the Sacred Spirit.
For each of them, You gave a code of law,
decided a certain course,
and finely chose successors;
well-trustworthy successors one after another,
each for a certain period,
in purpose of establishing Your religion
and acting as arguments against Your servants,
so that the truth should never leave its position
and the wrong should never overcome the people of the truth
and so that none should claim, saying,

lines.arabic: لَوْ لاَ ارْسَلْتَ إِِلَيْنَا رَسُولاًَ مُنْذِراً
lines.english: “If only You had sent to us a warning messenger
and established for us a guiding person,

lines.arabic: فَنَتَّبِعَ آيَاتِكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ انْ نَذِلَّ وَنَخْزَىٰ
lines.english: we should have followed Your signs before that we met humiliation and disgrace!”
lines.transliteration: fanattabi`a ayatika min qabli an nadhilla wa nakhza

lines.arabic: إِلَىٰ انِ ٱنْتَهَيْتَ بِٱلامْرِ إِلَىٰ حَبِيبِكَ وَنَجِيبِكَ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: You then ended the matter with Your most-beloved and well-select one, Muhammad,
lines.transliteration: ila an intahayta bil-amri ila habibika wa najibika muhammadin

lines.english: may Allah bless him and his Household.
He was—as exactly as You have chosen—
the master of all those whom You created,
the best of all those whom You selected,
the most favorite of all those whom You pointed out,
and the noblest of all those on whom You decided.
So, You preferred him to Your prophets,
sent him to the two dependents (men and jinn) from Your servants,
enabled him to tread on the east and the west of Your lands,
made subservient to him the Buraq (the celestial sumpter),
raised him to Your heavens,
and entrusted with him the knowledge of whatever passed
and whatever shall come to pass up to the extinction of Your creatures.
lines.transliteration: wa ma yakunu ila inqida'i khalqika

lines.english: You then granted him victory by means of awe & majesty
ordered (Archangels) Gabriel and Michael
as well as the marked angels to surround him,

lines.arabic: وَوَعَدْتَهُ انْ تُظْهِرَ دِينَهُ عَلَىٰ ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِ
lines.english: and promised him to make his faith prevail all other faiths
lines.transliteration: wa wa`adtahu an tuzhira dinahu `ala alddini kullihi

lines.english: however much the polytheists may be averse.

lines.arabic: وَذٰلِكَ بَعْدَ انْ بَوَّاتَهُ مُبَوَّا صِدْقٍ مِنْ اهْلِهِ
lines.english: You did all that after You had settled him in an honest position among his people,
lines.transliteration: wa dhalika ba`da an bawwa'tahu mubawwa'a sidqin min ahlihi

lines.english: made for him and them the first house
lines.transliteration: wa ja`alta lahu wa lahum awwala baytin

lines.english: ever located for the people; that is the house in Bakkah,
blessed and guidance for the worlds.
In it, there are clear-cut proofs.
It is the standing-place of Abraham,
and whoever enters it will be secured.

lines.arabic: وَقُلْتَ «إِِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ ٱلرِّجْسَ
lines.english: You also said, “Allah only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you,
lines.transliteration: wa qulta innama yuridu allahu liyudhhiba `ankum alrrijsa

lines.english: O people of the House,
and to purify you a thorough purifying.”
You then decided the reward of Muhammad,
Your blessings be upon him and his Household,
to be the love for them; as in Your Book
You said, “Say: I do not ask of you any reward for it
but love for my near relatives.”

lines.arabic: وَقُلْتَ «مَا سَالْتُكُمْ مِنْ اجْرٍ فَهُوَ لَكُمْ.»
lines.english: You also said, “Whatever reward I have asked of you, that is only for yourselves.”
lines.transliteration: wa qulta ma sa'altukum min ajrin fahuwa lakum

lines.english: You also said, “I do not ask you aught in return
lines.transliteration: wa qulta ma as'alukum `alayhi min ajrin
