lines.arabic: إِلاَّ مَنْ شَاءَ انْ يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلاًَ.»
lines.english: except that he who wills, may take the way to his Lord.”
lines.transliteration: illa man sha'a an yattakhidha ila rabbihi sabilan

lines.english: They (i.e. the Prophet’s Household) have therefore been the way to You
and the course to Your pleasure.
When his (i.e. the Prophet) days passed,

lines.arabic: اقَامَ وَلِيَّهُ عَلِيَّ بْنَ ابِي طَالِبٍ
lines.english: he appointed as successor his vicegerent `Ali the son of Abu-Talib,
Your blessings be upon both of them and their Household,
because he (the Prophet) was the warner
and `Ali was the guide for every people.
So, he (the Prophet) said in the presence of the people,
“As for each one who has taken me as his master,
`Ali is now his master.
O Allah, guard any one who is loyal to `Ali,
be the enemy of any one who antagonizes him,
support any one who supports him,
and disappoint any one who disappoints him.”

lines.arabic: وَقَالَ: ”مَنْ كُنْتُ انَا نَبِيَّهُ فَعَلِيٌّ امِيرُهُ.“
lines.english: He also said, “As for any one who has considered me as his Prophet, `Ali is now his commander.”
lines.transliteration: wa qala man kuntu ana nabiyyahu fa`aliyyun amiruhu

lines.english: He also said, “`Ali and I are of the same tree,
lines.transliteration: wa qala ana wa `aliyyun min shajaratin wahidatin

lines.english: while all the other peoples are from various trees.”
lines.transliteration: wa sa'iru alnnasi min shajarin shatta

lines.english: He endued him (i.e. `Ali) with the position that (Prophet) Aaron had with regard to (Prophet) Moses,
lines.transliteration: wa ahallahu mahalla haruna min musa

lines.arabic: فَقَالَ لَهُ: ”انْتَ مِنِّي بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُونَ مِنْ مُوسَىٰ
lines.english: saying, “Your position to me is as same as Aaron’s position to Moses (in every thing)
lines.transliteration: faqal lahu anta minni bimanzilati haruna min musa

lines.english: except that there shall be no prophet after me.”
He gave him in marriage his daughter the doyenne of the women of the worlds.
lines.transliteration: wa zawwajahu ibnatahu sayyidata nisa'i al`alamina

lines.arabic: وَاحَلَّ لَهُ مِنْ مَسْجِدِهِ مَا حَلَّ لَهُ
lines.english: He allowed him (alone) to do whatever he himself is allowed to do in his Mosque.
lines.transliteration: wa ahalla lahu min masjidihi ma halla lahu

lines.english: He closed all the doors (to the Mosque) except his (i.e. `Ali) door.
He then entrusted with him his knowledge and his wisdom,
saying, “I am the city of knowledge,
and `Ali is its door.
So, whoever wants this city and wisdom,
must come to it from its door.”
He then said (to `Ali), “You are my brother, successor, and inheritor.
lines.transliteration: thumma qala anta akhi wa wasiyyi wa warithi

lines.english: Your flesh is part of my flesh,
your blood is part of my blood,
your peace is my peace,
your war is my war,
and faith is mixed with your flesh and blood
as same as it is mixed with my flesh and blood.
On the morrow, you shall be my vicegerent on the (Divine) Pond.
You also settle my debts
and fulfill my commitments.
Your Shi`ah (i.e. adherents) shall be on pulpits of light,
white-faced, around me in Paradise.
They are my neighbors (therein).
Were it not for you `Ali,
true believers would not be recognized after me.”
Hence, he (i.e. `Ali), after the Prophet, was true guidance against straying off,
lines.transliteration: wa kana ba`dahu hudan min alddalali

lines.english: light against blindness,
the firmest rope of Allah,
and His straight path.
None would precede him in blood relation (with the Prophet)
or any priority in a religious affair,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ يُلْحَقُ فِي مَنْقَبَةٍ مِنْ مَنَاقِبِهِ
lines.english: and none would ever match him in any item of virtue.
lines.transliteration: wa la yulhaqu fi manqabatin min manaqibihi

lines.english: He patterned after the Messenger,
may Allah’s blessings be upon both of them and their Household.
He fought for the sake of true interpretation (of the Qur'an).

lines.arabic: وَلاَ تَاخُذُهُ فِي ٱللَّهِ لَوْمَةُ لاَئِمٍ
lines.english: The blame of any blamer would never stop him from doing anything for the sake of Allah.
lines.transliteration: wa la ta'khudhuhu fi allahi lawmatu la'imin

lines.english: He thus exterminated the villains of the Arabs,
killed their heroes,
and eradicated their ferocious fighters.
He therefore filled in their hearts with malice
from the battles of Badr, Khaybar, and Hunayn as well as others.
lines.transliteration: badriyyatan wa khaybariyyatan wa hunayniyyatan wa ghayrahunna

lines.english: Therefore, they clang inseparably to opposing him
and attached upon dissenting him
until he (had to) kill those who broke their oath/allegiance, and the unjust, and the apostates"
When he passed away

lines.arabic: وَقَتَلَهُ اشْقَىٰ ٱلآخِرِينَ يَتْبَعُ اشْقَىٰ ٱلاوَّلِينَ
lines.english: and he was killed by the most miserable of all of the late generations who will be attached to the most miserable of the past generations,
lines.transliteration: wa qatalahu ashqa al-akhirina yatba`u ashqa al-awwalina

lines.english: the decree of Allah’s Messenger,
may Allah bless him and his Household,
about the leadership of the successive guiding ones was not carried out;
rather, the people insisted on detesting him
and agreed unanimously on rupturing their relations with him
and moving away his descendants (from leadership),

lines.arabic: إِِلاَّ ٱلْقَلِيلَ مِمَّنْ وَفَىٰ لِرِعَايَةِ ٱلْحَقِّ فِيهِمْ
lines.english: except for a few ones who fulfilled the duty of observing their rights.
lines.transliteration: illa alqalila mimman wafa liri`ayati alhaqqi fihim

lines.english: Many (of `Ali’s descendants) were therefore slain,
many others were taken as captives,
and many others were banished.
Decrees were thus applied to them
in a form expected to grant them excellent reward for that.
Verily, the earth is Allah’s;
He gives it in inheritance to whomever of His servants that He wishes;
and the end result shall be for the pious.
All glory be to our Lord.
Most certainly, the promise of our Lord shall come to pass.
Allah shall never fail to fulfill His promise.
He is the Almighty, the All-wise.

lines.arabic: فَعَلَىٰ ٱلاطَائِبِ مِنْ اهْلِ بَيْتِ مُحَمَّد وَعَلِيٍّ
lines.english: For the immaculate ones from the household of Muhammad and `Ali,
lines.transliteration: fa`ala al-ata'ibi min ahli bayti muhammadin wa `aliyyin

lines.english: may Allah bless both of them and their household,
let weepers weep.
For them too, let lamenters lament.
For the like of them, let tears be shed,
screamers scream,
yellers yell,
and wailers wail.
Where is al-Hasan? Where is al-Husayn?
Where are the sons of al-Husayn;
a virtuous one after another,
and a veracious one after another?
Where is the course (to Allah) after a course?
Where is the best after the best?
Where are the rising suns?
Where are the shining moons?
Where are the brilliant stars?
Where are the authorities of the religion
and the foundations of knowledge?
Where is the left by Allah

lines.arabic: ٱلَّتِي لاََ تَخْلُو مِنَ ٱلْعِتْرَةِ ٱلْهَادِيةِ
lines.english: that is always represented by individuals from the guiding (Prophetic) offspring?
lines.transliteration: allati la takhlu min al`itrati alhadiyati

lines.english: Where is the one prepared for cutting off the roots of the wrongdoers?
Where is the one awaited for mending every unevenness and crookedness?
Where is the one hoped for removing oppression and aggression?
Where is the one spared for refreshing the duties and traditions?
Where is the one chosen for restoring the faith and the code of law?
Where is the one expected to restore to life the Book and its provisions?
lines.transliteration: ayna almu'ammalu li'ihya'i alkitabi wa hududihi

lines.english: Where is the reviver of the elements of the religion and its people?
lines.transliteration: ayna muhyi ma`alimi alddini wa ahlihi

lines.english: Where is the one shattering the arms of the aggressors?
Where is the one demolishing the edifices of polytheism and hypocrisy?
Where is the one annihilating the people of wickedness,
disobedience, and tyranny?
Where is the one uprooting the branches of error and insurgence?
Where is the one effacing the traces of evasiveness and personal desires?
Where is the one severing the ropes of fabrication and forgery?
Where is the one terminating the insolent defiant and persistent rebels?

lines.arabic: ايْنَ مُسْتَاصِلُ اهْلِ ٱلْعِنَادِ وَٱلتَّضْلِيلِ وَٱلإِلْحَادِ
lines.english: Where is the one tearing up the people of obstinacy, misleading, and atheism?
lines.transliteration: ayna musta'silu ahli al`inadi walttadlili wal-ilhadi

lines.english: Where is the one ennobling the saints and humiliating the enemies?
lines.transliteration: ayna mu`izzu al-awliya'i wa mudhillu al-a`da'i

lines.english: Where is the one bringing together (all scattered) words to piety?

lines.arabic: ايْنَ بَابُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي مِنْهُ يُؤْتَىٰ
lines.english: Where is the door of Allah from which Allah is come?
lines.transliteration: ayna babu allahi alladhi minhu yu'ta

lines.arabic: ايْنَ وَجْهُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي إِِلَيْهِ يَتَوَجَّهُ ٱلاوْلِيَاءُ
lines.english: Where is the Face of Allah towards whom the saints turn their faces.
lines.transliteration: ayna wajhu allahi alladhi ilayhi yatawajjahu al-awliya'u

lines.arabic: ايْنَ ٱلسَّبَبُ ٱلْمُتَّصِلُ بَيْنَ ٱلارْضِ وَٱلسَّمَاءِ
lines.english: Where is the means of access that is connectedly extended between the earth and the heavens.
lines.transliteration: ayna alssababu almuttasilu bayna al-ardi walssama'i

lines.english: Where is the patron of the Conquest Day
and the stretcher of the pennon of true guidance?
Where is the one reunifying the dispersed parts of uprightness and contentment?

lines.arabic: ايْنَ ٱلطَّالِبُ بِذُحُولِ ٱلانْبِيَاءِ وَابْنَاءِ ٱلانْبِيَاءِ
lines.english: Where is the one demanding with the vengeance of the Prophets and their sons?
lines.transliteration: ayna alttalibu bidhuhuli al-anbiya'i wa abna'i al-anbiya'i

lines.english: Where is the one demanding with the blood of the one slain in Karbala'?

lines.arabic: ايْنَ ٱلْمَنْصُورُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱعْتَدَىٰ عَلَيْهِ وَٱفْتَرَىٰ
lines.english: Where is the one granted aid against whomever transgresses and forges lies against him?

lines.arabic: ايْنَ ٱلْمُضْطَرُّ ٱلَّذِي يُجَابُ إِِذَا دَعَا
lines.english: Where is the distressed who is answered when he prays?
lines.transliteration: ayna almudtarru alladhi yujabu idha da`a

lines.arabic: ايْنَ صَدْرُ ٱلْخَلاَئِقِ ذُوُ ٱلْبِرِّ وَٱلتَّقْوَىٰ
lines.english: Where is the forepart of the creatures who enjoys dutifulness and piety?
lines.transliteration: ayna sadru alkhala'iqi dhu albirri walttaqwa

lines.english: Where is the son of the well-chosen Prophet,
the son of `Ali the well-pleased,
the son of Khadijah the glittery lady,
and the son of Fatimah the grand lady?
May my father and mother be ransoms for you.
May my soul be protection and shield for you.
O son of the chiefs drawn near!
O son of the most honorable, outstanding ones!
O son of the guiding and well-guided ones!
O son of the ever-best refined ones!
O son of the all-liberal and all-select ones!
O son of the immaculate and purified ones!
O son of the ample-giving, finely elected ones!
O son of the bounteous, most honorable ones!
O son of light-giving full moons!
O son of beaming lanterns!
O son of piercing flames!
O son of luminous stars!
O son of patent ways!
O son of obvious signs!
O son of perfect knowledge!
O son of renowned traditions!
O son of well-established features!
O son of well-known miracles!
O son of widely witnessed demonstrations!
O son of the straight path!
O son of the great news!

lines.arabic: يَا بْنَ مَنْ هُوَ فِي امِّ ٱلْكِتَابِ لَدَىٰ ٱللَّهِ عَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٌ
lines.english: O son of him who is elevated and full of wisdom in the original of the Book with Allah.
lines.transliteration: yabna man huwa fi ummi alkitabi lada allahi `aliyyun hakimun

lines.english: O son of signs and manifestations!
O son of apparent points of evidence!
O son of clear-cut and dazzling substantiations!
O son of conclusive arguments!
O son of superabundant bounties!
O son of Taha and the decisive (verses)!
O son of Yasin and al-Dhariyat (the winnowing winds)!
O son of al-Tur (the Mount of Revelation) and al-`ªdiyat (the running steeds)!
O son of him who drew near and then bowed;
he therefore was the measure of two bows or closer still;
nearness and closeness to the Most High and Most Exalted (Lord)!

lines.arabic: لَيْتَ شِعْرِي ايْنَ ٱسْتَقَرَّتْ بِكَ ٱلنَّوَىٰ
lines.english: How I wonder! Where has farness taken you?
lines.transliteration: layta shi`ri ayna istaqarrat bika alnnawa

lines.arabic: بَلْ ايُّ ارْضٍ تُقِلُّكَ اوْ ثَرَىٰ
lines.english: Or which land or soil is carrying you?
lines.transliteration: bal ayya ardin tuqilluka aw thara

lines.arabic: ابِرَضْوَىٰ اوْ غَيْرِهَا امْ ذِي طُوَىٰٰ
lines.english: Is it on (Mount) Radwa or elsewhere on (Mount) Dhi-Tuwa?
lines.transliteration: abiradwa aw ghayriha am dhi tuwa

lines.arabic: عَزِيزٌ عَلَيَّ انْ ارَىٰ ٱلْخَلْقَ وَلاَ تُرَىٰ
lines.english: It is hard for me that I can see all creatures but I can neither see you
lines.transliteration: `azizun `alayya an ara alkhalqa wa la tura

lines.arabic: وَلاَ اسْمَعُ لَكَ حَسِيساً وَلاَ نَجْوَىٰ
lines.english: nor can I hear any whisper or confidential talk from you!
lines.transliteration: wa la asma`u laka hasisan wa la najwa

lines.arabic: عَزِيزٌ عَلَيَّ انْ تُحِيطَ بِكَ دُونِيَ ٱلْبَلْوَىٰ
lines.english: It is hard for me that ordeals encompass you, not me

lines.arabic: وَلاَ يَنَالُكَ مِنِّي ضَجِيجٌ وَلاَ شَكْوَىٰ
lines.english: and neither cry nor complaint from me can rally round you!
lines.transliteration: wa la yanaluka minni dajijun wa la shakwa

lines.arabic: بِنَفْسِي انْتَ مِنْ مُغَيَّبٍ لَمْ يَخْلُ مِنَّا
lines.english: May my soul be ransom for you; for although you are hidden from us, you have never forsaken us.
lines.transliteration: binafsi anta min mughayyabin lam yakhlu minna

lines.arabic: بِنَفْسِي انْتَ مِنْ نَازِحٍ مَا نَزَحَ عَنَّا
lines.english: May my soul be ransom for you; for although you are away, you have never been away from us.
lines.transliteration: binafsi anta min nazihin ma nazaha `anna

lines.english: May my soul be ransom for you; for you are the wish of an eager
believing man or woman who mention you and miss you.
lines.transliteration: min mu'minin wa mu'minatin dhakara fahanna

lines.arabic: بِنَفْسِي انْتَ مِنْ عَقِيدِ عِزٍّ لاَ يُسَامَىٰ
lines.english: May my soul be ransom for you; for you are an unmatched pioneer of dignity.

lines.arabic: بِنَفْسِي انْتَ مِنْ اثِيلِ مَجْدٍ لاَ يُجَارَىٰ
lines.english: May my soul be ransom for you; for you are an unrivaled origin of glory.
lines.transliteration: binafsi anta min athili majdin la yujara

lines.arabic: بِنَفْسِي انْتَ مِنْ تِلاَدِ نِعَمٍ لاََ تُضَاهَىٰ
lines.english: May my soul be ransom for you; for you are unparalleled center of bounties.
lines.transliteration: binafsi anta min tiladi ni`amin la tudaha

lines.arabic: بِنَفْسِي انْتَ مِنْ نَصِيفِ شَرَفٍ لاََ يُسَاوَىٰ
lines.english: May my soul be ransom for you; for you are unequaled in all-inclusive honor.
lines.transliteration: binafsi anta min nasifi sharafin la yusawa

lines.arabic: إِلَىٰ مَتَىٰ احَارُ فِيكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ وَإِِلَىٰ مَتَىٰ
lines.english: Until when will I be bewildered about you, O my master, and until when?
lines.transliteration: ila mata aharu fika ya mawlaya wa ila mata

lines.arabic: وَايَّ خِطَابٍ اصِفُ فِيكَ وَايَّ نَجْوَىٰ
lines.english: In what kind of statement and in what kind of talk can I describe you?
lines.transliteration: wa ayya khitabin asifu fika wa ayya najwa

lines.arabic: عَزِيزٌ عَلَيَّ انْ اجَابَ دُونَكَ وَانَاغَىٰ
lines.english: It is hard for me that I can receive answers and words, but you cannot.

lines.arabic: عَزِيزٌ عَلَيَّ انْ ابْكِيَكَ وَيَخْذُلَكَ ٱلْوَرَىٰ
lines.english: It is hard for me that I weep for you but the others disappoint you.

lines.arabic: عَزِيزٌ عَلَيَّ انْ يَجْرِيَ عَلَيْكَ دُونَهُمْ مَا جَرَىٰ
lines.english: It is hard for me that what has happened afflict you other than all the others.

lines.arabic: هَلْ مِنْ مُعِينٍ فَاطِيلَ مَعَهُ ٱلْعَوِيلَ وَٱلْبُكَاءَ
lines.english: Is there any helper with whom I may lament and bewail as much as I wish?
lines.transliteration: hal min mu`inin fa'utila ma`ahu al`awila walbuka'a

lines.arabic: هَلْ مِنْ جَزُوعٍ فَاسَاعِدَ جَزَعَهُ إِِذَا خَلاَ
lines.english: Is there any aggrieved one whom I can help in grief when he becomes tired?
lines.transliteration: hal min jazu`in fa'usa`ida jaza`ahu idha khala

lines.arabic: هَلْ قَذِيَتْ عَيْنٌ فَسَاعَدَتْهَا عَيْنِي عَلَىٰ ٱلْقَذَىٰ
lines.english: Is there any eye moling out and thus my eye may help it to mol out more?

lines.arabic: هَلْ إِِلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ احْمَدَ سَبِيلٌ فَتُلْقَىٰ
lines.english: Is there any way to meet you, O son of Ahmad (the Prophet)?
lines.transliteration: hal ilayka yabna ahmada sabilun fatulqa

lines.arabic: هَلْ يَتَّصِلُ يَوْمُنَا مِنْكَ بِعِدَةٍ فَنَحْظَىٰ
lines.english: Will our day be promised to catch your day and we will thus achieve our hope?
lines.transliteration: hal yattasilu yawmuna minka bi`idatin fanahza

lines.english: When will we be able to join your refreshing springs and we will then be satiated?
When will we quench our thirst from your fresh water,
because thirst has been too long?
When will we accompany you in coming and going so that our eyes will be delighted?

lines.arabic: مَتَىٰ تَرَانَا وَنَرَاكَ وَقَدْ نَشَرْتَ لِوَاءَ ٱلنَّصْرِ تُرَىٰ
lines.english: When will you see us and we see you spreading the pennon of victory?
lines.transliteration: mata tarana wa naraka wa qad nasharta liwa'a alnnasri tura

lines.arabic: اتَرَانَا نَحُفُّ بِكَ وَانْتَ تَؤُمُّ ٱلْمَلَا
lines.english: Can it be that we surround you while you are leading the groups,
lines.transliteration: atarana nahuffu bika wa anta ta'ummu almala'a

lines.english: after you will have filled in the earth with justice,
tasted your enemies humiliation and punishment,
annihilated the insolent defiant and the deniers of the truth,
lines.transliteration: wa abarta al`utata wa jahadata alhaqqi

lines.english: cut off the roots of the arrogant,
eradicated the sources of the wrongdoers,

lines.arabic: وَنَحْنُ نَقُولُ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
lines.english: and we keep on saying, “All praise be to Allah the Lord of the worlds?”
lines.transliteration: wa nahnu naqulu alhamdu lillahi rabbi al`alamina

lines.english: O Allah, You are verily the reliever from agonies and ordeals.
To You do I complain about the transgressions against me, for You alone are worthy of receiving complaints,
and You are alone the Lord of the Hereafter and this world.

lines.arabic: فَاغِثْ يَا غِيَاثَ ٱلْمُسْتَغِيثِينَ عُبَيْدَكَ ٱلْمُبْتَلَىٰ
lines.english: So, (please) aid Your agonized worthless servant, O Aide of those who seek aid,
grant him (i.e. Your servant) chance to see his master, O Lord of mighty prowess,
lines.transliteration: wa arihi sayyidahu ya shadida alquwa

lines.english: remove from him misfortune and anguish, in the name of his master,

lines.arabic: وَبَرِّدْ غَلِيلَهُ يَا مَنْ عَلَىٰ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱسْتَوَىٰ
lines.english: and satisfy his thirst, O He Who is established on the Throne
lines.transliteration: wa barrid ghalilahu ya man `ala al`arshi istawa

lines.english: and He to Whom is the return and the final goal.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَنَحْنُ عَبِيدُكَ ٱلتَّائِقُونَ إِلَىٰ وَلِيِّكَ
lines.english: O Allah, we are Your servants who are fervently willing to meet Your vicegerent,
lines.transliteration: allahumma wa nahnu `abiduka altta'iquna ila waliyyika

lines.english: who reminds of You and Your Prophet;
and whom You have created as haven and refuge for us,
You have appointed as foundation and source of protection for us,
lines.transliteration: wa aqamtahu lana qiwaman wa ma`adhan

lines.english: and whom You have made to be the leader of the believers among us.
So, (please) convey to him greetings and salutations from us,
endue us with more honor, O my Lord, through that,
lines.transliteration: wa zidna bidhalika ya rabbi ikraman

lines.english: decide his settlement among us to be settlement and dwelling for us,
lines.transliteration: waj`al mustaqarrahu lana mustaqarran wa muqaman

lines.english: and perfect Your bounty by making him occupy the leading position before us
lines.transliteration: wa atmim ni`mataka bitaqdimika iyyahu amamana

lines.english: so that You shall allow us to enter the gardens of Your Paradise
and to accompany the martyrs from among Your elite ones.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad;([1])
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin

lines.english: and send blessings upon Muhammad his grandfather and Your messenger;
lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala muhammadin jaddihi wa rasulika

lines.english: the senior master,
upon his father the junior master,
upon his grandmother the grand veracious lady
Fatimah the daughter of Muhammad,
peace be upon him and his Household,

lines.arabic: وَعَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱصْطَفَيْتَ مِنْ آبَائِهِ ٱلْبَرَرَةِ
lines.english: upon his dutiful fathers whom You have chosen (over all others),
lines.transliteration: wa `ala man istafayta min aba'ihi albararati

lines.english: and upon him with such most favorable, most perfect,
most thorough, most permanent,
most abundant, and most plentiful

lines.arabic: مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ احَدٍ مِنْ اصْفِيَائِكَ
lines.english: blessings that You have ever sent upon any of Your elite ones
and well-chosen ones among Your creatures.

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ صَلاَةً لاََ غَايَةَ لِعَدَدِهَا
lines.english: And (please) bless him with such blessings whose number is infinite,
lines.transliteration: wa salli `alayhi salatan la ghayata li`adadiha

lines.english: whose quantity is never-ending,
and whose time is interminable.
O Allah! Through him, establish all rights,
refute the entire wrong,
grant triumph to Your loyalists,
humiliate Your enemies,
establish, O Allah, between him and us
lines.transliteration: wa sil allahumma baynana wa baynahu

lines.english: a connection that leads us to accompany his ancestors,
include us with those who will take their vengeance
and keep constant under their shadow,
help us fulfill our duties towards him,
exert all efforts in obedience to him
and avoiding disobeying him,
bestow upon us with the favor of attaining his pleasure,
and grant us his kindness, mercy,
lines.transliteration: wa hab lana ra'fatahu wa rahmatahu

lines.english: prayer (for us), and his goodness

lines.arabic: مَا نَنَالُ بِهِ سَعَةً مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ
lines.english: in an amount due to which we will gain a good deal of Your mercy
lines.transliteration: ma nanalu bihi sa`atan min rahmatika

lines.english: and achievement with You.
And, through him, render our prayers admitted,
our sins forgiven,
and our supplications responded.
And, through him too, make our sustenance expanded for us,
our distresses relieved,
and our needs granted.
And (please) receive us with Your Noble Face,
approve of our seeking nearness to You,
and have a merciful look at us
by which we will win perfect honor with You;
and, after that, do not ever take it away from us, in the name of Your magnanimity,
and give us a drink from the Pond of his grandfather,
may Allah bless him and his Household,
from his own cup and with his own hand,
such a replete, satiating,
pleasant, and wholesome drink
after which we shall never suffer from thirst.
O most merciful of all those who show mercy!

title: Dua Mashlool
description:
This du-a'a known as "supplication of the youth stricken for his sin," is quoted from the work of Kaf-ami and from Muhaj al Da-wat by Sayyid ibn Tawus. From Imam Hussain(as) it is reported that one day he and his father, after performing Hajj, caught sight of a paralysed young man crying in repentance. He was a habitual sinner who had been cursed by his father, leading to his paralysis. Imam Ali (as) wrote this dua'a for him and instructed him to recite it after Isha salat. The youth was fully cured. The Holy Prophet (sa) told him in a dream to remember this dua'a as it contains the Ism-e-Azam (Greatest Name of Allah).

Reciting this dua'a after Isha salat brings countless blessings. legitmate desires are fulfilled, poverty and sickness are driven away, sins are forgiven, debts are cleared, and mental worries disappear. It brings prosperity, sound mind, and a healthy body.

lines.english: O Allah, verily I beseech You by Your Name:
O Lord of majesty and honor!
O Ever-living! O Self-subsistent!

lines.arabic: يَا حَيُّ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ انتَ
lines.transliteration: ya hayyu la ilaha illa anta
lines.english: O Ever-Living! There is no god but You!

lines.arabic: يَا هُوَ يَا مَنْ لاَ يَعْلَمُ مَا هُوَ
lines.transliteration: ya huwa ya man la ya`lamu ma huwa
lines.english: O He Whom none knows what He is,
nor how He is,
nor where He is,

lines.transliteration: wa la haythu huwa illa huwa
lines.english: nor in what respect He is, but He!
O Possessor of dominion and kingdom!
O Possessor of might and invincibility!

lines.arabic: يَا مَلِكُ يَا قُدُّوسُ يَا سَلاَمُ
lines.transliteration: ya maliku ya quddusu ya salamu
lines.english: O King! O All-holy! O Giver of peace!
O Granter of security! O All-preserver!

lines.arabic: يَا عَزِيزُ يَا جَبَّارُ يَا مُتَكَبِّرُ
lines.english: O Almighty! O All-compeller! O All-sublime!

lines.arabic: يَا خَاِلقُ يَا بَارِئُ يَا مُصَوِّرُ
lines.english: O Creator! O Maker! O Shaper!
O grantor of Benefits! O Director!
O Severe (in punishing the evildoers)! O Originator!
O Returner! O Destroyer!

lines.arabic: يَا وَدُودُ يَا مَحْمُودُ يَا مَعْبُودُ
lines.transliteration: ya wadudu ya mahmudu ya ma`budu
lines.english: O All-loving! O All-praiseworthy! O All-worshipped!
O Far! O Nigh!

lines.arabic: يَا مُجِيبُ يَا رَقِيبُ يَا حَسِيبُ
lines.english: O Responder! O Watcher! O Reckoner!
O Innovator! O Exalter!
O Inaccessible! O All-hearing!

lines.arabic: يَا عَلِيمُ يَا حَلِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ
lines.english: O All-knowing! O All-clement! O All-generous!
O All-wise! O Eternal!
O All-high! O All-tremendous!
O All-commiserating! O All-gracious!
O Condemner! O Recourse!
O All-majestic! O All-handsome!
O Guardian! O Surety!
O Annuller! O Bestower!
O All-noble! O Leader!
O Guide! O All-Apparent!
O First! O Last!
O Outward! O Inward!
O All-steadfast! O Everlasting!
O Knower! O Decider!
O Judge! O Just!
O Separator! O Joiner!
O Pure! O Purifier!
O All-powerful! O All-able!
O All-great! O All-sublime!

lines.arabic: يَا وَاحِدُ يَا احَدُ يَا صَمَدُ
lines.transliteration: ya wahidu ya ahadu ya samadu
lines.english: O One! O Unique! O eternally Besought of all!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
lines.transliteration: ya man lam yalid wa lam yulad
lines.english: O He Who begets not and was not begotten,

lines.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu kufwan ahadun
lines.english: equal to Whom is none,
Who has no consort,
with Him is no aide
nor has He taken any adviser,
nor needs He any assistant,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ كَانَ مَعَهُ مِنَ إِلٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ
lines.transliteration: wa la kana ma`ahu min ilahin ghayruhu
lines.english: nor with Him is any god but He—
there is no god but You.

lines.arabic: فَتَعَالَيْتَ عَمَّا يَقُولُ ٱلظَّالِمُونَ عُلُوّاً كَبِيراً
lines.english: So exalted are You above what the evildoers say, a great exaltation!

lines.arabic: يَا عَلِيُّ يَا شَامِخُ يَا بَاِذخُ
lines.english: O All-high! O All-lofty! O All-towering!

lines.arabic: يَا فَتَّاحُ يَا نَفَّاحُ يَا مُرْتَاحُ
lines.transliteration: ya fattahu ya naffahu ya murtahu
lines.english: O All-opener! O All-diffuser! O All-restful!

lines.arabic: يَا مُفَرِّجُ يَا نَاصِرُ يَا مُنْتَصِرُ
lines.transliteration: ya mufarriju ya nasiru ya muntasiru
lines.english: O Bestower of relief! O Helper! O Giver of victory!

lines.arabic: يَا مُدْرِكُ يَا مُهْلِكُ يَا مُنْتَقِمُ
lines.transliteration: ya mudriku ya muhliku ya muntaqimu
lines.english: O Comprehender! O Destroyer! O Avenger!
O Upraiser! O Inheritor!
O Seeker! O Vanquisher!
O He from Whom no fugitive can escape!

lines.arabic: يَا تَوَّابُ يَا اوَّابُ يَا وَهَّابُ
lines.transliteration: ya tawwabu ya awwabu ya wahhabu
lines.english: O All-relenting! O All-forbearing! O All-bestower!
O Originator of all means!
O Opener of all doors!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ حَيْثُ مَا دُعِي اجَابَ
lines.transliteration: ya man haythu ma du`iya ajaba
lines.english: O He Who answers wherever He is called upon!
O All-Pure! O All-thankful!
O Exempter! O Forgiver!
O Light of light!
O Director of all affairs!
O All-subtle! O All-aware!
O Protector! O Illuminator!

lines.arabic: يَا بَصِيرُ يَا ظَهِيرُ يَا كَبِيرُ
lines.transliteration: ya basiru ya zahiru ya kabiru
lines.english: O All-seeing! O All-aiding! O All-great!
O Alone! O Solitary!

lines.arabic: يَا ابَدُ يَا سَنَدُ يَا صَمَدُ
lines.transliteration: ya abadu ya sanadu ya samadu
lines.english: O Eternity without end! O Support! O Everlasting Refuge!
O All-sufficient! O All-healing!
O All-fulfilling! O All-relieving!
O All-kind! O All-gracious!
O All-benevolent! O All-bountiful!
O All-beneficent! O All-solitary!
O He Who is exalted and dominates!
O He Who is master and exercises power!
O He Who is inward and aware!
O He Who is worshipped and thankful!
O He Who is disobeyed and forgives!
O He Who is not encompassed by thoughts,
nor perceived by vision,
and from Whom no trace remains hidden!
O Provider of mankind!
O Determiner of every lot!
O Lofty in place!
O Firm in supports!
O Transformer of times!
O Accepter of sacrifices!
O Lord of graciousness and benevolence!
O Lord of might and force!
O All-compassionate! O All-merciful!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ هُوَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ فِي شَانٍ
lines.transliteration: ya man huwa kulla yawmin fi sha'nin
lines.english: O He Who is every day upon some labor!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ لاَ يَشْغَلُهُ شَانٌ عَنْ شَانٍ
lines.transliteration: ya man la yashghaluhu sha'nun `an sha'nin
lines.english: O He Who is not distracted from one labor by another!
O Tremendous in rank!
O He Who is in every place!
O He Who hears all sounds!
O He Who answers all supplications!
O He Who fulfils all entreaties!
O He Who provides all needs!
O He Who sends down blessings!
O He Who has mercy upon tears!
O He Who annuls slips!
O He Who removes troubles!
O He Who sponsors good things!
O He Who exalts in rank!
O He Who bestows requests!
O He Who gives life to the dead!
O He Who gathers all scattered things!
O He Who is aware of all intentions!
O He Who brings back what has passed away!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ لاَ تَشْتَبِهُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلاصْوَاتُ
lines.english: O He for Whom sounds are never indistinct!
O He Who never becomes annoyed at requests
nor covered by shadows!
O Light of the earth and the heavens!
O Ample in blessings!
O Repeller of adversities!
O Maker of the breaths of life!
O He Who gathers together the nations!
O Healer of illnesses!
O Creator of light and darkness!
O Lord of munificence and generosity!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ لاَ يَطَا عَرْشَهُ قَدَمٌ
lines.english: O He upon Whose Throne no foot treads!
O Most Munificent of the most munificent!
O Most Generous of the most generous!
O Most Hearing of the hearers!
O Most Seeing of the viewers!
O Protector of those who seek protection!
O Sanctuary of the fearful!
O Asylum of the refugees!
O Patron of the believers!
O Helper of those who seek aid!
O Goal of the seekers!
O Companion of every stranger!
O Intimate of everyone alone!
O Refuge of every outcast!
O Shelter of every wanderer!
O Custodian of everyone astray!
O He Who is merciful to old men!
O He Who provides for small infants!
O He Who sets broken bones!
O He Who releases every prisoner!
O He Who enriches the miserable pauper!
O He Who safeguards the fearful seeker of protection!
O He Who governs and determines!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنِ ٱلْعَسِيرُ عَلَيْهِ سَهْلٌ يَسِيرٌ
lines.english: O He for Whom the difficult is simple and easy!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ لاَ يَحْتَاجُ إِلَىٰ تَفْسِيرٍ
lines.transliteration: ya man la yahtaju ila tafsirin
lines.english: O He Who never needs an explanation!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ هُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
lines.transliteration: ya man huwa `ala kulli shay'in qadirun
lines.english: O He Who is powerful over everything!'

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ هُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَبِيرٌ
lines.transliteration: ya man huwa bikulli shay'in khabirun
lines.english: O He Who is aware of everything!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ هُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيءٍ بَصِيرٌ
lines.transliteration: ya man huwa bikulli shay'in basirun
lines.english: O He Who sees everything!
O Sender of the winds!
O Cleaver of the dawn!
O Dispatcher of the spirits!
O Lord of munificence and forbearance!
O He in Whose Hand is every key!
O He Who hears every sound!
O He Who takes precedence over everything that passes away!

lines.arabic: يَا مُحْيِي كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بَعْدَ ٱلْمَوْتِ
lines.transliteration: ya muhyiya kulli nafsin ba`da almawti
lines.english: O He Who gives life to every soul after death!
O my Provision in my hardship!
O my Maintainer in my exile!
O my Intimate in my lonesomeness!
O my Sponsor in my blessings!
O my haven when the ways make me weary,
when relatives give me up
and when every companion forsakes me!

lines.arabic: يَا عِمَادَ مَنْ لاَ عِمَادَ لَهُ
lines.english: O Backing of him who has no backing!

lines.arabic: يَا سَنَدَ مَنْ لاَ سَنَدَ لَهُ
lines.transliteration: ya sanada man la sanada lahu
lines.english: O Support of him who has no support!

lines.arabic: يَا ذُخْرَ مَنْ لاَ ذُخْرَ لَهُ
lines.transliteration: ya dhukhra man la dhukhra lahu
lines.english: O Store of him who has no store!

lines.arabic: يَا حِرْزَ مَنْ لاَ حِرْزَ لَهُ
lines.transliteration: ya hirza man la hirza lahu
lines.english: O Sanctuary of him who has no sanctuary!

lines.arabic: يَا كَهْفَ مَنْ لاَ كَهْفَ لَهُ
lines.transliteration: ya kahfa man la kahfa lahu
lines.english: O Cave of him who has no cave!

lines.arabic: يَا كَنْزَ مَنْ لاَ كَنْزَ لَهُ
lines.transliteration: ya kanza man la kanza lahu
lines.english: O Treasure of him who has no treasure!

lines.arabic: يَا رُكْنَ مَنْ لاَ رُكْنَ لَهُ
lines.transliteration: ya rukna man la rukna lahu
lines.english: O castle of him who has no castle!

lines.arabic: يَا غِيَاثَ مَنْ لاَ غِيَاثَ لَهُ
lines.transliteration: ya ghiyatha man la ghiyatha lahu
lines.english: O Help of him who has no help!

lines.arabic: يَا جَارَ مَنْ لاَ جَارَ لَهُ
lines.transliteration: ya jara man la jara lahu
lines.english: O backer of him who has no backer!
O my Adjacent Neighbor!
O my Sturdy Pillar!
O My God in truth!
O Lord of the Ancient House!
O All-affectionate! O Friend!
Deliver me from the chains of strictures,

lines.arabic: وَٱصْرِفْ عَنِّي كُلَّ هَمٍّ وَغَمٍّ وَضِيقٍ
lines.transliteration: wasrif `anni kulla hammin wa ghammin wa diqin
lines.english: turn away from me every care, grief and distress,
protect me from the evil of that which I cannot bear,
and help me in that which I am able to bear!
O He Who returned Joseph to Jacob!
O He Who removed the affliction of Job!
O He Who forgave the sin of David!

lines.arabic: يَا رَافِعَ عِيسَىٰ بْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَمُنجِيهِ مِنْ ايْدِي ٱلْيَهُودِ
lines.transliteration: ya rafi`a `isa ibni maryama wa munjiyahu min a y di alyahudi
lines.english: O He Who caused Jesus, the son of Mary, to ascend and delivered him from the hands of the Jews!

lines.arabic: يَا مُجِيبَ نِدَاءِ يُونُسَ فِي ٱلظُّلُمَاتِ
lines.transliteration: ya mujiba nida'i yunusa fi alzzulumati
lines.english: O He Who answered Jonah's call in the darkness!
O He Who chose Moses by spoken words!
O He Who forgave Adam his slip
and raised Idris to a high place through his mercy!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ نَجَّىٰ نُوحاً مِنَ ٱلغَرَقِ
lines.transliteration: ya man najja nuhan mina algharaqi
lines.english: O He Who saved Noah from drowning!
O He Who destroyed `ªd, the ancient,
and Thamud, and did not spare them,
and the people of Noah before;

lines.transliteration: innahum kanu hum azlama wa atgha
lines.english: certainly, they were most unjust and more rebellious,
and al-Mu'tafikah, He also overthrew.

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ دَمَّرَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِ لُوطٍ
lines.english: O He Who destroyed the people of Lot
and crushed the people of Shu`ayb!
O He Who took Abraham for a friend!
O You Who took Moses for an object of His words,

lines.arabic: وَٱتَّخَذَ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّىٰ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَعَلَيْهِمْ اجْمَعِينَ حَبِيباً
lines.transliteration: wattkhadha muhammadan salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi wa `alayhim ajma`ina habiban
lines.english: and took Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household, for a beloved!
O He Who gave Luqman wisdom,
and bestowed upon Solomon a kingdom
such as may not befit anyone after him!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ نَصَرَ ذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ عَلىٰ ٱلْمُلُوكِ ٱلْجَبَابِرَةِ
lines.transliteration: ya man nasara dhalqarnayni `ala almuluki aljababirati
lines.english: O He Who gave Dhul-Qarnayn victory over the tyrannical kings!
O He Who gave al-Khadir (eternal) life

lines.arabic: وَرَدَّ لِيُوشَعَ بْنِ نُونٍ ٱلشَّمْسَ بَعْدَ غُرُوبِهَا
lines.transliteration: wa radda liyusha`a bni nunin alshshamsa ba`da ghurubiha
lines.english: and returned the sun to Joshua, the son of Nun, after its setting!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ رَبَطَ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِ امِّ مُوسَىٰ
lines.transliteration: ya man rabata `ala qalbi ummi musa
lines.english: O He Who strengthened the heart of Moses' mother,
and guarded the virginity of Mary, the daughter of `Imran!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ حَصَّنَ يَحْيَىٰ بْنَ زَكَرِيَّا مِنَ ٱلذَّنْبِ
lines.transliteration: ya man hassana yahya ibna zakariyya mina aldhdhanbi
lines.english: O He Who fortified John, the son of Zachariah, against sins
and calmed the anger of Moses!
O He Who gave Zachariah the good news of the birth of John!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ فَدَىٰ إِسْمَاعِيلَ مِنَ ٱلذَّبْحِ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
lines.transliteration: ya man fada isma`ila mina aldhdhabhi bidhibhin `azimin
lines.english: O He Who ransomed Ishmael from the sacrifice with a mighty sacrifice!
O He Who accepted the sacrifice of Abel
and placed a curse upon Cain!

lines.arabic: يَا هَازِمَ ٱلاحْزَابَ لِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
lines.transliteration: ya hazima al-ahzabi limuhammadin salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
lines.english: O He Who routed the parties for Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household!
(please do) Bless Muhammad, the household of Muhammad,

lines.transliteration: wa `ala jami`i almursalina wa mala'ikatika almuqarrabina
lines.english: all the messengers, Your archangels,
and all those who obey You!

lines.arabic: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ مَسْالَةٍ سَالَكَ بِهَا احَدٌ
lines.transliteration: wa as'aluka bikulli mas'alatin sa'alaka biha ahadun
lines.english: I beseech You the supplication of every one who has besought you

lines.arabic: مِمَنْ رَضِيتَ عَنْهُ فَحَتَمْتَ لَهُ عَلىٰ ٱلإِجَابَةِ
lines.english: and with whom You have been pleased and thus decided to grant his request.

lines.arabic: يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ
lines.transliteration: ya allahu ya allahu ya allahu
lines.english: O Allah! O Allah! O Allah!

lines.arabic: يَا رَحْمٰنُ يَا رَحْمٰنُ يَا رَحْمٰنُ
lines.transliteration: ya rahmanu ya rahmanu ya rahmanu
lines.english: O All-merciful! O All-merciful! O All-merciful!

lines.arabic: يَا رَحِيمُ يَا رَحِيمُ يَا رَحِيمُ
lines.transliteration: ya rahimu ya rahimu ya rahimu
lines.english: O All-compassionate! O All-compassionate! O All-compassionate!
O Lord of majesty and honor!
O Lord of majesty and honor!
O Lord of majesty and honor!

lines.arabic: بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ بِهِ
lines.transliteration: bihi bihi bihi bihi bihi bihi bihi
lines.english: By Him! By Him! By Him! By Him! By Him! By Him! By Him!

lines.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ ٱسْمٍ سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ
lines.transliteration: as'aluka bikulli ismin sammayta bihi nafsaka
lines.english: I beseech You by every Name with which You have named Yourself

lines.arabic: اوْ انْزَلْتَهُ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنْ كُتُبِكَ
lines.transliteration: aw anzaltahu fi shay'in min kutubika
lines.english: or which You have sent down in one of Your scriptures

lines.arabic: اوِ ٱسْتَاثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ ٱلَّذِي عِنْدَكَ
lines.english: or kept for Yourself in the knowledge of the Unseen with You,
by the junctures of might for Your Throne,
by the utmost limit of mercy from Your Book,

lines.arabic: وَبِمَا ﴿وَلَوْ انّ َمَا فِي ٱلارْضِ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ اقْلاَمٌ
lines.transliteration: wa bima wa law anna ma fi al-ardi min shajaratin aqlamun
lines.english: by the fact that, “though all the trees in the earth were pens

lines.arabic: وَٱلْبَحْرُ يَمُدُّهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ سَبْعَةُ ابْحُرٍ
lines.transliteration: walbahru yamudduhu min ba`dihi sab`atu abhurin
lines.english: and the sea - seven seas after it to replenish it,
yet the words of Allah not be spent.
Allah is All-mighty, All-wise.”
And I beseech You by Your Most Excellent Names
that You have described in Your book thus saying,

lines.transliteration: wa lillahi al-asma'u alhusna fad`uhu biha
lines.english: “To Allah belong the Most Excellent Names, so call Him by them!”
And You said: “Call upon Me and I will answer you.”

lines.arabic: وَقُلْتَ: ﴿وَإِذَا سَالَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ
lines.transliteration: wa qulta wa idha sa'alaka `ibadi `anni fa'inni qaribun
lines.english: And You said: “And when My servants ask you concerning Me, then surely I am very near;
I answer the prayer of the suppliant when he calls on Me.”

lines.arabic: وَقُلْتَ: ﴿قُلْ يَا عِبَادِي ٱلَّذِينَ اسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ انْفُسِهِمْ
lines.transliteration: wa qulta qul ya `ibadiya alladhina asrafu `ala anfusihim
lines.english: And You said: “Say: O My servants who have been prodigal against yourselves;
do not despair of Allah's mercy.
Surely, Allah forgives all sins.
Surely, He is the All-forgiving, the All-compassionate.”
And I ask You, O my God,
I call You, O my Lord,
I please You, O my Master,

lines.arabic: وَاطْمَعُ فِي إِجَابَتِي يَا مَوْلايَ كَمَا وَعَدتَّنِي
lines.transliteration: wa atma`u fi ijabati ya mawlaya kama wa`adtani
lines.english: and I desire for You to respond to me, O my Protector, just as You have promised me—
for I have called You just as You have commanded me.

lines.arabic: فَٱفْعَلْ بِي مَا انتَ اهْلُهُ يَا كَرِيمُ
lines.transliteration: faf`al bi ma anta ahluhu ya karimu
lines.english: So, do to me what is worthy of You, O All-generous!
All praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.

lines.arabic: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ اجْمَعِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa alihi ajma`ina
lines.english: May Allah bless Muhammad and his entire Household.

title: Dua Mujeer
description: This is a supplication of high eminence which is reported to have been brought by Angel Jibreel for the Holy Prophet (pbuh) when he was engrossed in prayers in Maqam-e-Ibrahim. It is mentioned that the reward for the one reciting it during the Ayyam al-bidh (13th, 14th & 15th day) of the Holy month of Ramadan is that his sins are forgiven even if they are in such plenty as the drops of rain water, leaves of trees or sand of a desert. It is also very effective for the cure of the sick, fulfillment of debts, acquisition of wealth and relief from grief.

Keep us safe from the everlasting fire O Giver of Refuge!
Glory be to You. O Subtle!
Exalted are You. O Noble!
Keep us safe from the everlasting fire O Giver of Refuge!
Glory be to You. O Lord!
Exalted are You. O Truth!
Keep us safe from the everlasting fire O Giver of Refuge!
Glory be to You. O Splendid!
Exalted are You. O Author!
Keep us safe from the everlasting fire O Giver of Refuge!
Glory be to You. O Granter of amnesty!
Exalted are You. O Avenger!
Keep us safe from the everlasting fire O Giver of Refuge!
Glory be to You. O Bountiful!
Exalted are You. O Plentiful!
Keep us safe from the everlasting fire O Giver of Refuge!
Glory be to You. O Clement!
Exalted are You. O Affectionate!
Keep us safe from the everlasting fire O Giver of Refuge!
Glory be to You. O Alone!
Exalted are You. O Single!
Keep us safe from the everlasting fire O Giver of Refuge!
Glory be to You. O Over-Seer!
Exalted are You. O Who surrounds everything!
Keep us safe from the everlasting fire O Giver of Refuge!
Glory be to You. O Protecting Advocate!
Exalted are You. O Justice!
Keep us safe from the everlasting fire O Giver of Refuge!
Glory be to You. O Manifest!
Exalted are You. O Persevering!
Keep us safe from the everlasting fire O Giver of Refuge!
Glory be to You. O Benign!
Exalted are You. O Beloved One!
Keep us safe from the everlasting fire O Giver of Refuge!
Glory be to You. O Who guides on the right path!
Exalted are You. O Who leads on to the true path!
Keep us safe from the everlasting fire O Giver of Refuge!
Glory be to You. O Light!
Exalted are You. O Illuminator!
Keep us safe from the everlasting fire O Giver of Refuge!
Glory be to You. O Ally!
Exalted are You. O Helper!
Keep us safe from the everlasting fire O Giver of Refuge!
Glory be to You. O Patient!
Exalted are You. O Enduring!
Keep us safe from the everlasting fire O Giver of Refuge!
Glory be to You. O Who takes away!
Exalted are You. O Who brings about!
Keep us safe from the everlasting fire O Giver of Refuge!
Glory be to You. O Glorious!
Exalted are You. O Requiter!
Keep us safe from the everlasting fire O Giver of Refuge!
Glory be to You. O Who gives help!
Exalted are You. O Who is called for help!
Keep us safe from the everlasting fire O Giver of Refuge!
Glory be to You. O Splitter!
Exalted are You. O Ever-Present!
Keep us safe from the everlasting fire O Giver of Refuge!
Glory be to You. O Lord of Honor and Grace, invoked for blessings.
O Lord of Might and Majesty, Glory be to You.
There is no god but You.
“Glory be to You. Verily, I have been a wrongdoer.”
“So We heard his prayer and saved him from the anguish
lines.transliteration: fastajabna lahu wa najjaynahu mina alghammi

lines.english: Thus We save believers.”

lines.arabic: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ اجْمَعِينَ
lines.english: Blessings of Allah be on our chief, Muhammad and his Household, one and all.
lines.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala sayyidina muhammadin wa alihi ajma`ina

lines.english: (All) praise be to Allah the Lord of the worlds.
Sufficient for us is Allah. He is the Best Protector.
lines.transliteration: wa hasbuna allahu wa ni`ma alwakilu

lines.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
lines.english: There is no power and no might except (with) Allah, the High, the Great.
lines.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi

title: Dua Adeelah
description: This dua'a contains the articles of faith. Every faithful must recite this dua'a regularly to drive away Shaytan, and to remain firm in the true faith. A dying faithful, in the last moments of life, should recite this dua'a, or , if it is not possible, ask someone else to read it aloud for him or her, so as not to be misled by doubts which may come into the mind, or not to be depressed emotionally, because these forces together with the misleading suggestions of Shaytan, more often than not, in the last hour of life, make man die a death of an infidel or hypocrite.

lines.arabic: ﴿شَهِدَ ٱللَّهُ انَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ
lines.english: “Allah bears witness that there is no god but He,
lines.transliteration: shahida allahu annahu la ilaha illa huwa

lines.english: and (so do) the angels and those possessed of knowledge,
maintaining His creation with justice;

lines.arabic: لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
lines.english: there is no god but He, the Mighty, the Wise.
lines.transliteration: la ilaha illa huwa al`azizu alhakimu

lines.english: Surely, the (true) religion with Allah is Islam.”
I am the slave—feeble, sinful,
disobedient, needy, and ignoble—
I testify to my Benefactor, Creator,
Provider of me with my sustenance, and my Honorer,
as same as He has testified to Himself
and the angels have testified to Him
so have those possessed with knowledge amongst His servants
that there is no god save Him
the Lord of bounties, favors,
generosity, and kindness.
He is Omnipotent, Eternal,
All-knowing, Everlasting,
Ever-living, One and Only,
Self-existent, Endless,
All-hearing, All-Seeing,
Willing, Discriminating,
All-aware, and eternally Besought of all.
He is worthy of all these attributes,

lines.arabic: وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ مَا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ فِي عِزِّ صِفَاتِهِ
lines.english: and He, characterized by all these sublime attributes,
lines.transliteration: wa huwa `ala ma huwa `alayhi fi `izzi sifatihi

lines.arabic: كَانَ قَوْيّاً قَبْلَ وُجُودِ ٱلْقُدْرَةِ وَٱلْقُوَّةِ
lines.english: was All-powerful prior to the existence of might and power,
lines.transliteration: kana qawiyyan qabla wujudi alqudrati walquwwati

lines.arabic: وَكَانَ عَلِيماً قَبْلَ إِيجَادِ ٱلْعِلْمِ وَٱلْعِلَّةِ
lines.english: and All-knowing before the origination of knowledge and reason.
lines.transliteration: wa kana `aliman qabla ijadi al`ilmi wal`illati

lines.arabic: لَمْ يَزَلْ سُلْطَاناً إِذْ لاَ مَمْلَكَةَ وَلاَ مَالَ
lines.english: He has been always Authority when there was neither sovereignty nor wealth.
lines.transliteration: lam yazal sultanan idh la mamlakata wa la mala

lines.arabic: وَلَمْ يَزَلْ سُبْحَاناً عَلَىٰ جَمِيعِ ٱلاحْوَاِل
lines.english: He has been always Glorious under all circumstances.
lines.transliteration: wa lam yazal subhanan `ala jami`i al-ahwali

lines.arabic: وُجُودُهُ قَبْلَ ٱلْقَبْلِ فِي ازَلِ ٱلآزَاِل
lines.english: His Being is before all precedence in the pre-eternity of sempiternity.
lines.transliteration: wujuduhu qabla alqabli fi azali al-azali

lines.arabic: وَبَقَاؤُهُ بَعْدَ ٱلْبَعْدِ مِنْ غَيْرِ ٱنتِقَالٍ وَلاَ زَوَالٍ
lines.english: His Remaining will be after all endings without any extinction or disappearance.
lines.transliteration: wa baqa'uhu ba`da alba`di min ghayri intiqalin wa la zawalin

lines.english: He is self-Sufficient at the beginning and at the end
and All-independent inwardly and outwardly.
There is no injustice in His judgment,
nor is there unfairness in His management,
nor is there unfairness in His administration,
nor is there any escape from His sovereignty,
nor is there any shelter against His firm grip,
nor is there any salvation from His punishment.
His mercy overtakes His Wrath.
None can escape Him when He summons.
lines.transliteration: wa la yafutuhu ahadun idha talabahu

lines.english: He covers all logics for His obligatory decrees,
treats absolutely equally the weak and the noble,
lines.transliteration: wa sawwa alttawfiqa bayna aldda`ifi walshsharifi

lines.english: makes capable to carry out His commands,
and makes easy to abstain from His prohibitions.

lines.arabic: لَمْ يُكَلِّفِ ٱلطَّاعَةَ إِلاَّ دُونَ ٱلْوُسْعِ وَٱلطَّاقَةِ
lines.english: He does not make obedience a burden but according to one's real capacity.
lines.transliteration: lam yukallif altta`ata illa duna alwus`i walttaqati

lines.english: All glory be to Him! How manifest His generosity is!
How sublime His standing is!
All glory be to Him! How magnificent to seek Him is!
How splendid His favors are!
He has sent the Prophets in order to show His justice,
and appointed successors [for the Prophets] in order to make known His munificence and grace.
lines.transliteration: wa nasaba al-awsya'a liyuzhira tawlahu wa fadlahu

lines.english: He has made us of the community of the Chief of Prophets,
lines.transliteration: wa ja`alana min ummati sayyidi al-anbya'i

lines.english: the most favorable of His saints,
the best of His elite ones,
and the most sublime of the pure ones;

lines.arabic: مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ
lines.english: that is Muhammad, may Allah send blessings and benedictions upon him and his Household.
lines.transliteration: muhammadin salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi wa sallama

lines.english: We thus believe in him, in all that to which he has called us,
lines.transliteration: amanna bihi wa bima da`ana ilayhi

lines.english: in the Qur'an which He revealed to him,
and in his Successor whom he appointed on the Ghadir Day
lines.transliteration: wa biwasiyyihi alladhi nasabahu yawma alghadiri

lines.english: and to whom he referred by saying, “This is `Ali.”
I also bear witness that the Imams—the pious
and benign vicegerents [of Allah]
after the Chosen Prophet are:
`Ali, the subduer of the infidels.

lines.arabic: وَمِنْ بَعْدِهِ سَيِّدُ اوْلاَدِهِ ٱلْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ
lines.english: Following him is the chief of his sons, al-Hasan, the son of `Ali.
lines.transliteration: wa min ba`dihi sayyidu awladihi alhasanu ibnu `aliyyin

lines.arabic: ثُمَّ اخُوهُ ٱلسِّبْطُ ٱلتَّابِعُ لِمَرْضَاةِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْحُسَيْنُ
lines.english: Then comes his brother, the grandson and seeker of Allah’s pleasure; al-Husayn.
lines.transliteration: thumma akhuhu alssibtu alttabi`u limardati allahi alhusaynu

lines.english: Then comes `Ali, the [distinctive] worshipper [of Allah].
Then comes the Cleaver (of knowledge), Muhammad.
Then comes the veracious Ja`far.
Then comes the suppressor of rage, Musa.
Then comes the pleased, `Ali.
Then comes the pious, Muhammad.
Then comes the refined, `Ali.
Then comes the pure resident of `Askar, al-Hasan.
Then comes the Argument, Successor, Assumer,
Awaited, Well-guided, and Expected
on account of whose existence, this world is kept in existence,
on account of whose blessing, the created beings are provided sustenance,
and on account of whose existence, the earth and the sky are kept in firmness.

lines.arabic: وَبِهِ يَمْلَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلارْضَ قِسْطاً وَعَدْلاً
lines.english: Through him, Allah shall fill the earth with equity and justice
lines.transliteration: wa bihi yamla'u allahu al-arda qistan wa `adlan

lines.english: after it will be filled with inequity and injustice.
I also bear witness that their words are decisive arguments,
to comply with their orders is obligatory,
the obedience to them is commissioned [by Allah],
to love them is necessary and pre-ordained,
and to pattern after them will definitely achieve salvation,
but to oppose them will definitely bring about destruction.
They are, moreover, the chiefs of all the inhabitants of Paradise,
lines.transliteration: wa hum sadatu ahli aljannati ajma`ina

lines.english: the interceders on the Judgment Day,
and, undoubtedly, the leaders of the inhabitants of the earth,
and the best of the satisfied Successors [of the Prophets].
I also bear witness that death is certain,

lines.arabic: وَمُسَاءَلَةَ مُنْكَرٍ وَنَكِيرٍ فِي ٱلْقَبْرِ حَقٌّ
lines.english: the interrogation by Munkar and Nakir in the grave is certain,
the raising of the dead is certain,
the final assemblage is certain,
the Discriminating Bridge is certain,
the Scales [of deeds] is certain,
the calling into account is certain,
the record book [of deeds] is certain,
Paradise is certain,
Hellfire is certain,

lines.arabic: وَانَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ آتِيَةٌ لاَ رَيْبَ فِيهَا
lines.english: the Hour [of resurrection] will certainly come, without any dispute,
lines.transliteration: wa anna alssa`ata atiyatun la rayba fiha

lines.arabic: وَانَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْعَثُ مَنْ فِي ٱلْقُبُورِ
lines.english: and Allah shall raise up those who are in graves.
lines.transliteration: wa anna allaha yab`athu man fi alquburi

lines.english: O Allah, in Your favor do I put my hope,
Your generosity and mercy do I expect confidently,

lines.arabic: لاَ عَمَلَ لِي اسْتَحِقُّ بِهِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ
lines.english: I have no single deed by which I deserve Paradise,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ طَاعَةَ لِي اسْتَوْجِبُ بِهَا ٱلرِّضْوَانَ
lines.english: nor do I have any act of obedience [to You] due to which I deserve Your pleasure;
lines.transliteration: wa la ta`ata li astawjibu biha alrridwana

lines.english: except that I believe in Your Oneness and Your Justice
and I hope for Your benevolence and Your favor.

lines.arabic: وَتَشَفَّعْتُ إِلَيْكَ بِٱلنَّبِيِّ وَآلِهِ مِنْ احِبَّتِكَ
lines.english: I thus seek the Prophet and his Household, Your most-beloved ones, to intercede for me before You;
lines.transliteration: wa tashaffa`tu ilayka bilnnabiyyi wa alihi min ahibbatika

lines.english: and You are verily the most Generous of all those who treat generously
and the most Merciful of all those who show mercy.
May Allah send blessings to Our Prophet, Muhammad
and upon all of his Household,
the pure and immaculate,
and send upon them many many benedictions.

lines.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
lines.english: There is no might and no power except with Allah, the All-high, the All-great.
lines.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi

lines.english: O Allah! O most Merciful of all those who show mercy,

lines.arabic: إِنِّي اوْدَعْتُكَ يَقِينِي هٰذَا وَثَبَاتَ دِينِي
lines.english: I am depositing with You this faith of mine and my firmness on this belief;
lines.transliteration: inni awda`tuka yaqini hadha wa thabata dini

lines.english: and You are the ever-best of all those who keep deposits.
You have commanded us to keep safe deposits that are put with us;
so, (please) keep for me this deposit to give it back to me at the time of my death
and at the time of the interrogation of Munkar and Nakir;
[I beseech You] in the name of Your mercy; O most Merciful of all those who show mercy.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ ٱلعَدِيلَةِ عِنْدَ ٱلْمَوْتِ
lines.english: O Allah, I seek Your protection against deviation at the hour of death.
lines.transliteration: allahumma inni a`udhu bika mina al`adilati `inda almawti

lines.english: Deviation at the hour of death stands for shifting from the right to the wrong at the hour of death. To explain, Satan attends at the hour of death in order to deceive the moribund and suggest evil to him in order to make him doubt about his religion. If Satan succeeds, he will pull out faith from the heart of the dying person. To avoid that, many supplications have comprised statements of seeking Almighty Allah's protection against deviation at death. Fakhr al-Muhaqqiqin says, "To escape deviation at the hour of death, one should bethink the proofs of creed in which he believes, as well as the five principles of the religion with all of their irrefutable evidences, with absolute sincerity and purity and should then trust them with Almighty Allah beseeching Him for giving them back at the hour of dying. This can be done by saying the following supplicatory prayer:
O Allah, O most Merciful of all those who show mercy,

lines.arabic: إِنِّي قَدْ أَوْدَعْتُكَ يَقِينِي هُذَا وَثَبَاتَ دِينِي
lines.english: I am depositing with You this faith of mine and my firmness on this belief;
lines.transliteration: inni qad awda`tuka yaqini hadha wa thabata dini

lines.english: and You are the ever-best of all those who keep deposits.

lines.arabic: وَ قَدْ آمَرْ تَنَا بِحِفْظِ الْوَدَائِع
lines.english: You have commanded us to keep safe deposits that are put with us;
so, (please) keep for me this deposit to give it back to me at the time of my death

title: Dua Man Ta’abba Tahhaya
description: It is recommended to recite this supplication on Friday. It is narrated that whoever recites this supplication on Friday will be granted the reward of all those who offer prayers on Friday.

lines.english: O Allah, One may call up, prepare,
ready oneself, and stand prepared
for purpose of coming to a creature
in the hope of gaining his aid
and asking for his gift and present.
As for myself, to You—O my Lord—I make my preparations and readiness
hoping for Your pardon
and asking for Your gift and present.
So, (please) do not disappoint my entreaty.

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ لاَ يَخِيبُ عَلَيْهِ سَائِلٌ
lines.english: O He Who never disappoints His beseechers
and Whose prizes never decrease His ample-giving!

lines.arabic: فَإنّي لَمْ آتِكَ ثِقَةً بِعَمَلٍ صَالِحٍ عَمِلْتُهُ
lines.english: I have not come to You with confidence of a righteous deed that I have done
lines.transliteration: fa'inni lam atika thiqatan bi`amalin salihin `amiltuhu

lines.english: nor have I had any hope in a grant of any creature.

lines.arabic: اتَيْتُكَ مُقِرّاً عَلَىٰ نَفْسِي بِٱلإسَاءَةِ وَٱلظُّلْمِ
lines.english: Rather, I have come to You professing myself to be evildoer and transgressor

lines.arabic: مُعْتَرِفاً بِانْ لاَ حُجَّةَ لِي وَلاَ عُذْرَ
lines.english: and confessing that I lack any pretext or excuse.
lines.transliteration: mu`tarifan bi-an la hujjata li wa la `udhra

lines.english: I have come to You hoping for Your great pardon
due to which You have pardoned the wrongdoers.

lines.arabic: فَلَمْ يَمْنَعْكَ طُولُ عُكُوفِهِمْ عَلِي عَظِيمِ ٱلْجُرْمِ
lines.english: Hence, their long-lasting retirement to their grave offenses has not prevented You
from turning to them with mercy.
O He Whose mercy is huge
and Whose pardon is great;

lines.arabic: يَا عَظيـمُ يَا عَظيـمُ يَا عَظيـمُ
lines.english: O All-great, O All-great, O All-great;
nothing can repel Your rage except Your forbearance

lines.arabic: وَلاَ يُنْجِي مِنْ سَخَطِكَ إِلاَّ ٱلتَّضَرُّعُ إِلَيْكَ
lines.english: and nothing can save from Your wrath except imploring earnestly to You.
lines.transliteration: wa la yunji min sakhatika illa alttadarru`u ilayka

lines.english: So, my God, (please) grant me a relief

lines.arabic: بِٱلْقُدْرَةِ ٱلَّتِي تُحْيِي بِهَا مَيْتَ ٱلْبِلاَدِ
lines.english: in the name of the power through which You restore to life the derelict lands,
lines.transliteration: bilqudrati allati tuhyi biha mayta albiladi

lines.arabic: وَلاَ تُهْلِكْنِي غَمّاً حَتَّىٰ تَسْتَجِيبَ لِي
lines.english: and do not cause me to perish out of grief until You respond to me
lines.transliteration: wa la tuhlikni ghamman hatta tastajiba li

lines.english: and show me signs of Your response to my prayers.

lines.arabic: وَاذِقْنِي طَعْمَ ٱلْعَافِيَةِ إلَىٰ مُنَتَهَىٰ اجَلِي
lines.english: (please) Make me taste the flavor of wellbeing up to the end of my lifetime,
lines.transliteration: wa adhiqni ta`ma al`afiyati ila muntaha ajali

lines.english: do not make my enemies gloat over me,
do not give them a hand over me,
and do not make them control over me.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ وَضَعْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَرْفَعُنِي
lines.english: O Allah, If You humiliate me, who can then exalt me?
lines.transliteration: allahumma in wada`tani faman dha alladhi yarfa`uni

lines.arabic: وَإِنْ رَفَعْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَضَعُنِي
lines.english: And if You exalt me, who can then humiliate me?
lines.transliteration: wa in rafa`tani faman dha alladhi yada`uni

lines.arabic: وَإِنْ اهْلَكْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَعْرِضُ لَكَ فِي عَبْدِكَ
lines.english: If You annihilate me, who can then interfere before You concerning the affair of me—Your slave
lines.transliteration: wa in ahlaktani faman dha alladhi ya`ridu laka fi `abdika

lines.english: or who can intercede to ask You about it?

lines.arabic: وَقَدْ عَلِمْتُ انَّهُ لَيْسَ فِي حُكْمِكَ ظُلْمٌ
lines.english: I have already known for sure that Your decrees are devoid of injustice
lines.transliteration: wa qad `alimtu annahu laysa fi hukmika zulmun

lines.english: and Your punishment does not count on immediateness.
Verily, immediateness is the work of him who fears lest he may miss,
lines.transliteration: wa innama ya`jalu man yakhafu alfawta

lines.english: and only do the weak need injustice.
lines.transliteration: wa innama yahtaju ila alzzulmi aldda`ifu

lines.arabic: وَقَدْ تَعَالَيْتَ يَا إِلٰهِي عَنْ ذٰلِكَ عُلُوّاً كَبِيراً
lines.english: As for You, O my God, You are too exalted to be so—Exalted and Great You are beyond all measure!
lines.transliteration: wa qad ta`alayta ya ilahi `an dhalika `uluwwan kabiran

lines.english: O Allah, I take refuge in You; so, (please) have protection upon me!
I call for Your safekeeping; so, (please) keep me under Your security!
I appeal for Your sustenance; so, (please) provide me with sustenance!
I put trust in You; so, (please) keep me under Your supervision!
I call for Your aid against my enemy; so, (please) grant me support!
I seek Your assistance; so, (please) assist me!
I ask for Your forgiveness; so, (please) forgive me.
lines.transliteration: wa astaghfiruka ya ilahi faghfir li

lines.english: So, respond! Respond! Respond!

title: Dua after Ziyarat Aal-e-Yasin
description: This is the supplicatory prayer narrated to be recited immediately after Ziyarat Aal-e-Yasin, focusing on seeking the intercession and reappearance of the Imam of the Age (atfs).

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: O Allah, I beseech You to send blessings upon Muhammad
lines.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka an tusalliya `ala muhammadin

lines.english: the Prophet of Your mercy and the Word of Your Light,
and to fill in my heart with the illumination of certitude,
lines.transliteration: wa an tamla'a qalbi nura alyaqini

lines.english: my chest with the illumination of faith,
my intellect with the illumination of honest intentions,
my determination with the illumination of knowledge,
my strength with the illumination of work,
my tongue with the illumination of honesty,
my religion with the illumination of clear evidence from You,
my sight with the illumination of brightness,
my hearing with the illumination of wisdom,
and my faculty of love with the illumination of sincere loyalty to Muhammad and his Household,
lines.transliteration: wa mawaddati nura almuwalati limuhammadin wa alihi

lines.english: peace be upon them,

lines.arabic: حَتَّىٰ أَلْقَاكَ وَقَدْ وَفَيْتُ بِعَهْدِكَ وَمِيثَاقِكَ
lines.english: so that I, when I meet You, will have fulfilled the pledge and covenant that I made with You
lines.transliteration: hatta alqaka wa qad wafaytu bi`ahdika wa mithaqika

lines.english: and then Your mercy will encompass me.
O Protector! O Worthy of all praise!
O Allah, bless Muhammad (al-Mahdi)
Your argument in Your land,
Your viceroy in Your countries,
the caller to Your course,
the establisher of Your justice,
the revolting by Your command,
the authority of the believers,
the ruiner of the unbelievers,
the remover of the murk,
the illuminator of the truth,
the speaker with wisdom and honesty,
the perfect Word of You in Your lands,
the vigilant and fearful,
the well-wishing saint,
the ark of salvation,
the sign of guidance,
the light of the peoples’ sights,
the best of all those who put clothes on their bodies,
lines.transliteration: wa khayri man taqammasa wa irtada

lines.english: and the unveiler of blindness,
who will fill the lands with justice and equity
as it would be filled up with wrong and unfairness.
You verily have power over all things.
O Allah, bless Your vicegerent
and the son of Your vicegerents the obedience to whom You have made incumbent upon us
and the observance of the right of whom You have made obligatory
and from whom You have removed filth
and whom You have purified with thorough purifying.
O Allah, give him victory and make him the supporter of Your religion
and through him, give victory to Your and his adherents,
followers, and backers.
Include us with them.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِذْهُ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ بَاغٍ وَطَاغٍ
lines.english: O Allah, protect him against the evil of every transgressor and tyrant
lines.transliteration: allahumma a`idhhu min sharri kulli baghin wa taghin

lines.english: and against the evils of all Your creatures.

lines.arabic: وَٱحْفَظْهُ مِنْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ
lines.english: Guard him from ahead of him, behind him,
lines.transliteration: wahfazhu min bayni yadayhi wa min khalfihi

lines.english: his right side, and his left side.

lines.arabic: وَٱحْرُسْهُ وَٱمْنَعْهُ مِنْ أَنْ يوُصَلَ إِلَيْهِ بِسُوءٍ
lines.english: Watch him and defend him against anything that may cause evil to him.
lines.transliteration: wahrus-hu wamna`hu min an yusala ilayhi bisu'in

lines.english: Save through him Your Messenger and the family of Your Messenger.
lines.transliteration: wahfaz fihi rasulaka wa ala rasulika

lines.english: Manifest justice through him.
Aid him with victory.
Help his backers.
Frustrate those who intend to disappoint him.
Terminate those who intend to eradicate him.
And, through him, terminate the tyrants of unbelief,
kill the disbelievers, the hypocrites,
and all atheists,

lines.arabic: حَيْثُ كَانُوٱ مِنْ مَشَارِقِ ٱلأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا
lines.english: wherever they are; in the east or the west of the earth
lines.transliteration: haythu kanu min mashariqi al-ardi wa magharibiha

lines.english: on the lands or in the oceans,
and, through him, fill in the earth with justice,
manifest the religion of Your Prophet,
blessings and peace of You be upon him and his Household,
lines.transliteration: salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi wa sallama

lines.english: make me, O Allah, of his supporters, helpers,
lines.transliteration: waj`alni allahumma min ansarihi wa a`wanihi

lines.english: followers, and adherents;

lines.arabic: وَأَرِنِي فِي آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ مَا يَأْمُلُونَ
lines.english: allow me to see the hopes of the family of Muhammad, peace be upon them, come true,
lines.transliteration: wa arini fi ali muhammadin `alayhim alssalamu ma ya'muluna

lines.english: and the hazards of their enemies come true.
O God of Truth, respond.
O Lord of Glory and Honor!
O most merciful of those who show mercy!

title: Dua after Ziyarat Imam Ali (as)
description: Dua to be recited after the Ziyarat of Imam Ali (as).

lines.english: In his book of al-Mazar, Sayyid ibn Tawus says: Whenever you offer an obligatory or a supererogatory prayer during your residence in the holy shrine of Imam `Ali Amir al-Mu'minin (‘a), you are recommended to say the following supplication:
O Allah, Your determination is surely unavoidable,
Your destiny is unavoidable,
Your act is unavoidable,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa bika
lines.english: and there is no power and no might except with You.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَمَا قَضَيْتَ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ قَضَاءٍ
lines.english: So, O Allah, whatever act You decide on us
and whatever decree You make on us,

lines.transliteration: fa'a`tina ma`ahu sabran yaqharuhu wa yadmaghuhu
lines.english: (please do) grant us along with it patience that repels and fends it off
and make it ascend for our good toward Your Pleasure
so that it shall grow up our rewards, favors,
tributes, honor,
glory, boon,
and dignity in this world as well as the world to come.
And (please) do not lessen our rewards.
O Allah, whatever donation You give us,
whatever virtue You confer on us,
whatever endowment You bestow on us,

lines.transliteration: fa'a`tina ma`ahu shukran yaqharuhu wa yadmaghuhu
lines.english: (please) grant us with it thanksgiving that repels and fends it off.
And make it ascend for our good toward Your Pleasure,
and ascend in our rewards, tribute,
honor, Your boon,
and Your honoring (us) in this world as well as the world to come.

lines.arabic: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْهُ لَنَا أَشَراً وَلاَ بَطَراً
lines.transliteration: wa la taj`alhu lana asharan wa la bataran
lines.english: And (please) do not make it to be for us a source of evil, ungratefulness,

lines.transliteration: wa la fitnatan wa la maqtan
lines.english: seditious matter, hatred,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ عَذَاباً وَلاَ خِزْياً فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa la `adhaban wa la khizyan fi alddunya wal-akhirati
lines.english: torture, or disgrace in this world as well as the world to come.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَثْرَةِ ٱللِّسَانِ
lines.transliteration: allahumma inna na`udhu bika min `athrati allisani
lines.english: O Allah, we do seek Your protection against slips of tongues,
evil situations,
and lightness of the Scale.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
make us meet our the rewards of good deeds at the hours of our death,
do not show us the fruits of our deeds as nothing but regrets,
do not disgrace us when You judge us,

lines.transliteration: wa la tafdahna bisayyi'atina yawma nalqaka
lines.english: do not expose us because of our evildoings on the Day when we shall meet You,

lines.transliteration: waj`al qulubana tadhkuruka wa la tansaka
lines.english: make our hearts remember You always and never forget You,

lines.transliteration: wa takhshaka ka'annaha taraka hatta talqaka
lines.english: make our hears fear You as if they can see You until we meet You,

lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
change our evildoings into good deeds,
make our good deeds to be grades,
change our grades into chambers (in Paradise),
and make our chambers high.
O Allah, (please do) expand the source of sustenance for our poor people

lines.arabic: مِنْ سَعَةِ مَا قَضَيْتَ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِكَ
lines.english: from the expansion that You have taken upon Yourself to make.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
and endue us with true guidance as long as You grant us life,
with honor as long as You keep us alive,
with forgiveness when You decide to cease our lifetime,

lines.arabic: وَٱلْحِفْظِ فِي مَا بَقِيَ مِنْ عُمْرِنَا
lines.english: with protection in the rest of our lifetime,
with blessings in the sustenance that You give us,
with help to carry out what You have burdened us with,
and with steadfastness against what You have imposed on us.
And do not punish us for our wrongdoings,
do not treat us on basis of our lack of knowledge,
do not draw us near to destruction gradually on account of our sins,

lines.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْ أَحْسَنَ مَا نَقُولُ ثَابِتاً فِي قُلُوبِنَا
lines.transliteration: waj`al ahsana ma naqulu thabitan fi qulubina
lines.english: make the best of our words to be firm in our hearts,
make us to be great persons in Your view
but humble ones in our own views,
make that which You have taught us to benefit us,
and increase us with useful knowledge.

lines.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ قَلْبٍ لاََ يَخْشَعُ
lines.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika min qalbin la yakhsha`u
lines.english: And I seek Your protection against a heart that does not submit (to You),
an eye that does not shed tears (for fear of You),
and a prayer that is not admitted (by You).
(Please do) rescue us from the evil seditious matters,
O Manager of this world and the world to come.

title: Dua Faraj (Imam Mahdi)
description: Supplication for the advent of Imam al-Mahdi (ajtfs) and for relief from calamities.

lines.english: O my Lord! The calamity has aggravated; the absence prolonged;
The curtain of modesty has been lifted; hope has been curtailed;
The earth has been narrow; and sky has been denied.
And You are the One from whom help is sought and complaints are made

lines.arabic: وَ عَلَيْكَ الْمُعَوَّلُ فِيْ الشِّدَّةِ وَالرَّخَاءِ
lines.english: And in You we trust in the times of difficulty.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَي مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: Allahumma salli ‘ala Muhammad wa ali Muhammad
lines.english: O Allah! Send blessings upon Muhammad (S) and the progeny of Muhammad (S),

lines.arabic: أُوْلِي الْأَمْرِ الَّذِيْنَ فَرَضْتَ عَلَيْنَا طَا عَتَهُمْ
lines.english: The possessors of authority whose obedience you have enjoined upon us

lines.arabic: وَ عَرَّفْتَنَا بِذَالِكَ مَنْزِلَتَهُمْ ، فَفَّرِجْ عَنَّا بِحَقِّهِمْ فَرَجاً عَاجِلاً قَرِيْباً كَلَمْحِ الْبَصَرِ أَوْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ
lines.transliteration: Wa ‘arraftana bidhalika manzilatahum fafarrij ‘anna bi-haqqihim farajan ‘ajilan qariban kalamhi’l-basari aw huwa aqrab
lines.english: And by that made us aware of their position. Then make open for us, by their truth, an immediate opening, immediate as a wink or sooner.
O Muhammad! O ‘Ali! O ‘Ali! O Muhammad!

lines.arabic: ِكْفِيَانِيْ فَإِنَّكُمَا كَافِيَانِ وَ انْصُرَانِيْ فَإِنَّكُمَا نَاصِرَانِ
lines.transliteration: Ikfiyani fainnakuma kafiyani wa’n-surani fainnakuma nasiran
lines.english: Suffice me both of you as both of you are sufficient. Help me—two of you—for you are my helpers.
O our Master, O Master of the Time!
Help! Help!
Rescue me! Rescue me! Rescue me!
This moment! This moment! This moment!
You may then slap your right thigh with your hand three times and, at each time, say the following words:
Hasten, hasten, hasten!

lines.arabic: يَا أَرْحَمَ لرَّاحِمِيْنَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِهِ الطَّا هِرِيْنَ
lines.transliteration: Ya arhama’r-rahimina bi-haqqi Muhammad wa alihi’t-tahirin
lines.english: O Most Merciful of the Merciful, For the sake of Muhammad (S) and his holy progeny.

sections.title: Salat-Dua
sections.prelude:
Sayyed Ibn Taawoos (a.r.) mentions, ‘The prayers of al-Hujjah al-Qaem (a.t.f.s.) consists of two rak’ats.
In each unit, Surah al-Hamd is recited, and the verse below within Sura Hamd is repeated 100 times;

lines.english: You do we worship, and Yours aid we seek.
After completion of the Salat recite this Dua faraj
O Allah, unbearable is our tribulation!
The hidden has been disclosed!
The cover has been exposed!

lines.transliteration: wa daqat al-ardu bima wasa`at alssama'u
lines.english: The earth has become too narrow to carry that which could be embraced by the sky.
To You, my Lord, is the complaint
and in You is the trust in sorrow and in joy.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
whom You have commanded us to obey,
and hasten their Relief through the Rising Imam among them;
and make manifest Your fortifying him.
O Muhammad! O `Ali!
O `Ali! O Muhammad!
Save me, for you both are true saviors of me.
Aid me, for you both are true aides of me.
Protect me, for you both are true protectors of me.
O my master, the Patron of the Age!
Help, help, help!
[come to] succor me, [come to] succor me, [come to] succor me!
[grant me] security, [grant me] security, [grant me] security!

sections.title: Full text for fulfillment of needs
sections.prelude: One who has a need should perform Ghusl on Friday eve after midnight, and come to the place of prayers and perform two rakats prayer and in the first rakat he should recite Surah al-Hamd and when he reaches: “Iyyaka Na’budoo we iyyaka Nastaeen”, repeat this a hundred times.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اِنْ اَطَعْتُكَ فَالْمَحْمَدَةُ لَكَ، وَ إِنْ عَصَيْتُكَ فَالْحُجَّةُ لَكَ، مِنْكَ الرَّوْحُ وَ مِنْكَ الْفَرَجُ، سُبْحَانَ مَنْ اَنْعَمَ وَ شَكَرَ سُبْحَانَ مَنْ قَدَّرَ وَ غَفَرَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتُ عَصَيْتُكَ فَإنِّیْ قَدْ اَطَعْتُكَ فِىْ اَحَبِّ اْلاَشْيَاءِ إِلَيْكَ وَ هُوَ الإِيْمَانُ بِكَ لَمْ اَتَّخِذْ لَك وَلَدًا وَّ لَمْ اَدْعُ لَك شَرِيْكًا مَنًّا مِنْكَ بِهِ عَلَىَّ لاَ مَنَّا مِنِّیْ بِهِ عَلَيْكَ وَ قَدْ عَصَيْتُكَ يَا إِلٰهِىْ عَلٰی غَيْرِ وَجْهِ الْمُكَابَرَةِ وَ لاَ الْخُرُوْجِ عَنْ عُبُوْدِيَّتِكَ وَ لاَ الْجُحُوْدِ لِرُبُوْبِيَّتِكَ وَ لٰكِنْ اَطَعْتُ هَوٰاىَ وَ اَزَلَّنِيْ الشَّيْطَانُ فَلَكَ الْحُجَّةُ عَلَىَّ وَ الْبَيَانُ فَإِنْ تُعَذِّبْنِيْ فَبِذُنُوْبِىْ غَيْرُ ظَالِمٍ لِىْ، وَ إِنْ تَغْفِرْ لِىْ وَ تَرْحَمْنِيْ فَإِنَّكَ جَوَادٌ كَرِيْمٌ.
