lines.transliteration: Allaahumma in at’a’tuka fal mah’madatu lak, wa in as’aytuka fal h’ujjatu laka minka rrawh’u wa minkal faraju subh’ana man an’ama wa shakara subh’aana man qaddara wa ghafara Allaahumma in kuntu as’aytuka fa innee qad at’a’tuka fee ah’abbil ashyaa-i ilaika wa huwal eemaanu bika lam attakhidh laka waladan wa lam ad’u laka shareekam mannam minka bihi ‘alayya laa mannam minnee bihi ‘alaika wa qad as’aituka ya ilaahdee ‘ala ghairi wajhil mukaabarati walaa alkhurooji ‘an ‘uboodiyyatika wa laal ju’hoodi liruboobiyyatika wa laakin at’a’tu hawaaya wa azallanish shait’aanu falaka alh’ujjatu ‘alayya wal bayaan. Fa-in tu’adh-dhibnee fabidhunoobee ghaira zaalimil llee wa-in taghfirlee wa tarh’amnee fa-innaka jawaadun kareem.
lines.english: O Allah, if I obey You, then the essence of praise is for You; and if I disobey You, then You have the argument against me. From You comes ease and relief. Glory be to One Who bestows and thanks; Glory be to One Who ordains and forgives. O Allah, if I have disobeyed You, I have indeed obeyed You in the thing most beloved to You, which is faith in You; I have not taken for You a son, nor have I called out to a partner with You, as a favor from You to me, not as a favor from me to You. And I have disobeyed You, O my God, not by way of arrogance, nor by departing from Your servitude, nor by denying Your Lordship, but I followed my desires and Satan made me slip. So You have the argument and the explanation against me. If You punish me, it is because of my sins and You are not unjust to me; and if You forgive me and have mercy on me, then You are Generous and Kind.

lines.arabic: يَا كَرِيْمُ يَا كَرِيْمُ يَا كَرِيْمُ...
lines.english: Keep repeating 'Ya Kareem' until you lose your breath.

lines.arabic: يَا آمِنًا مِنْ كُلِّ شَیْءٍ وَ كُلُّ شَىْءٍ مِنْكَ خَائِفٌ حَذِرٌ اَسْاَلُكَ بِاَمْنِكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَ خَوْفِ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مِنْك اَنْ تُصَلِّىَ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اَنْ تُعْطِيَنِيْ اَمَانًا لِنَفْسِىْ وَ اَهْلِىْ وَ وَلَدِىْ وَ سَائِرِ مَا اَنْعَمْتَ بِهِ عَلَىَّ حَتَّی لاَ اَخَافَ وَ لاَ اَحْذَرَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ اَبَدًا إِنَّكَ عَلٰی كُلِّ شَیْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ وَ حَسْبُنَا اللهُ وَ نِعْمَ الْوَكِيْلُ يَا كَافِىَ إبْرَاهِيْمَ نَمُوْدَ وَ يَا كَافِىَ مُوْسٰی فِرْعَوْنَ اَسْاَلَُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّىَ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَنْ تَكْفِيَنِيْ شَرَّ فُلاَنَ بْنَ فُلاَنٍ.
lines.transliteration: Yaa aaminam min kulli shai-in wa kullu shai-im minka khaa-ifun h’adhir. As-aluka bi-aminika min kulli shai-in wa khaufi kulli shai-im minka an tus’alliya ‘ala Muh’ammadin wa aali Muh’ammmadin wa an tu’tiyani amaanan linafsee wa ahlee wa waladee wa saa-iri maa an-’amta bihi ‘alaiyya h’atta laa akhaafa walaa ah’dhara min shai-in abadaa. Innaka ‘ala kulli shai-in qadeer. Wa h’asbunallaahu wa ni’mal wakeel. yaa kaafiya ibraaheema namrooda wa yaa kaafiya moosa fir-’auna as’aluka an tus’alliya ‘alaa Muh’ammadi wa aali Muh’ammadin an takfiyanee sharra (mention someone's name) bin (father's name).
lines.english: O One Who is safe from everything and everything is fearful of Him. I ask You by Your safety from everything and the fear of everything from You to send blessings upon Muhammad and the progeny of Muhammad and that You give me safety for myself, my family, my children and all that You have bestowed upon me so that I may not fear nor be cautious of anything forever. Surely You have power over all things. And Allah is sufficient for us and Excellent is the Disfenser of affairs. O Sufficer of Abraham against Nimrod, and O Sufficer of Moses against Pharaoh, I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad and that You suffice me from the evil of (mention name) son of (father's name).

title: Dua Asharaat
description: It is narrated that this supplication was taught by Imam Ali (a.s.) to his son Imam Husayn (a.s.). It is highly recommended to be recited during the afternoons of Fridays.

lines.english: All Glory be to Allah,
all praise be to Allah,
there is no god save Allah,
Allah is the Greatest,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
lines.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi
lines.english: there is neither power nor might save with Allah, the Most High, the All-magnificent.

lines.arabic: سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ آنَاءَ ٱللَّيْلِ وَاطْرَافَ ٱلنَّهَارِ
lines.transliteration: subhana allahi ana'a allayli wa atrafa alnnahari
lines.english: Glory be to Allah in hours of the night and at the two ends of the day.
Glory be to Allah in the morning and the evening hours.
Glory be to Allah in the early hours of night and morning.

lines.arabic: سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ
lines.transliteration: subhana allahi hina tumsuna wa hina tusbihuna
lines.english: Glory be to Allah when you enter the night and when you enter the morning.

lines.transliteration: wa lahu alhamdu fi alssamawati wal-ardi
lines.english: Unto Him be praise in the heavens, the earth,
at the sun's decline, and in the noonday.
He brings forth the living from the dead,
brings forth the dead from the living,
revives the earth after its death,
and even so will you be brought forth.

lines.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
lines.english: Glorified be Your Lord, the Lord of Majesty, from that which they attribute (to Him).
Peace be upon the Messengers.
All praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.
Glory be to the Lord of Kingdom and Realm.
Glory be to the Lord of Majesty and Magnificence.
Glory be to the Lord of Greatness and Magnitude;
the True Sovereign, the Guardian, and the Holy.

lines.arabic: سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَلِكِ ٱلْحَيِّ ٱلَّذِي لاَ يَمُوتُ
lines.transliteration: subhana allahi almaliki alhayyi alladhi la yamutu
lines.english: Glory be to Allah, the Sovereign, the Ever-living Who never dies.
Glory be to Allah, the Ever-living, the Holy.
Glory be to the Self-Existent, the Eternal.
Glory be to the Eternal, the Self-Existent.
Glory be to my Lord, the Most Great.
Glory be to my Lord, the Most High.
Glory be to the Ever-living, the Self-Existent.
Glory be to the Exalted, the Most High.
Glory be to Him, and Exalted be Him.
Glorified (is He), Holy (is He),
Our Lord, and the Lord of the angels and the Spirit.
Glory be to the Eternal Who never forgets.
Glory be to the All-knowing Who does not need teaching.

lines.arabic: سُبْحَانَ خَالِقِ مَا يُرَىٰ وَمَا لاَ يُرَىٰ
lines.transliteration: subhana khaliqi ma yura wa ma la yura
lines.english: Glory be to the Creator of all seen and unseen beings.
Glory be to Him Who comprehends all visions,
but visions cannot comprehend Him,
and He is the Knower of subtleties, the Aware.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اصْبَحْتُ مِنْكَ فِي نِعْمَةٍ وَخَيْرٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma inni asbahtu minka fi ni`matin wa khayrin
lines.english: O Allah, I begin my day covered with grace and favor from You
as well as blessing and good health.
So, (please) bless Muhammad and his Household,
make perfect Your grace and favor for me
as well as Your blessings and good health,
through redemption from Hellfire,
grant me thanksgiving to You, enjoyment of wellbeing from You,

lines.transliteration: wa fadlaka wa karamataka abadan ma abqaytani
lines.english: Your grace, and Your honor permanently so long as You decide to keep me alive.
O Allah, only by Your Light have I been guided,
only by Your grace have I been opulent,
and only by Your grace have I lived in eves and morns.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اشْهِدُكَ وَكَفَىٰ بِكَ شَهِيداً
lines.transliteration: allahumma inni ush-hiduka wa kafa bika shahidan
lines.english: O Allah, I ask You to witness for me, and You are surely sufficient as a witness,

lines.transliteration: wa ush-hidu mala'ikataka wa anbiya'aka wa rusulaka
lines.english: and I also choose as witnesses Your angels, Prophets, Messengers,

lines.transliteration: wa hamalata `arshika wa sukkana samawatika wa ardika
lines.english: the bearers of Your Throne, the inhabitants of Your heavens and earth,
and all Your creatures,

lines.arabic: بِانَّكَ انْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ
lines.transliteration: bi'annaka anta allahu la ilaha illa anta
lines.english: that You are Allah, there is no god save You,
One and Only Lord, having no partner,

lines.arabic: وَانَّ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
lines.transliteration: wa anna muhammadan salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi `abduka wa rasuluka
lines.english: and that Muhammad, peace be upon him and his Household, is Your servant and Messenger,

lines.arabic: وَانَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْ ءٍ قَدِيرٌ
lines.english: and that You have power over all things;

lines.transliteration: tuhyi wa tumitu wa tumitu wa tuhyi
lines.english: You grant life and cause to die and You cause to die and grant life;
and I witness that Paradise is true,
Hellfire is true,
Resurrection is true,
the Hour is coming, there is no doubt about it,

lines.arabic: وَانَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْعَثُ مَنْ فِي ٱلْقُبُورِ
lines.transliteration: wa anna allaha yab`athu man fi alquburi
lines.english: and Allah shall raise up those who are in graves.

lines.arabic: وَاشْهَدُ انَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ ابِي طَالِبٍ امِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَقّاً حَقّاً
lines.transliteration: wa ash-hadu anna `aliyya bna abi talibin amiru almu'minina haqqan haqqan
lines.english: I also witness that `Ali the son of Abu-Talib is truly the commander of the faithful, indeed,

lines.arabic: وَانَّ ٱلائِمَّةَ مِنْ وُلْدِهِ هُمُ ٱلائِمَّةُ ٱلْهُدَاةُ ٱلْمَهْدِيُّونَ
lines.transliteration: wa anna al-a'immata min wuldihi hum al-a'immatu alhudatu almahdiyyuna
lines.english: the Imams from his offspring are the guides, leaders, and well-guided,
neither straying off nor misleading,
and they are Your chosen representatives,
Your triumphant party,

lines.transliteration: wa sifwatuka wa khiyaratuka min khalqika
lines.english: Your choice, the most favorable of all Your creatures,
the superior ones whom You have selected for Your religion,
decided on from among Your beings,
chosen from among Your servants,
and made Claims against all beings.

lines.arabic: صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱلسَّلاَمُ وَرَحْمَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
lines.transliteration: salawatuka `alayhim wa alssalamu wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
lines.english: May Your consent, peace, mercy, and blessings be upon them.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ٱكْتُبْ لِي هٰذِهِ ٱلشَّهَادَةَ عِنْدَكَ
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) certify this witness for me with You

lines.arabic: حَتَّىٰ تُلَقِّنَنِيهَا يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ وَانْتَ عَنِّي رَاضٍ
lines.transliteration: hatta tulaqqinaniha yawma alqiyamati wa anta `anni radin
lines.english: so that You shall give it back to me on the Resurrection Day while You are pleased with me.
Verily, You have power over all that which You will.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ حَمْداً يَصْعَدُ اوَّلُهُ وَلاَ يَنْفَدُ آخِرُهُ
lines.transliteration: allahumma laka alhamdu hamdan yas`adu awwaluhu wa la yanfadu akhiruhu
lines.english: O Allah, to You be praise the first of which ascends while its end is infinite.

title: Dua Ya Shahida Kulle Najwa
description: Recommended to be recited on Friday nights.

lines.english: O Witness of every secret!
O Knower of every hidden thing!
O destination of every complaint!
O Goal of every need!
O He Who instigates favoring on the Servants!
O He Who is All-generous in pardoning!
O He Who is All-excellent in overlooking!
O All-magnanimous!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَا يُوَارِي مِنْهُ لَيْلٌ دَاجٍ
lines.transliteration: ya man la yuwari minhu laylun dajin
lines.english: O He Who cannot be concealed by the covering darkness of night,
the roaring clamor of oceans,
the skies along with their constellations,
or the thunderous murk.
O He with Whom the entire murk is light,
I beseech You in the name of the brightness of Your Noble Face

lines.arabic: ٱلَّذِي تَجَلَّيْتَ بِهِ لِلْجَبَلِ فَجَعَلْتَهُ دَكّاً
lines.transliteration: alladhi tajallayta bihi liljabali faja`altahu dakkan
lines.english: through which You manifested Your glory to the mountain; so, You made it crumble
and (Prophet) Moses fell down in a swoon,

lines.arabic: وَبِٱسْمِكَ ٱلَّذِي رَفَعْتَ بِهِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ بِلاَ عَمَدٍ
lines.transliteration: wa bismika alladhi rafa`ta bihi alssamawati bila`amadin
lines.english: in the name of Your Name by which You raised the heavens without any pillars

lines.arabic: وَسَطَحْتَ بِهِ ٱلارْضَ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِ مَاءٍ جَمَدٍ
lines.transliteration: wa satahta bihi al-arda `ala wajhi ma'in jamadin
lines.english: and by which You flattened the earth on the surface of solid water,
in the name of Your Name—the concealed, the stored,
the scribed, and the pure,
which You answer any one who beseeches You in its name
and grant any one who asks You his request,
in the name of Your Name; the Praised, Holy, and Demonstrative,

lines.arabic: ٱلَّذِي هُوَ نُورٌ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ نُورٍ
lines.english: which is light over the entire light,
which is light made of light,
and from which all lights take their brightness;
if it reaches the earth, it will be rent asunder,
if it reaches the heavens, they will be opened,
and if it reaches the throne, it will quiver;

lines.arabic: وَبِٱسْمِكَ ٱلَّذِي تَرْتَعِدُ مِنْهُ فَرَائِصُ مَلائِكَتِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa bismika alladhi tarta`idu minhu fara'isu mala'ikatika
lines.english: and in the name of Your Name from the fear of which the muscles of Your angels tremble.

lines.transliteration: wa as'aluka bihaqqi jabra'ila wa mika'ila wa israfila
lines.english: I beseech You in the name of [Archangels] Gabriel, Michael, and Seraph,
in the name of Muhammad, the Divinely-chosen Prophet,
peace be upon him, his Household,

lines.transliteration: wa `ala jami`i al-anbiya'i wa jami`i almala'ikati
lines.english: and all prophets and angels;

lines.arabic: وَبِٱلاِﹾسْمِ ٱلَّذِي مَشَىٰ بِهِ ٱلْخِضْرُ عَلَىٰ قُلَلِ ٱلْمَاءِ
lines.transliteration: wa bilismi alladhi masha bihi alkhidru `ala qulali alma'i
lines.english: in the name of the Name through which al-Khadir could walk on waters

lines.arabic: كَمَا مَشَىٰ بِهِ عَلَىٰ جَدَدِ ٱلارْضِ
lines.english: just as he used to walk on lands;

lines.arabic: وَبِٱسْمِكَ ٱلَّذِي فَلَقْتَ بِهِ ٱلبَحْرَ لِمُوسَىٰ
lines.transliteration: wa bismika alladhi falaqta bihi albahra limusa
lines.english: in the name of You Name through which You caused the sea to cleave asunder for Moses,
You drowned Pharaoh and his people,

lines.arabic: وَانْجَيْتَ بِهِ مُوسَىٰ بْنَ عِمْرَانَ وَمَنْ مَعَهُ
lines.transliteration: wa anjayta bihi musa bna `imrana wa man ma`ahu
lines.english: and saved Moses, the son of `Imran, and those who accompanied him;

lines.arabic: وَبِٱسْمِكَ ٱلَّذِي دَعَاكَ بِهِ مُوسَىٰ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ
lines.transliteration: wa bismika alladhi da`aka bihi musa bnu `imrana
lines.english: in the name of Your Name by which Moses, the son of `Imran, besought You
from the right slope of the Mount;

lines.arabic: فَٱسْتَجَبْتَ لَهُ وَالْقَيْتَ عَلَيْهِ مَحَبَّةً مِنْكَ
lines.transliteration: fastajabta lahu wa alqayta `alayhi mahabbatan minka
lines.english: so, You responded to him and cast down upon him love from You;

lines.arabic: وَبِٱسْمِكَ ٱلَّذِي بِهِ احْيَا عِيسَىٰ بْنُ مَرْيَمَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
lines.transliteration: wa bismika alladhi bihi ahya `isa bnu maryama almawta
lines.english: in the name of Your Name by which Jesus, the son of Mary, brought life to the dead,
could speak while he was a child in the cradle,
and healed the blind and the leprous by Your permission;

lines.arabic: وَبِٱسْمِكَ ٱلَّذِي دَعَاكَ بِهِ حَمَلَةُ عَرْشِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa bismika alladhi da`aka bihi hamalatu `arshika
lines.english: in the name of Your Name by which the bearers of Your Throne besought You

lines.transliteration: wa jabra'ilu wa mika'ilu wa israfilu
lines.english: and so did Gabriel, Michael, Seraph,

lines.arabic: وَحَبِيبُكَ مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa habibuka muhammadun salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
lines.english: Muhammad Your most beloved one (peace be upon him and upon his Household)
Your favorite angels,
Your messaged Prophets,

lines.arabic: وَعِبَادُكَ ٱلصَّالِحُونَ مِنْ اهْلِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلارَضِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa `ibaduka alssalihuna min ahli alssamawati wal-aradina
lines.english: and Your righteous servants from among the inhabitants of the heavens and the layers of the earth;

lines.arabic: وَبِٱسْمِكَ ٱلَّذِي دَعَاكَ بِهِ ذُو ٱلنُّونِ
lines.transliteration: wa bismika alladhi da`aka bihi dhu alnnuni
lines.english: in the name of Your Name by which Dhu’l-Nun (Prophet Jonah) besought You

lines.arabic: إِذْ ذَهَبَ مُغَاضِباً فَظَنَّ انْ لَنْ تَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ
lines.transliteration: idh dhahaba mughadiban fazanna an lan taqdira `alayhi
lines.english: when he departed in wrath: he imagined that You had no power over him,

lines.arabic: فَنَادَىٰ فِي ٱلظُّلُمَاتِ انْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ
lines.transliteration: fanada fi alzzulumati an la ilaha illa anta subhanaka
lines.english: but he cried through the depths of darkness, “There is no god but You. Glory be to You.
I was indeed one of those who are wrong!”

lines.transliteration: fastajabta lahu wa najjaytahu min alghammi
lines.english: So, You responded to him and delivered him from the grief
and thus do You deliver the believers;

lines.arabic: وَبِٱسْمِكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ ٱلَّذِي دَعَاكَ بِهِ دَاوُودُ
lines.transliteration: wa bismika al`azimi alladhi da`aka bihi dawudu
lines.english: in the name of Your Great Name by which David besought You

lines.arabic: وَخَرَّ لَكَ سَاجِداً فَغَفَرْتَ لَهُ ذَنْبَهُ
lines.transliteration: wa kharra laka sajidan faghafarta lahu dhanbahu
lines.english: and as he fell down prostrating himself to You, You rectified it for him;

lines.arabic: وَبِٱسْمِكَ ٱلَّذِي دَعَتْكَ بِهِ آسِيَةُ ٱمْرَاةُ فِرْعَوْنَ
lines.transliteration: wa bismika alladhi da`atka bihi asiyatu imra'atu fir`awna
lines.english: in the name of Your Name by which ªsiyah, the wife of Pharaoh, besought You,

lines.arabic: إِذْ قَالَتْ: ”رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِي عِنْدَكَ بَيْتاً فِي ٱلْجَنَّةِ
lines.transliteration: idh qalat rabbi ibni li `indaka baytan fi aljannati
lines.english: saying, “My Lord! Build for me a house with You in Paradise,
deliver me from Pharaoh and his doing,
and deliver me from the unjust people.”
So, You responded to her prayer;

lines.arabic: وَبِٱسْمِكَ ٱلَّذِي دَعَاكَ بِهِ ايُّوبُ إِذْ حَلَّ بِهِ ٱلْبَلاَءُ
lines.transliteration: wa bismika alladhi da`aka bihi ayyubu idh halla bihi albala'u
lines.english: in the name of Your Name by which (Prophet) Job besought You after misfortune had befallen him;

lines.transliteration: fa`afaytahu wa ataytahu ahlahu wa mithlahum ma`ahum
lines.english: so, You healed him and gave him his family and the like of them with them:
a mercy from You and a reminder to the worshippers;

lines.transliteration: wa bismika alladhi da`aka bihi ya`qubu
lines.english: in the name of Your Name by which (Prophet) Jacob besought You;

lines.arabic: فَرَدَدْتَ عَلَيْهِ بَصَرَهُ وَقُرَّةَ عَيْنِهِ يُوسُفَ وَجَمَعْتَ شَمْلَهُ
lines.transliteration: faradadta `alayhi basarahu wa qurrata `aynihi yusufa wa jama`ta shamlahu
lines.english: so, You returned to him his sight and the delight of his heart, Joseph, and You reunified him.

lines.transliteration: wa bismika alladhi da`aka bihi sulaymanu
lines.english: in the name of Your Name by which (Prophet) Solomon besought You;

lines.arabic: فَوَهَبْتَ لَهُ مُلْكاً لاَ يَنْبَغِي لاحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ
lines.transliteration: fawahabta lahu mulkan la yanbaghi li'ahadin min ba`dihi
lines.english: So, You gifted him kingdom that none else should never gain,
for You are verily the Granter of bounties;

lines.arabic: وَبِٱسْمِكَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرْتَ بِهِ ٱلْبُرَاقَ لِمُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: wa bismika alladhi sakhkharta bihi alburaqa limuhammadin
lines.english: in the name of Your Name by which You subdued the Buraq to Muhammad,

lines.transliteration: salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi wa sallama
lines.english: peace and blessings be upon him and his Household,

lines.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ تَعَالَىٰ: ”سُبْحَانَ ٱلَّذِي اسْرَىٰ بِعَبْدِهِ لَيْلاً
lines.transliteration: idh qala ta`ala subhana alladhi asra bi`abdihi laylan
lines.english: as Almighty Allah says, “Glory be to Him Who made His servant to go on a night

lines.arabic: مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ إِلَىٰ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلاقْصَىٰ“
lines.transliteration: min almasjidi alharami ila almasjidi al-aqsa
lines.english: from the Sacred Mosque to the remote mosque.”

lines.arabic: وَقَوْلُهُ: ”سُبْحَانَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa qawluhu subhana alladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinina
lines.english: He also says, “Glory be to Him Who made this subservient to us and we were not able to do it.
Surely, to our Lord we must return;”

lines.arabic: وَبِٱسْمِكَ ٱلَّذِي تَنَزَّلَ بِهِ جَبْرَائِيلُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: wa bismika alladhi tanazzala bihi jabra'ilu `alamuhammadin
lines.english: in the name of Your Name by which (Archangel) Gabriel used to ascend to Muhammad,
peace be upon him and his Household;

lines.transliteration: wa bismika alladhi da`aka bihi adamu
lines.english: and in the name of Your Name by which Adam besought You;

lines.transliteration: faghafarta lahu dhanbahu wa askantahu jannataka
lines.english: so, You rectified him and allowed him to dwell in Your Paradise.
I beseech You in the name of the Great Qur'an,
in the name of Muhammad, the Seal of the Prophets,
in the name of Abraham,
in the name of Your Judgment on the Day of the Administration of Justice,
in the name of the Scales when they shall be set up,
the Scrolls when they shall be laid open,

lines.transliteration: wa bihaqqi alqalami wa ma jara
lines.english: the Pen and whatever has been decided,
and the Tablet and whatever it has recorded;

lines.arabic: وَبِحَقِّ ٱلاِﹾسْمِ ٱلَّذِي كَتَبْتَهُ عَلَىٰ سُرَادِقِ ٱلْعَرْشِ
lines.transliteration: wa bihaqqi alismi alladhi katabtahu `ala suradiqi al`arshi
lines.english: in the name of the Name that You had inscribed on the pavilion of the Divine Throne
two thousand years before You created the beings, the world,
the sun, and the moon.

lines.arabic: وَاشْهَدُ انْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ
lines.transliteration: wa ashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu
lines.english: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah,
alone without having any partner,
and that Muhammad is his servant and messenger.

lines.transliteration: wa as'aluka bismika almakhzuni fi khaza'inika
lines.english: I beseech You in the name of Your Name that is hoarded in Your stores,

lines.arabic: ٱلَّذِي ٱسْتَاثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ
lines.english: You have kept in the knowledge of the Unseen with You

lines.arabic: لَمْ يَظْهَرْ عَلَيْهِ احَدٌ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
lines.english: and it has not been shown to any of Your creatures,
be him a favorite angel,
a missioned Prophet,
or a chosen servant.

lines.arabic: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِٱسْمِكَ ٱلَّذِي شَقَقْتَ بِهِ ٱلْبِحَارَ
lines.transliteration: wa as'aluka bismika alladhi shaqaqta bihi albihara
lines.english: I beseech You in the name of Your Name by which You rent asunder the oceans,
the mountains rose,
and night and day follow each other,

lines.transliteration: wa bihaqqi alssab`i almathani walqur'ani al`azimi
lines.english: in the name of the seven of the oft-repeated verses and the Grand Qur'an,
in the name of the noble, recording angels,

lines.transliteration: wa bihaqqi ta-ha wa ya-sin wa kaf-ha-ya-`ayn-sad
lines.english: in the name of Ta-Ha, Ya-Sin, Kaf-Ha-Ya-`Ayn-Sad,
Ha-Mim-`Ayn-Sin-Qaf,
and in the name of the Torah of Moses,
the Gospel of Jesus,
the Psalms of David,
the Furqan (Criterion) of Muhammad,
peace be upon him, his Household,

lines.transliteration: wa `ala jami`i alrrusuli wa bahiyyan sharahiyyan
lines.english: and all the messengers and bahiyya sharahiyya.([1])

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ تِلْكَ ٱلْمُنَاجَاةِ
lines.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka bihaqqi tilka almunajati
lines.english: O Allah, I beseech You in the name of this confidential talk

lines.arabic: ٱلَّتِي كَانَتْ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ مُوسَىٰ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ
lines.transliteration: allati kanat baynaka wa bayna musa bni `imrana
lines.english: which took place between You and Moses, the son of `Imran,
on the Mount Tur Sayna',

lines.arabic: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِٱسْمِكَ ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمْتَهُ مَلَكَ ٱلْمَوْتِ لِقَبْضِ ٱلارْوَاحِ
lines.transliteration: wa as'aluka bismika alladhi `allamtahu malaka almawti liqabdi al-arwahi
lines.english: I beseech You in the name of Your Name which You taught the Angel of Death so that he would be able to grasp the souls,

lines.arabic: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِٱسْمِكَ ٱلَّذِي كُتِبَ عَلَىٰ وَرَقِ ٱلزَّيْتُونِ
lines.transliteration: wa as'aluka bismika alladhi kutiba `ala waraqi alzzaytuni
lines.english: I beseech You in the name of Your Name which was written on the leaves of olive-trees;
so, fires subdued to these leaves

lines.transliteration: faqulta ya naru kuni bardan wa salaman
lines.english: after You said, “O fire! Be a comfort and peace,”

lines.arabic: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِٱسْمِكَ ٱلَّذِي كَتَبْتَهُ عَلَىٰ سُرَادِقِ ٱلْمَجْدِ وَٱلْكَرَامَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa as'aluka bismika alladhi katabtahu `ala suradiqi almajdi walkaramati
lines.english: and I beseech You in the name of Your Name that You wrote on the canopies of Glory and Dignity.
O He Who cannot be annoyed by any beseecher
He Who cannot be influenced by any reward (that He presents)!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ بِهِ يُسْتَغَاثُ وَإِلَيْهِ يُلْجَا
lines.transliteration: ya man bihi yustaghathu wa ilayhi yulja'u
lines.english: O He Whose refuge is taken and to Whom resort is made!
I beseech You in the name of the Seats of Honor belonging to Your Throne,
the utmost of mercy in Your Book,
Your All-great Name,
Your All-high majesty,
and Your most high, perfect Words.

lines.transliteration: allahumma rabba alrriyahi wa ma dharat
lines.english: O Allah, Lord of winds and whatever they scatter far,
Lord of the sky and whatever it covers,
the Lord of the earth and whatever it carries,
the Lord of the devils and whomever they mislead,
and the Lord of the oceans and wherever they flow.

lines.arabic: وَبِحَقِّ كُلِّ حَقٍّ هُوَ عَلَيْكَ حَقٌّ
lines.transliteration: wa bihaqqi kulli haqqin huwa `alayka haqqun
lines.english: I beseech You in the name of everything that enjoys a right with You,
in the name of the favorite angels,
the angels managing the spirits, the cherubim,

lines.arabic: وَٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ لَكَ بِٱللَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ لاَ يَفْتُرُونَ
lines.transliteration: walmusabbihina laka billayli walnnahari la yafturuna
lines.english: and the angels praising You night and day without showing sluggishness,
in the name of Abraham, Your intimate friend,

lines.arabic: وَبِحَقِّ كُلِّ وَلِيٍّ يُنَادِيكَ بَيْنَ ٱلصَّفَا وَٱلْمَرْوَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa bihaqqi kulli waliyyin yunadika bayna alssafawalmarwati
lines.english: and in the name of each and every saint who calls You between Safa and Marwah
and You respond to his/her prayer.

lines.arabic: يَا مُجِيبُ أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ هٰذِهِ ٱلاسْمَاءِ وَبِهٰذِهِ ٱلدَّعَوَاتِ
lines.transliteration: ya mujibu as'aluka bihaqqi hadhihi al-asma'i wa bihadhihi aldda`awati
lines.english: O Responsive Lord! I beseech You in the name of all these names and all these prayers

lines.arabic: انْ تَغْفِرَ لَنَا مَا قَدَّمْنَا وَمَا اخَّرْنَا
lines.transliteration: an taghfira lana ma qaddamna wa ma akhkharna
lines.english: to forgive us all our past and coming sins,

lines.transliteration: wa ma asrarna wa ma a`lanna
lines.english: including the secret and the open,

lines.transliteration: wa ma abdayna wa ma akhfayna
lines.english: the hidden and the public,

lines.transliteration: wa ma anta a`lamu bihi minna
lines.english: and those whom You know better than we do.
Verily, You have power over all things.
[Respond] in the name of Your mercy, O most Merciful of all those who show mercy.
O He Who guards all strangers!
O He Who brings entertainment to all lonely ones!
O He Who is the power of all the weak!
O He Who is the support of all the persecuted!
O He Who bestows upon all the deprived!
O He Who brings entertainment to all the lonesome!
O He Who is the company of all those on journeys!
O He Who is the pillar of all the present!

lines.transliteration: ya ghafira kulli dhanbin wa khati'atin
lines.english: O He Who forgives all sins and offenses!
O He Who is the aid of all those begging aid!
O He Who is the relief of all those pleading for relief!
O He Who relieves the calamity of those inflicted with calamities!
O He Who alleviate the distress of the distressed ones!
O He Who is the Originator of the heavens and the layers of the earth!
O He Who is the utmost hope of the seekers!
O He Who responds to the prayers of the troubled!
O He Who is the most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
O Lord of the worlds!
O Master of the Judgment Day!
O most Magnanimous of all those who act magnanimously!
O most Generous of all those who act generously!
O most Hearing of all those who can hear!
O most Seeing of all those who can see!
O most Powerful of all those who have power!

lines.arabic: ٱغْفِرْ لِيَ ٱلذُّنُوبَ ٱلَّتِي تُغَيِّرُ ٱلنِّعَمَ
lines.transliteration: ighfir liya aldhdhunuba allati tughayyiru alnni`ama
lines.english: (Please) forgive my sins that change the bounties

lines.arabic: وَٱغْفِرْ لِيَ ٱلذُّنُوبَ ٱلَّتِي تُورِثُ ٱلنَّدَمَ
lines.transliteration: waghfir liya aldhdhunuba allati turithu alnnadama
lines.english: And forgive me my sins that bring about remorse,

lines.arabic: وَٱغْفِرْ لِيَ ٱلذُّنُوبَ ٱلَّتِي تُورِثُ ٱلسَّقَمَ
lines.transliteration: waghfir liya aldhdhunuba allati turithu alssaqama
lines.english: forgive me my sins that result in ailment,

lines.arabic: وَٱغْفِرْ لِيَ ٱلذُّنُوبَ ٱلَّتِي تَهْتِكُ ٱلْعِصَمَ
lines.transliteration: waghfir liya aldhdhunuba allati tahtiku al`isama
lines.english: forgive me my sins that tear safeguards,

lines.arabic: وَٱغْفِرْ لِيَ ٱلذُّنُوبَ ٱلَّتِي تَرُدُّ ٱلدُّعَاءَ
lines.transliteration: waghfir liya aldhdhunuba allati taruddu alddu`a'a
lines.english: forgive me my sins that repel prayers,

lines.arabic: وَٱغْفِرْ لِيَ ٱلذُّنُوبَ ٱلَّتِي تَحْبِسُ قَطْرَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ
lines.transliteration: waghfir liya aldhdhunuba allati tahbisu qatra alssama'i
lines.english: forgive me my sins that withhold the drops of the sky,

lines.arabic: وَٱغْفِرْ لِيَ ٱلذُّنُوبَ ٱلَّتِي تُعَجِّلُ ٱلْفَنَاءَ
lines.transliteration: waghfir liya aldhdhunuba allati tu`ajjilu alfana'a
lines.english: forgive me my sins that hasten extinction,

lines.arabic: وَٱغْفِرْ لِيَ ٱلذُّنُوبَ ٱلَّتِي تَجْلِبُ ٱلشَّقَاءَ
lines.transliteration: waghfir liya aldhdhunuba allati tajlibu alshshaqa'a
lines.english: forgive me my sins that beget misery,

lines.arabic: وَٱغْفِرْ لِيَ ٱلذُّنُوبَ ٱلَّتِي تُظْلِمُ ٱلْهَوَاءَ
lines.transliteration: waghfir liya aldhdhunuba allati tuzlimu alhawa'a
lines.english: forgive me my sins that darken the atmospheres,

lines.arabic: وَٱغْفِرْ لِيَ ٱلذُّنُوبَ ٱلَّتِي تَكْشِفُ ٱلْغِطَاءَ
lines.transliteration: waghfir liya aldhdhunuba allati takshifu alghita'a
lines.english: forgive me my sins that disclose the coverings,

lines.arabic: وَٱغْفِرْ لِيَ ٱلذُّنُوبَ ٱلَّتِي لاَ يَغْفِرُهَا غَيْرُكَ يَا اللَّهُ
lines.transliteration: waghfir liya aldhdhunuba allati la yaghfiruhaghayruka ya allahu
lines.english: forgive me my sins that none can forgive save You, O Allah,

lines.arabic: وَٱحْمِلْ عَنِّي كُلَّ تَبِعَةٍ لاحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
lines.transliteration: wahmil `anni kulla tabi`atin li'ahadin min khalqika
lines.english: bear from me every offensive that I have made against any of Your creatures,

lines.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ امْرِي فَرَجاً وَمَخْرَجاً وَيُسْراً
lines.transliteration: waj`al li min amri farajan wa makhrajan wa yusran
lines.english: make all my affairs reach at relief, exit, and easiness,
make Your tranquility ascend on my chest,

lines.arabic: وَرَجَاءَكَ فِي قَلْبِي حَتَّىٰ لاَ ارْجُوَ غَيْرَكَ
lines.transliteration: wa raja'aka fi qalbi hatta la arjuwa ghayraka
lines.english: and make hope in You ascend on my heart so that I shall never hope for anyone save You.
O Allah, (please) safeguard me, heal me in all my situations,
be my companion at nights and days,

lines.transliteration: wa min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi
lines.english: be ahead of me, behind me,
from my right side, from my left side,

lines.transliteration: wa min fawqi wa min tahti
lines.english: from above me, and from beneath me,
make easy all the ways for me,
make excellent facilitation for me,
do not disappoint me in hardships,
guide me, O Best of all guides,

lines.arabic: وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي فِي الْأُمُورِ
lines.transliteration: wa la takilni ila nafsi fi al-umuri
lines.english: do not leave me alone in all my affairs,
make me receive all pleasures,
and make me return to my family with prosperity, success,
and gladness in the present and in the future.
Verily, You have power over all things.
(Please) bestow upon me with Your favors,
expand for me the most favorable of Your sustenance,
apply me to the obedience to You,
redeem me from Your chastisement and Fire,

lines.arabic: وَٱقْلِبْنِي إِذَا تَوَفَّيْتَنِي إِلَىٰ جَنَّتِكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ
lines.transliteration: waqlibni idha tawaffaytani ila jannatika birahmatika
lines.english: and when You grasp my soul, lead me to Your Paradise, by Your mercy.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma inni a`udhu bika min zawali ni`matika
lines.english: O Allah, I seek Your protection against confiscation of Your graces,
against alternation of Your conferral of wellbeing on me,
against the befalling of Your punishment,
and against the ensuing of Your chastisement.

lines.transliteration: wa a`udhu bika min jahdi albala'i
lines.english: I seek Your protection against arduous hardships,
against coming about of misery,
against evil end results,
against my enemies’ gloating over my grief,

lines.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ
lines.transliteration: wa min sharri ma yanzilu min alssama'i
lines.english: against the evil of everything that ascends from the heavens,

lines.arabic: وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي ٱلْكِتَابِ ٱلْمُنْزَلِ
lines.transliteration: wa min sharri ma fi alkitabi almunzali
lines.english: and against the evils mentioned in the Revealed Book.
O Allah, (please) do not include me with the evil ones,
do not include me with the people of Hellfire,
do not deprive me of the companionship of the upright people,
grant me a pleasant lifetime,

lines.transliteration: wa tawaffani wafatan tayyibatan tulhiquni bil-abrari
lines.english: decide for me a kind of death due to which You will join me to the Pious Ones,
and confer upon me with the companionship of the Prophets

lines.arabic: فِي مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِنْدَ مَلِيكٍ مُقْتَدِرٍ
lines.english: in the seat of honesty with the All-powerful King.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ عَلَىٰ حُسْنِ بَلاَئِكَ وَصُنْعِكَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma laka alhamdu `ala husni bala'ika wa sun`ika
lines.english: O Allah, all praise be to You for Your pleasant trials and deeds to us.

lines.arabic: وَلَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ عَلَىٰ ٱلإِسْلاَمِ وَٱتِّبَاعِ ٱلسُّنَّةِ
lines.transliteration: wa laka alhamdu `ala al-islami wattiba`i alssunnati
lines.english: All praise be to You for my being Muslim and for my following the Prophet’s traditions.
O my Lord, as You have guided them (i.e. the pious)
and taught them Your Book, (please) guide us and teach us.

lines.arabic: وَلَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ عَلَىٰ حُسْنِ بَلاَئِكَ وَصُنْعِكَ عِنْدِي خَاصَّةً
lines.transliteration: wa laka alhamdu `ala husni bala'ika wa sun`ika `indi khassatan
lines.english: All praise be to You for Your pleasant trials and deeds to me in private,
as You created me, gifted me an excellent form,
taught me, gifted me excellent erudition,
guided me, and gifted me excellent guidance.

lines.arabic: فَلَكَ ٱلْحَمْدُ عَلَىٰ إِنْعَامِكَ عَلَيَّ قَدِيماً وَحَدِيثاً
lines.transliteration: falaka alhamdu `ala in`amika `alayya qadiman wa hadithan
lines.english: So, all praise be to You for Your favors that You conferred upon me in the past and in the present.

lines.arabic: فَكَمْ مِنْ كَرْبٍ يَا سَيِّدِي قَدْ فَرَّجْتَهُ
lines.transliteration: fakam min karbin ya sayyidi qad farrajtahu
lines.english: Too many are the agonies that You, my Master, relieved.

lines.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ غَمٍّ يَا سَيِّدِي قَدْ نَفَّسْتَهُ
lines.transliteration: wa kam min ghammin ya sayyidi qad naffastahu
lines.english: Too many are the distresses that You, my Master, eased.

lines.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ هَمٍّ يَا سَيِّدِي قَدْ كَشَفْتَهُ
lines.transliteration: wa kam min hammin ya sayyidi qad kashaftahu
lines.english: Too many are the sufferings that You, my Master, alleviated.

lines.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ بَلاَءٍ يَا سَيِّدِي قَدْ صَرَفْتَهُ
lines.transliteration: wa kam min bala'in ya sayyidi qad saraftahu
lines.english: Too many are the hardships from which You, my Master, saved me.

lines.arabic: وَكَمْ مِنْ عَيْبٍ يَا سَيِّدِي قَدْ سَتَرْتَهُ
lines.transliteration: wa kam min `aybin ya sayyidi qad satartahu
lines.english: Too many are the defects that You, my Master, covered.
So, all praise be to You for all conditions,
in every place and time,
every circumstance and situation,

lines.transliteration: wa `ala hadhihi alhali wa kulli halin
lines.english: and for the current condition and all conditions.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْنِي مِنْ افْضَلِ عِبَادِكَ نَصِيباً
lines.english: O Allah, (please) shower upon me the best share of every good thing

lines.arabic: فِي هٰذَا ٱلْيَوْمِ مِنْ خَيْرٍ تَقْسِمُهُ
lines.transliteration: fi hadha alyawmi min khayrin taqsimuhu
lines.english: that You decide for Your servants on this day,
such as harm that You decide to hold off,
evil that You decide to ward off,
ordeal that You decide to deter,
grace that You decide to grant,
item of mercy that You decide to distribute,
and item of wellbeing that You decide to cover up (on one of Your servants),
for You verily have power over all things,
in Your hands lie the hoards of the heavens and the earth,
You are verily the One, the All-generous, and the Best Bestower,
You are the One Whose beseechers are not rejected,
and You are the One Who never disappoint those who put hope in Him,
the One Who is never influenced by the rewards that He bestows upon anyone,
and the One Whose possessions never run out;
rather, You always increase in quantity, excellent gift,
conferrals, and magnanimity.

lines.arabic: وَٱرْزُقْنِي مِنْ خَزَائِنِكَ ٱلَّتِي لاَ تَفْنَىٰ
lines.transliteration: warzuqni min khaza'inika allati la tafna
lines.english: (Please) bestow upon me from Your hoards that never come to an end
and from Your expansive mercy.
Your conferral shall never be confined
and You have power over all things;
in the name of Your mercy; O most Merciful of all those who show mercy.

title: Dua Yastashir
description: Imam Ali (a.s.) said, “The Messenger of Allah taught me this supplication and ordered me to say it under all circumstances—sorrow and joy.” It is one of the treasures of the Divine Throne.

lines.english: All praise is due to Allah.
There is no god but He,
the True, Manifest King.
He is the Administrator without any minister
and without consultation with any of his slaves.
He is the First Who cannot be described.
He is Eternal after the annihilation of all creatures.
He is the greatest Cherisher,
the Light of the heavens and the earth
and their Creator and Maker out of nothing.
He created both of them and separated them with a proper separation;
the heavens hence became stable in obedience to His command
and the earths became fixed on the surface of the water with their pegs.

lines.arabic: ثُمَّ عَلاَ رَبُّنَا فِي ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ ٱلْعُلَىٰ
lines.english: Then, our Lord subdued the high heavens,
the All-beneficent, ruled from the Throne.

lines.transliteration: lahu ma fi alssamawati wa ma fi al-ardi
lines.english: Everything that is in the heavens and in the earth,

lines.transliteration: wa ma baynahuma wa ma tahta alththara
lines.english: and in between them and what is below the earth belongs to Him.
So, I bear witness that You are verily Allah;
there is none to elevate what You may lower,
none to lower what You may elevate,
no one to exalt him whom You leave in disgrace,
no one to bring into disgrace him whom You exalt,
no one to prevent him upon whom You bestow Your favor,
and no one to bestow anything which You may withhold.

lines.arabic: وَانتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ انتَ
lines.transliteration: wa anta allahu la ilaha illa anta
lines.english: You are Allah, there is no god but You;

lines.transliteration: kunta idh lam takun sama'un mabniyyatun
lines.english: You existed when there was neither stable sky,
nor broad earth,
nor brilliant sun,
nor dark night,
nor bright day
nor vast ocean,
nor stable mountain,
nor revolving planet,
nor luminous moon,
nor blowing wind,
nor raining cloud,
nor flashing lightning,
nor praising thunder,
nor breathing soul,
nor flying bird,
nor blazing fire,
nor flowing water.
You existed before the existence of all things,
You created everything,
had power over everything,
and originated everything.
You enriched some and reduced others to poverty,
caused some to die and brought others to life,
and made some laugh and others weep.
Verily, You rule from the Throne.
Blessed and Exalted be You, O Allah.

lines.arabic: انتَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ انتَ
lines.transliteration: anta allahu alladhi la ilaha illa anta
lines.english: You are Allah save Whom there is no god;
the Creator and Supporter.
Your Decree is overpowering,
Your Knowledge is operative,
Your strategy is wonderful,
Your promise is fulfilled,
Your saying is true,
Your judgment is fair,
Your words are right guidance,
Your Revelation is light,
Your mercy is all-inclusive,
Your forgiveness is superb,
Your grace is excessive,
Your gift is most abundant,
Your cord is strong,
Your ability is ever ready,
Your protégé is supported,
Your prowess is strong,
and Your stratagem is entrapping.

lines.transliteration: anta ya rabbi mawdi`u kulli shakwa
lines.english: You, O my Lord, are the target of all complaints,
the present in all gatherings,
the witness of all confidential talks,
the ultimate goal of all requests,
the expeller of all sorrows,
the affluence of every needy,
the stronghold for every refugee,
the security of every fearful,
the shield of the weak,
the treasure for the indigent,
the destroyer of grief,
and the helper of the righteous.

lines.arabic: ذٰلِكَ  ٱللَّهُ رَبُّنَا لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ
lines.transliteration: dhalika allahu rabbuna la ilaha illa huwa
lines.english: Such is Allah, our Lord. There is no god but He.

lines.arabic: تَكْفِي مِنْ عِبَادِكَ مَنْ تَوَكَّلَ عَلَيْكَ
lines.english: You satisfy such of Your slaves as trust in You.

lines.arabic: وَانتَ جَارُ مَنْ لاَذَ بِكَ وَتَضَرَّعَ إِلَيْكَ
lines.transliteration: wa anta jaru man ladha bika wa tadarra`a ilayka
lines.english: You are the protector of him who has recourse to You and implore You,
the haven of him who seeks Your haven,
the supporter of him who looks up to You support,
the forgiver of sins of him who begs Your forgiveness,
the Compeller of the tyrants,
the Most Grand of the grand,
the Most Great of the great,
the Master of masters,
the Lord of lords,
the Succor of the grieved,
the Reliever of the aggrieved,
the Responder to the calls of the distressed,
the most hearing of the hearers,
the most-seeing of all observers,
the justest of all judges,
the quickest in reckoning,
the most merciful of all the merciful,
the best of all forgivers,
the satisfier of the needs of the faithful,
and the succorer of the righteous.

lines.arabic: انتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ انتَ
lines.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta
lines.english: You are Allah, there is no god but You,
the Lord of the worlds.
You are the Creator and I am a creature,

lines.transliteration: wa anta almaliku wa ana almamluku
lines.english: You are the Master and I am a servant,

lines.transliteration: wa anta alrrabbu wa ana al`abdu
lines.english: You are the Lord and I am a slave,

lines.transliteration: wa anta alrraziqu wa ana almarzuqu
lines.english: You are the Provider while I am provided with sustenance,

lines.transliteration: wa anta almu`ti wa ana alssa'ilu
lines.english: You are the Giver while I am a beggar,

lines.transliteration: wa anta aljawadu wa ana albakhilu
lines.english: You are the Generous while I am a miser,

lines.transliteration: wa anta alqawiyyu wa ana aldda`ifu
lines.english: You are the Mighty while I am weak,

lines.transliteration: wa anta al`azizu wa ana aldhdhalilu
lines.english: You are the Noble while I am humble,

lines.transliteration: wa anta alghaniyyu wa ana alfaqiru
lines.english: You are the Independent while I am needy,

lines.transliteration: wa anta alssayyidu wa ana al`abdu
lines.english: You are the Master while I am slave,

lines.transliteration: wa anta alghafiru wa ana almusi'u
lines.english: You are the Forgiver of sins while I am sinful,

lines.transliteration: wa anta al`alimu wa ana aljahilu
lines.english: You are the Omniscient while I am ignorant,

lines.transliteration: wa anta alhalimu wa ana al`ajulu
lines.english: You are the forbearing while I am hasty,

lines.transliteration: wa anta alrrahmanu wa ana almarhumu
lines.english: You are the All-Merciful and I lack mercy,

lines.transliteration: wa anta almu`afi wa ana almubtala
lines.english: You are the Healer but I am involved in suffering,

lines.transliteration: wa anta almujibu wa ana almudtarru
lines.english: and You are the Responder and I am the distressed.

lines.transliteration: wa ana ash-hadu bi'annaka anta allahu
lines.english: I bear witness that You are verily Allah,
there is no god but You,
You bestow favors upon Your slaves before they beseech them.
I bear witness that You are verily Allah,
the One, the Peerless, the Unique, the Independent, the Single,
and to You is the return.

lines.arabic: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاهْلِ بَيْتِهِ ٱلطَّيِّبِينَ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa salla allahu `ala muhammadin wa ahli baytihi alttayyibina alttahirina
lines.english: May the blessings of Allah be upon Muhammad and his Household, the immaculate and pure.
Forgive my sins,
keep my faults concealed,

lines.arabic: وَٱفْتَحْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَرِزْقاً وَاسِعاً
lines.transliteration: waftah li min ladunka rahmatan wa rizqan wasi`an
lines.english: and extend to me Your special and bounteous sustenance.
O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
All praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.

lines.transliteration: wa hasbuna allahu wa ni`ma alwakilu
lines.english: Allah is the Sufficient to us and excellent Protector is He.

lines.arabic: وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
lines.transliteration: wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al`aliyyi al`azimi
lines.english: There is neither might nor power but with Allah, the All-high, the All-great.

title: Supplication at the First Hour (Dawn-Sunrise) - dedicated to Imam Ali (as)
description: The first hour (dawn-sunrise) of the day is dedicated to Imam Ali Amir al-Mu'minun (as).

lines.english: O Allah, O Lord of brilliance, greatness,
grandeur, and authority!
You have demonstrated the power as You wished,
bestowed upon Your servants with Your forgiveness,
dominated over them with Your supremacy,
and taught them how to thank Your graces.
O Allah, in the name of `Al, the well-pleased for the religion,
the well-versed with the judgment and the streams of piety,
and the leader of the pious,

lines.arabic: صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ فِي ٱلاأوَّلِينَ وَٱلآخِرِينَ
lines.english: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household among the past and the coming generations,
lines.transliteration: sssalli `al Muhammadin wa alihi f al-awwalna wal-khirna

lines.english: and I present him (i.e. `Al) as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

lines.arabic: اأنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: [I beseech You] to send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...
lines.transliteration: an tusalliya `al Muhammadin wa li Muhammadin

title: Supplication at the Second Hour - dedicated to Imam Hasan al-Mujtaba (as)
description: The second hour of the day is dedicated to Imam al-Hasan al-Mujtaba (as).

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَبِسْتَ بَهَاءَكَ فِي اأعْظَمِ قُدْرَتِكَ
lines.english: O Allah, You have dressed Yourself with Your brilliance in the greatest level of Your power.
lines.transliteration: allhumma labista bah'aka f a`ami qudratika

lines.english: Your Light has been clear in the most glowing level of Your brightness.
Your knowledge has surpassed Your Screen.

lines.arabic: وَخَلَّصْتَ فِيهِ اأهْلَ ٱلثِّقَةِ بِكَ عِنْدَ جُودِكَ
lines.english: Through it (i.e. knowledge), You have accurately selected those having full trust in You, out of Your magnanimity.
lines.transliteration: wa khallata fhi ahla alththiqati bika `inda jdika

lines.english: So, exalted by You in Your grandeur

lines.arabic: عُلُوّاً عَظُمَتْ فِيهِ مِنَّتُكَ عَلَىٰ اأهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ
lines.english: with such exaltation due to which Your conferrals upon the people of obedience to You have been immense.

lines.arabic: فَبَاهَيْتَ بِهِمْ اأهْلَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ بِمِنَّتِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ
lines.english: You therefore boasted the inhabitants of Your heavens about Your favoring upon them (i.e. the obedient to You).

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَبِحَقِّ ٱلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْكَ اأسْاألُكَ
lines.english: O Allah, in the name the regard of al-asan, the son of `Al, with You I beseech You,
and in his name too, I seek Your succor
and I present him as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

lines.arabic: اأنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...
lines.transliteration: an tusalliya `al Muhammadin wa li Muhammadin

title: Supplication at the Third Hour - dedicated to Imam Husayn (as)
description: The third hour of the day is dedicated to Imam al-Husayn (as).

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ تَجَبَّرَ فَلاَ عَيْنٌ تَرَاهُ
lines.english: O He Who is too Omnipotent to be seen by any eye!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ تَعَظَّمَ فَلاَ تَخْطُرُ ٱلْقُلُوبُ بِكُنْهِهِ
lines.english: O He Who is so Great that hearts cannot even imagine His quiddity!
lines.transliteration: y man ta`aama fadal takhuru alqulbu bikunhih

lines.english: O most Excellent in favoring!
O most Excellent in condonation!
O most Excellent in pardoning!
O All-magnanimous! O All-generous!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ لاَ يُشْبِهُهُ شَيْءٌ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ
lines.english: O He none of Whose creatures is like Him!
lines.transliteration: y man l yushbihuh shay'un min khalqih

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ مَنَّ عَلَىٰ خَلْقِهِ بِاأوْلِيَائِهِ
lines.english: O He Who has conferred a benefit upon His creatures through His Vicegerents
whom He has accepted for His religion,
through whom He has disciplined His servants,

lines.arabic: وَجَعَلَهُمْ حُجَجاً مَنّاً مِنْهُ عَلَىٰ خَلْقِهِ
lines.english: and whom He has made arguments against His creatures, out of His favor!
lines.transliteration: wa ja`alahum hujajan mannan minhu `al khalqih

lines.english: I beseech You in the name of al-usayn the son of `Al,
peace be upon both of them,
the grandson who is subservient to Your pleasure,
sincere in Your religion,
and the signpost on Your Essence;
I thus beseech You in the name of him
and I present him as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

lines.arabic: اأنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...
lines.transliteration: an tusalliya `al Muhammadin wa li Muhammadin

title: Supplication at the Fourth Hour - dedicated to Imam Ali Zayn al-Abidin (as)
description: The fourth hour of the day is dedicated to Imam Ali Zayn al-Abidin (as).

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَفَا نُورُكَ فِي اأتَمِّ عَظَمَتِكَ
lines.english: O Allah, very clear is Your Light in Your most perfect greatness.
Very exalted is Your brightness in Your most brilliant glow.

lines.arabic: اأسْاألُكَ بِنُورِكَ ٱلَّذِي نَوَّرْتَ بِهِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلاأرَضِينَ
lines.english: I beseech You in the name of Your Light by which You have lit up the heavens and the layers of the earth,
lines.transliteration: as'aluka binrika alladh nawwarta bih alssamwti wal-arana

lines.english: annihilated the tyrants,
restored the dead to life,
caused the alive to die,
brought together the scattered,
split the brought together,
perfected the Words,
and established the heavens.

lines.arabic: اأسْاألُكَ بِحَقِّ وَلِيِّكَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ
lines.english: I beseech You in the name of Your vicegerent, `Al the son of al-usayn,
peace be upon both of them,
who defended Your religion
and strove painstakingly for Your sake;
and I present him as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

lines.arabic: اأنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...
lines.transliteration: an tusalliya `al Muhammadin wa li Muhammadin

title: Supplication at the Fifth Hour - dedicated to Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (as)
description: The fifth hour of the day is dedicated to Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (as).

lines.english: O Allah, O Lord of brightness, greatness,
light, grandeur, and authority!
You have practiced omnipotence in the greatness of Your brilliance,
conferred upon Your servants with the favor of Your kindness and mercy,
showed them where Your pleasure lies,

lines.arabic: وَجَعَلْتَ لَهُمْ دَلِيلاًَ يَدُلُّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَحَبَّتِكَ
lines.english: and made for them a sign guiding them to Your love,
lines.transliteration: wa ja`alta lahum dallan yadulluhum `al maabbatika

lines.english: teaching them the items that You love,
and showing them Your volition.
O Allah, in the name of the regard of Muhammad, the son of `Al,
peace be upon both of them, with You, I beseech You
and I present him as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

lines.arabic: اأنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...
lines.transliteration: an tusalliya `al Muhammadin wa li Muhammadin

title: Supplication at the Sixth Hour - dedicated to Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (as)
description: The sixth hour of the day is dedicated to Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (as).

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَطُفَ عَنْ إِدْرَاكِ ٱلاأوْهَامِ
lines.english: O He Who is too subtle to be comprehended by illusions!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ كَبُرَ عَنْ مَوْجُودِ ٱلْبَصَرِ
lines.english: O He Who is too great to be observed by existent sights!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ تَعَالَىٰ عَنِ ٱلصِّفَاتِ كُلِّهَا
lines.english: O He Who is too exalted above all attributes!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ جَلَّ عَنْ مَعَانِي ٱللُّطْفِ
lines.english: O He Who is too majestic above all significances of subtlety
and too subtle above all significances of majesty!
I beseech You in the name of the light of Your Face and the brightness of Your grandeur
lines.transliteration: as'aluka binri wajhika wa iy'i kibriy'ika

lines.english: and I beseech You in the name of Your greatness
to grant me salvation from Your Fire.

lines.arabic: وَاأسْاألُكَ بِحَقِّ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْكَ
lines.english: I also beseech You in the name of the regard of Ja`far, the son of Muhammad, with You
lines.transliteration: wa as'aluka bi-haqqi ja`fadari bni Muhammadin `alayka

lines.english: and I present him as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

lines.arabic: اأنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...
lines.transliteration: an tusalliya `al Muhammadin wa li Muhammadin

title: Supplication at the Seventh Hour - dedicated to Imam Musa al-Kadhim (as)
description: The seventh hour of the day is dedicated to Imam Musa al-Kadhim (as).

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ تَكَبَّرَ عَنِ ٱلاأوْهَامِ صُورَتُهُ
lines.english: O He Whose Figure is too great above all illusions!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ تَعَالَىٰ عَنِ ٱلصِّفَاتِ نُورُهُ
lines.english: O He Whose Light is too elevated above attributes!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ قَرُبَ عِنْدَ دُعَاءِ خَلْقِهِ
lines.english: O He Whose is Nigh when His creatures pray Him!
O He Whom is supplicated by the distressed,
to Whom the afraid have recourse,
asked by the believers,
served by the thankful,
and praised by the sincere!
I beseech You in the name of Your glowing light
and the regard of Ms, the son of Ja`far, with You
through whom I seek nearness to You
and I present him as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

lines.arabic: اأنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...
lines.transliteration: an tusalliya `al Muhammadin wa li Muhammadin

title: Supplication at the Eighth Hour - dedicated to Imam Ali al-Ridha (as)
description: The eighth hour of the day is dedicated to Imam Ali al-Ridha (as).

lines.english: O Best of all besought ones!
O Best of all givers!
O Best of all asked ones!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ اأضَاءَ بِاسْمِهِ ضَوْءُ ٱلنَّهَارِ
lines.english: O He by Whose Name the light of days beams,
lines.transliteration: y man a'a bismih aw'u alnnahri

lines.english: the darkness of nights dims,
the heavy rain of floods flows,
and has provided His intimate servants with all prosperity!
O He Whose light has gone up the heavens,
Whose beam has gone up the earth,
and Whose mercy has gone up the east and the west!
O Ample in magnanimity,

lines.arabic: اأسْاألُكَ بِحَقِّ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُوسَىٰ ٱلرِّضَا
lines.english: I beseech You in the name of `Al, the son of Ms, the well-contented,
peace be upon both of them,
and I present him as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

lines.arabic: اأنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...
lines.transliteration: an tusalliya `al Muhammadin wa li Muhammadin

title: Supplication at the Ninth Hour - dedicated to Imam Muhammad al-Taqi (as)
description: The ninth hour of the day is dedicated to Imam Muhammad al-Taqi (as).

lines.english: O He Who, when the distressed prayed Him, responded to them,
when the afraid had recourse with Him, granted them security,
when the obedient served Him, thanked them,
when the believers thanked Him, favored upon them,
when they obeyed Him, safeguarded them,
when they asked Him, gave them,

lines.arabic: وَنَسُوا نِعْمَتَهُ فَلَمْ يُخْلِ شُكْرَهُ مِنْ قُلُوبِهِمْ
lines.english: and when they forgot His grace, did not evacuate thanking Him from their hearts;
lines.transliteration: wa nas ni`matah fadalam yukhli shukrah min qulbihim

lines.arabic: وَٱمْتَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ فَلَمْ يَجْعَلِ ٱسْمَهُ مَنْسِيّاً عِنْدَهُمْ
lines.english: and He favored them when He did not make His Name forgotten by them.
I beseech You in the name of Muhammad, the son of `Al,
peace be upon both of them,
You conclusive argument,
affluent grace,
and patent course,
and I present him as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

lines.arabic: اأنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...
lines.transliteration: an tusalliya `al Muhammadin wa li Muhammadin

title: Supplication at the Tenth Hour - dedicated to Imam Ali al-Naqi (as)
description: The tenth hour of the day is dedicated to Imam Ali al-Naqi (as).

lines.english: O He Who is Exalted and thus All-great!
O He Who is All-powerful and thus Omnipotent!
O He Who is Omnipotent and thus All-powerful!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ عَزَّ فَٱسْتَكْبَرَ فِي عِزِّهِ
lines.english: O He Who is Almighty and thus All-grand in His almightiness!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ عَلَىٰ خَلْقِهِ
lines.english: O He Who extended the shadow on His creatures!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنِ ٱمْتَنَّ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِهِ
lines.english: O He Who has conferred upon His servants with favors!
O Mighty and Lord of retribution!

lines.arabic: يَا مُنْتَقِماً بِعِزَّتِهِ مِنْ اأهْلِ ٱلشِّرْكِ
lines.english: O He Who retaliates upon the people of polytheism by His Might!
lines.transliteration: y muntaqiman bi`izzatih min ahli alshshirki

lines.english: I beseech You in the name of `Al, the son of Muhammad,
peace be upon both of them,
and I present him as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

lines.arabic: اأنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...
lines.transliteration: an tusalliya `al Muhammadin wa li Muhammadin

title: Supplication at the Eleventh Hour - dedicated to Imam Hasan al-Askari (as)
description: The eleventh hour of the day is dedicated to Imam al-Hasan al-Askari (as).

lines.english: O Foremost without having beginning!
O Ultimate without having end!
O Self-Subsisting without there being termination of His eternity!
O Almighty without cessation of His almightiness!

lines.arabic: يَا مُتَسَلِّطاً بِلاَ ضَعْفٍ مِنْ سُلْطَانِهِ
lines.english: O All-powerful without there being weak point in His overpowering!
lines.transliteration: y mutassssallian bil a`fin min sulnih

lines.english: O All-generous along with perpetuity of His graces!
O Omnipotent and Dignifier of His intimate servants!
O All-aware in His knowledge!
O All-knowledgeable in His power!
O Powerful in His Essence!
I beseech You in the name of al-asan, the son of `Al,
peace be upon both of them,
and I present him as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

lines.arabic: اأنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...
lines.transliteration: an tusalliya `al Muhammadin wa li Muhammadin

title: Supplication at the Twelfth Hour - dedicated to Imam al-Mahdi (atfs)
description: The twelfth hour of the day is dedicated to Imam al-Mahdi (atfs).

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ تَوَحَّدَ بِنَفْسِهِ عَنْ خَلْقِهِ
lines.english: O He Who has excluded Himself lonely from His creatures!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ غَنِيَ عَنْ خَلْقِهِ بِصُنْعِهِ
lines.english: O He Who has sufficed Himself from His creatures by His making!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ عَرَّفَ نَفْسَهُ خَلْقَهُ بِلُطْفِهِ
lines.english: O He Who has introduced Himself to His creatures out of His gentleness!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ سَلَكَ بِاأهْلِ طَاعَتِهِ مَرْضَاتَهُ
lines.english: O He Who has led the people of obedience to Him to His pleasure!
lines.transliteration: y man salaka bi'ahli ta`atihi mardi'atihi

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ اأعَانَ اأهْلَ مَحَبَّتِهِ عَلَىٰ شُكْرِهِمْ
lines.english: O He Who has helped the people of love for Him to thank Him!
lines.transliteration: y man a`na ahla mahabbatihi `al shukrihim

lines.english: O He Who has conferred upon them with the favor of His religion
and has been kind to them through His rewards!

lines.arabic: اأسْاألُكَ بِحَقِّ ٱلْخَلَفِ ٱلصَّالِحِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ
lines.english: I beseech You in the name of the regard of the Righteous Successor, peace be upon him, with You,
implore to You in his name,
and present him as my mediation for the settling of my needs,

lines.arabic: اأنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...
lines.transliteration: an tusalliya `al Muhammadin wa li Muhammadin

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
lines.transliteration: allhumma sssalli `al Muhammadin wa li Muhammadin

lines.english: the men of authority whom You have ordered us to obey,
the kindred by blood whom You have ordered us to connect,
lines.transliteration: wa ul al-armi alladhna amarta biilatihim

lines.english: the relatives whom You have ordered us to love,
lines.transliteration: wa dhaw alqurb alladhna amarta bimawaddatihim

lines.english: the masters whom You have ordered us to recognize their right,

lines.arabic: وَاأهْلِ ٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلَّذِينَ اأذْهَبْتَ عَنْهُمُ ٱلرِّجْسَ وَطَهَّرْتَهُمْ تَطْهِيراً
lines.english: and the People of the House from whom You have removed away filth and whom You have purified with thorough purifying,
lines.transliteration: wa ahli albayti alladhna adhhabta `anhum alrrijsa wa ahhartahum tathran

lines.arabic: اأنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.english: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and...
lines.transliteration: an tusalliya `al Muhammadin wa li Muhammadin

title: Glorification for the Three Special Hours
description: It is reported from Imam al-Sadiq (a) that there are three hours at night (last third of night until dawn) and three hours at day (early forenoon) at which Allah glorifies Himself. Reciting this glorification at these hours is highly recommended.

lines.arabic: انْتَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ
lines.english: You are Allah; there is no god save You, the Lord of the Worlds.
lines.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta rabbu al`alamina

lines.arabic: انْتَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ الرَّحِيمُ
lines.english: You are Allah; there is no god save You, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
lines.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta alrrahmanu alrrahimu

lines.arabic: انْتَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ
lines.english: You are Allah; there is no god save You, the All-High, the All-great.
lines.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta al`aliyyu alkabiru

lines.arabic: انْتَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ مَلِكُ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
lines.english: You are Allah; there is no god save You, the Master of the Judgment Day.
lines.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta maliku yawmi alddini

lines.arabic: انْتَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
lines.english: You are Allah; there is no god save You, the All-forgiving, the All-merciful.
lines.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta alghafuru alrrahimu

lines.arabic: انْتَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
lines.english: You are Allah; there is no god save You, the Almighty, the All-wise.
lines.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta al`azizu alhakimu

lines.arabic: انْتَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ مِنْكَ بَدْءُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
lines.english: You are Allah; there is no god save You, from You is the beginning of all things
lines.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta minka bad'u kulli shay'in

lines.english: and to You do all things return.

lines.arabic: انْتَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ لَمْ تَزَلْ وَلاَ تَزَالُ
lines.english: You are Allah; there is no god save You, You have been always existent and You will always be existent.
lines.transliteration: anta allahu alladhi la ilaha illa anta lam tazal wa la tazalu

lines.arabic: انْتَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ خَالِقُ الْخَيْرِ وَالشَّرِّ
lines.english: You are Allah; there is no god save You, the Creator of good and evil.
lines.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta khaliqu alkhayri walshsharri

lines.arabic: انْتَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ خَالِقُ الْجَنَّةِ وَالنَّارِ
lines.english: You are Allah; there is no god save You, the Creator of Paradise and Hell.
lines.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta khaliqu aljannati walnnari

lines.arabic: انْتَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ الاحَدُ الصَّمَدُ
lines.english: You are Allah; there is no god save You, the One and the eternally besought of all.
lines.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta al-ahadu alssamadu

lines.english: He begets not nor was begotten
and there is none comparable to Him.
lines.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu kufwan ahadun

lines.arabic: انْتَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ الْمَلِكُ الْقُدُّوسُ
lines.english: You are Allah; there is no god save You, the King, the All-holy,
lines.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta almaliku alquddusu

lines.english: the Giver of peace, the Granter of security, the Guardian over all,
the Almighty, the Omnipotent, and the Grand.
Glory be to Allah from what they set up with Him.
You are Allah; the Creator, the Originator, and the Fashioner.
Yours are the most excellent names.

lines.arabic: يُسَبِّحُ لَكَ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالارْضِ
lines.english: Whatever is in the heavens and the earth declares Your glory;
lines.transliteration: yusabbihu laka ma fi alssamawati wal-ardi

lines.english: and You are the Almighty, the All-wise.

lines.arabic: انْتَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَٰهَ إِلاَّ انْتَ
lines.english: You are Allah; there is no god save You,
lines.transliteration: anta allahu la ilaha illa anta

lines.english: the Great, the Most High. Grandeur is Your dress.

title: Dua Kayfa Adooka
description: This supplication, also known as the Dua of Muqatil bin Sulayman, is recommended to be recited 100 times for the fulfillment of needs.

lines.english: O my God! How can I call on Thee, seeing that I am I;
lines.transliteration: ilahi kayfa ad'uka wa ana ana

lines.arabic: وَكَيْفَ أَقْطَعُ رَجَائِي مِنْكَ وَأَنْتَ أَنْتَ؟
lines.english: and how can I cut off my hope from Thee, seeing that Thou art Thou?
lines.transliteration: wa kayfa aqta'u raja'i minka wa anta anta

lines.english: O my God! If I do not ask of Thee that Thou mayest give me,
who is there that I may ask to give me?

lines.arabic: إِلَهِي، إِذَا لَمْ أَدْعُوكَ فَتَسْتَجِيبَ لِي،
lines.english: O my God! If I do not call on Thee that Thou mayest answer me,
lines.transliteration: ilahi idha lam ad’uka fatastajiba li

lines.arabic: فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي أَدْعُوهُ فَيَسْتَجِيبُ لِي؟
lines.english: who is there that I may call on to answer me?

lines.arabic: إِلَهِي، إِذَا لَمْ أَتَضَرَّعْ إِلَيْكَ فَتَرْحَمَنِي،
lines.english: O my God! If I do not beseech Thee that Thou mayest have mercy on me,
lines.transliteration: ilahi idha lam atadarra’ ilayka fatarhamani

lines.arabic: فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي أَتَضَرَّعُ إِلَيْهِ فَيَرْحَمُنِي؟
lines.english: who is there that I may beseech to have mercy on me?

lines.arabic: إِلَهِي، فَكَمَا فَلَقْتَ الْبَحْرَ لِمُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَنَجَّيْتَهُ،
lines.english: O my God! Just as Thou didst cleave the sea for Moses (peace be upon him) and savedst him,
lines.transliteration: ilahi fakama falaqtal-bahra limusa ‘alayhis-salamu wa najjaytahu

lines.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ،
lines.english: I ask Thee that Thou mayest send blessings on Muhammad and his family,
lines.transliteration: as’aluka an tusalliya ‘ala muhammadin wa alihi

lines.english: and that Thou mayest save me from that in which I am,
lines.transliteration: wa an tunjiyani mimma ana fihi

lines.arabic: وَتُفَرِّجَ عَنِّي فَرَجاً عَاجِلاً غَيْرَ آجِلٍ،
lines.english: and grant me relief, a relief speedy, not late,
by Thy grace and Thy mercy, O most Merciful of those who show mercy!

title: Dua Arafah of Imam Husain (as)
arabicTitle: دُعَاء عَرَفَة لِلإِمَامِ الحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَام
description: Dua Arafah is a famous supplication of Imam al-Husayn (as) recited on the Day of Arafah (9th of Dhu al-Hijjah) at Mount Arafat. It is highly esteemed for its sublime theological and moral contents.

lines.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَيْسَ لِقَضَائِهِ دَافِعٌ
lines.english: Praise be to Allah Whose determination cannot be repelled by anything,
lines.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi laysa liqada'ihi dafi`un

lines.english: Whose gifts cannot be stopped by anything,
and Whose making cannot be resembled by the making of anyone.
He is the All-magnanimous, the All-liberal.
He originated the genus of the wonderfully created things
and He perfected the made things by His wisdom.
All growing things cannot be hidden from Him
and all things deposited with Him shall never be wasted.
He is the Repayer on every deed,
the Enricher of every satisfied one,
the Merciful toward every suppliant,
and the Revealer of the benefits
and the All-comprehensive Book with the glaring light.
He is also the Hearer of prayers,
the Warder-off of anguishes,
the Raiser of ranks,
and the Suppressor of the tyrants.
There is no god other than Him
and there is nothing equivalent to Him
and nothing like a likeness of Him,
and He is the All-hearing, the All-seeing,
the All-gentle, the All-aware,
and He has power over all things.
O Allah, I willingly desire for You
and I testify to the Lordship of You,
confessing that You are verily my Lord
and to You shall be my return.
You had begun bestowing on me
before I was anything worth mentioning,
and You created me from dust.
You then put me up in the loins,
(making me) saved from vicissitudes of time,
and change of ages and years.

lines.arabic: فَلَمْ أَزَلْ ظَاعِناً مِنْ صُلْبٍ إِلَىٰ رَحِمٍ
lines.english: I was moving from a loin to a womb
lines.transliteration: falam azal za`inan min sulbin ila rahimin

lines.english: throughout the passage of the past days
and the ancient ages;
as You have not taken me out (to this world)—on account of Your sympathy to me,
Your kindness to me,
and Your compassion to me—
in the government of the heads of unbelief
who breached their covenant with You
and denied Your messengers.

lines.arabic: لٰكِنَّكَ أَخْرَجْتَنِي لِلَّذِي سَبَقَ لِي مِنَ ٱلْهُدَىٰ
lines.english: However, You took me out on account of the guidance that You have already known about me
lines.transliteration: lakinnaka akhrajtani lilladhi sabaqa li min alhuda

lines.english: and You have made easy the way to it
and You have brought me up in it.
Even before that, You had compassion on me,
lines.transliteration: wa min qabli dhalika ra'ufta bi

lines.english: through Your excellent conferral
and Your affluent bestowals.
So, You fashioned my creation from semen that gushed forth
and put me up in triple darkness
among flesh, blood, and skin.
lines.transliteration: bayna lahmin wa damin wa jildin

lines.english: You have not made me witness my creation,

lines.arabic: وَلَمْ تَجْعَلْ إِلَيَّ شَيْئاً مِنْ أَمْرِي
lines.english: and You have not referred any part of my creation to me.
lines.transliteration: wa lam taj`al ilayya shay'an min amri

lines.arabic: ثُمَّ أَخْرَجْتَنِي لِلَّذِي سَبَقَ لِي مِنَ ٱلْهُدَىٰ
lines.english: You then took me out on account of the guidance that You have already known about me
lines.transliteration: thumma akhrajtani lilladhi sabaqa li min alhuda

lines.english: to the world, perfect and in sound health.
You have safeguarded me in the cradle as small child.
lines.transliteration: wa hafiztani fi almahdi tiflan sabiyyan

lines.english: You have provided me with wholesome milk as food.
lines.transliteration: wa razaqtani min alghidha'i labanan mariyyan

lines.english: You have made the hearts of the nursemaids tender.
You have given me into the charge of merciful mothers.
You have saved me from the visits of the Jinn.
You have delivered me from increase and decrease.
So, Exalted be You, O All-merciful, O All-beneficent.
When I commenced (my life) by pronouncing words,
You perfected for me the affluent bestowals,
and brought me up with an increase every year.
When my creation was accomplished,
and my power became straight,
You put me under the obligation of Your Claim,
which is that You inspired me with recognition of You
and alarmed me by the wonders of Your wisdom,

lines.arabic: وَأَيْقَظْتَنِي لِمَا ذَرَأْتَ فِي سَمَائِكَ وَأَرْضِكَ
lines.english: and You aroused in me that which You created in Your heavens and lands,
lines.transliteration: wa ayqaztani lima dhara'ta fi sama'ika wa ardika

lines.english: which is the excellent creation of You.
You attracted my attentions to thank and mention You.
You made obligatory on me to obey and worship You.
You made me understand that with which Your Apostles came.
lines.transliteration: wa fahhamtani ma ja'at bihi rusuluka

lines.english: You made easy for me to find agreeable Your pleasure.
You bestowed upon me with the favor of all that,
out of Your aid and Your gentleness.

lines.arabic: ثُمَّ إِذْ خَلَقْتَنِي مِنْ خَيْرِ ٱلثَّرَىٰ
lines.english: As You created me from the best of soil,
lines.transliteration: thumma idh khalaqtani min khayri alththara

lines.arabic: لَمْ تَرْضَ لِي يَا إِلٰهِي نِعْمَةً دُونَ أُخْرَىٰ
lines.english: You, my God, have not wanted for me to have a certain favor (and to be deprived of another)
lines.transliteration: lam tarda li ya ilahi ni`matan duna ukhra

lines.english: and You therefore provided me with the various kinds of living
and types of wealth,
out of Your great and grand conferral upon me,
and Your eternal kindness to me.

lines.arabic: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا أَتْمَمْتَ عَلَيَّ جَمِيعَ ٱلنِّعَمِ
lines.english: As You perfected for me all the graces
and warded off all misfortunes,
my ignorance of You and challenge have not stopped You

lines.arabic: أَنْ دَلَلْتَنِي إِلَىٰ مَا يُقَرِّبُنِي إِلَيْكَ
lines.english: from showing me that which takes me near to You,
lines.transliteration: an dalaltani ila ma yuqarribuni ilayka

lines.english: and from leading me to that which grants me proximity to You.
So, if I pray You, You will respond to me;
and if I beg You, You will give me;
and if I obey You, You will thank me;
and if I thank You, You will give me more.
All that is completion of Your favors for me,
and Your kindness to me.
So, all glory be to You; all glory be to You.
You are verily Originator and Reproducer (of the creation)
and worthy of all praise and full of all glory.
Holy be Your Names
as Your bounties are so immeasurable.

lines.arabic: فَأَيَّ نِعَمِكَ يَا إِلٰهِي أُحْصِي عَدَداً وَذِكْراً؟
lines.english: Which of Your favors, O my God, can I count in numbers and examples?
lines.transliteration: fa'ayya ni`amika ya ilahi uhsi `adadan wa dhikran

lines.arabic: أَمْ أَيَّ عَطَايَاكَ أَقُومُ بِهَا شُكْراً
lines.english: Or which of Your gifts can I thank properly?

lines.arabic: وَهِيَ يَا رَبِّ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ أَنْ يُحْصِيهَا ٱلْعَادُّونَ
lines.english: They are, O my Lord, too numerous to be counted by counters
lines.transliteration: wa hiya ya rabbi aktharu min an yuhsiha al`adduna

lines.english: or to be realized by memorizers.
Moreover, that which You have warded off and repelled,
O Allah, from (the various kinds of) harm and mischief

lines.arabic: أَكْثَرُ مِمَّا ظَهَرَ لِي مِنَ ٱلْعَافِيَةِ وَٱلسَّرَّاءِ
lines.english: is more than that which came to me from wellbeing and joy.
lines.transliteration: aktharu mimma zahara li min al`afiyati walssarra'i

lines.arabic: وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ يَا إِلٰهِي بِحَقِيقَةِ إِيـمَانِي
lines.english: And I bear witness, O my God, with my true belief,
lines.transliteration: wa ana ashhadu ya ilahi bihaqiqati imani

lines.english: and the fortitude of the determinations of my conviction
and the purity of my open belief in Your Oneness
and the essence of the secret of my conscience,
and the ties of the canals of the light of my sight,
and the lines of my forehead
and the hallows of the courses of my breath,
and the (nasal) cavities of my nose,
and the courses of the meatus of my hearing,
and whatever my two lips hide and cover up,
lines.transliteration: wa ma dammat wa atbaqat `alayhi shafataya

lines.english: and the motions of the vocalization of my tongue,
and the socket of the palate of my mouth and jaw,
lines.transliteration: wa maghrazi hanaki fami wa fakki

lines.english: and the matrices of my dents,
and the tasting of my food and my drink,
and the carrier of my skill,
and the tube of the tissues of my neck
and what is included by the cloak of my chest,
and the carriers of the cord of my aorta,
and the cords of the pericardium of my heart,
and the pieces of the retinues of my liver,
